words.englishDefinition: A well-known or notable person
words.japaneseExplanation: 有名な人。
words.example: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

words.englishDefinition: A facility consisting of the means and equipment necessary for the movement of passengers or goods
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗客または荷物の移動に必要な手段と設備で成る施設。
words.example: We have no means of transportation.

words.englishDefinition: An organization founded and united for a specific purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的のために設立され、統一された組織。
words.example: This institution came into being after the war.

words.englishDefinition: The act of taking something from someone unlawfully
words.japaneseExplanation: だれかから何かを不法に取る行為。
words.example: Please tell me how the theft was done.

words.englishDefinition: A politician who is running for public office
words.japaneseExplanation: 公職に立候補する政治家。
words.example: We promised our support to the candidate.

words.englishDefinition: Any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
words.japaneseExplanation: 皮膚がほぼ毛で覆われている、温血脊椎動物。単孔類の小亜綱を除いて子供は生きたまま生まれミルクで育てられる。
words.example: What is the largest mammal in the world?

words.englishDefinition: An expert in the science of economics
words.japaneseExplanation: 経済学の専門家。
words.example: My mother works as an English teacher, but she's an economist by profession.

words.englishDefinition: Any of a large group of nitrogenous organic compounds that are essential constituents of living cells; consist of polymers of amino acids; essential in the diet of animals for growth and for repair of tissues; can be obtained from meat and eggs and milk and legumes
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きた細胞の主要な成分である窒素有機化合物の大きなグループの総称。アミノ酸の重合体から成る。
words.example: How do you get your protein?

words.englishDefinition: A person who comes to a country where they were not born in order to settle there
words.japaneseExplanation: 彼らがそこで定住するために生まていない国に来る人。
words.example: Yanni was an immigrant who had to learn to speak English.

words.englishDefinition: Something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 所有されるもの。ある人物が所有する有形の所有物。
words.example: How many of the trees on your property are fruit trees?

words.englishDefinition: A reserve of money set aside for some purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの目的のために取っておかれる資金。
words.example: I have a college fund.

words.englishDefinition: The type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体またはグループが通常生活または発生する環境の種類。
words.example: I live in a space habitat.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that accompanies X and is regarded as an indication of X's existence
words.japaneseExplanation: Xに付随し、Xの存在のしるしと見なされるもの。
words.example: Do you have this symptom often?

words.englishDefinition: A sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然の激しい自然発生（通常いくつかの好ましくない状態の）。
words.example: I have a skin eruption.

words.englishDefinition: Forceful and extreme and rigorous
words.japaneseExplanation: 力強く極端で厳しい。
words.example: I must do something drastic.

words.englishDefinition: A minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
words.japaneseExplanation: 微小生命体（特に病気をもたらすバクテリア）。その語は専門的には使われない。
words.example: The man is also a stubborn microbe.

words.englishDefinition: Any liquid suitable for drinking
words.japaneseExplanation: 飲むのに適した液体の総称。
words.example: My favorite beverage is tea.

words.englishDefinition: Work that involves handling papers: forms or letters or reports etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 書類の処理を伴う仕事：書式のある文書や書状や報告書などの。
words.example: I never have time to get through all the paperwork.

words.englishDefinition: A person considered as descended from some ancestor or race
words.japaneseExplanation: ある先祖あるいは種族の系統をひくと思われる人。
words.example: We want to leave our descendants a clean and green earth.

words.englishDefinition: A three-dimensional work of plastic art
words.japaneseExplanation: プラスチックアートの３次元作品。
words.example: This sculpture is more than two thousand years old.

words.englishDefinition: a sheet of information given to people
words.japaneseExplanation: 授業や説明会などで配る資料やプリント。
words.example: Please read the handout before the next lesson.

words.englishDefinition: The act of furnishing an equivalent person or thing in the place of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の場所で、同等の人あるいはものを供給する行為。
words.example: You can't just go out and buy a replacement for this.

words.englishDefinition: A person appointed to a high office in the government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の高い地位に任命される人。
words.example: I spoke to the minister himself.

words.englishDefinition: A natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地表あるいは地下を流れる自然の流水。
words.example: I saw children playing in the stream.

words.englishDefinition: Any animal that lives by preying on other animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の動物を捕食して生きる動物。
words.example: My teacher was a predator.

words.englishDefinition: A person who becomes aware (of things or events) through the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 五感を通して物事を知覚する人。
words.example: The author is an observer of his era.

words.japanese: 代理手数料、歩合、委員会
words.englishDefinition: A special group delegated to consider some matter
words.japaneseExplanation: ある問題について検討することを委ねられた特別のグループ。
words.example: You should go to the commission.

words.englishDefinition: A special group delegated to consider some matter
words.japaneseExplanation: ある問題について検討することを委ねられた特別のグループ。
words.example: We want the committee to work out this problem.

words.japanese: がらくた、つまらないもの
words.englishDefinition: The remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up
words.japaneseExplanation: 破壊されたもの、またはばらばらにされたものの残骸。
words.example: Please get all of your junk out of this room.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of the present
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在の特性。
words.example: I must admit that I don't like contemporary music much.

words.englishDefinition: A state of lawlessness and disorder (usually resulting from a failure of government)
words.japaneseExplanation: 無法状態で混乱していること（通常、政府の不在が原因）。
words.example: They needed a new government to control the anarchy.

words.englishDefinition: The termination or disintegration of a relationship (between persons or nations)
words.japaneseExplanation: （人や国の間の）関係の終了か崩壊。
words.example: I heard about your breakup.

words.englishDefinition: A special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all
words.japaneseExplanation: みんなが享受できない、特別な有利さ、特典、利益。
words.example: We were given the privilege of using the library.

words.englishDefinition: Immunity from an obligation or duty
words.japaneseExplanation: 義務や債務からの免除。
words.example: Tom was given an exemption.

words.englishDefinition: A nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right
words.japaneseExplanation: 国家の支配者、または、国家元首で、たいていは世襲の権利による。
words.example: The monarch has six children.

words.englishDefinition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
words.japaneseExplanation: 出来事の行為、発生、詳細、進行を伝えるメッセージ。文書、劇、映画の中で、あるいはラジオまたはテレビの番組として示さた。
words.example: You were never one to let facts get in the way of your narrative.

words.englishDefinition: An unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation
words.japaneseExplanation: 刺激に対する直接的で基本的な認知。
words.example: I could never have imagined such a sensation.

words.englishDefinition: Works for an expert to learn a trade
words.japaneseExplanation: 働きながら仕事を学ぶ人。
words.example: Do you want to be my apprentice?

words.englishDefinition: A specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
words.japaneseExplanation: 義務として、あるいは、特定の料金のために行うことを要求される特定の仕事。
words.example: You can go play with your friends when your chores are done.

words.englishDefinition: Dryness resulting from the removal of water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水を取り除くことによる乾燥。
words.example: When it's very hot, you should drink lots of water to avoid dehydration.

words.englishDefinition: Subject to question
words.japaneseExplanation: 質問を受けやすい。
words.example: I think this is extremely questionable.

words.englishDefinition: Old; no longer valid or fashionable
words.japaneseExplanation: 古い。もはや有効でないかファッショナブルでない。
words.example: Your ideas are a bit outdated.

words.englishDefinition: happening soon
words.japaneseExplanation: 近いうちに予定されていること。
words.example: We discussed the forthcoming school trip at the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Before any deductions
words.japaneseExplanation: 控除の前。
words.example: You must be more careful to avoid making a gross mistake.

words.englishDefinition: Past due; not paid at the scheduled time
words.japaneseExplanation: 期日を過ぎたさま。予定された時間に支払われないさま。
words.example: I didn't realize that Tom's bill was overdue.

words.englishDefinition: How much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
words.japaneseExplanation: 定量化できるものがいくらあるか、またはいくつあるか。
words.example: What quantity of paper do you need?

words.englishDefinition: A public promotion of some product or service
words.japaneseExplanation: ある製品あるいはサービスの一般宣伝。
words.example: I think I'll place an ad in the paper.

words.englishDefinition: An act of economizing; reduction in cost
words.japaneseExplanation: 節約する行為。原価低減、コストの削減。
words.example: You need to work on saving your marriage.

words.englishDefinition: The geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
words.japaneseExplanation: 主権国家の管轄下の地理的な領域。
words.example: It goes with the territory.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is a source of danger
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険の源であるもの。
words.example: What he said was nothing less than a threat.

words.englishDefinition: A person suffering from an illness
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気に苦しむ人。
words.example: The sufferer of a cold may have spread the virus even before they noticed any symptoms.

words.englishDefinition: The act of emitting; causing to flow forth
words.japaneseExplanation: 放出する行為。前方へ流させる。
words.example: Australia had no such emission controls.

words.englishDefinition: A person responsible for the administration of a business
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業の経営に対して責任がある人。
words.example: I made an executive decision.

words.englishDefinition: An elaborate and systematic plan of action
words.japaneseExplanation: 入念で体系的な行動計画。
words.example: Do you think this strategy will work?

words.englishDefinition: A public act of violence by an unruly mob
words.japaneseExplanation: 抑制のきかない暴徒による公然の暴動。
words.example: I have the feeling that it's about time to read him the riot act.

words.englishDefinition: A region marked off for administrative or other purposes
words.japaneseExplanation: 行政目的または他の目的のために区画された地域。
words.example: I don't live in this district.

words.englishDefinition: A vote to select the winner of a position or political office
words.japaneseExplanation: 政治的職務を得る人を選ぶ投票。
words.example: You can't really believe he's going to win the election.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
words.example: I have been taking this medication for many years.

words.englishDefinition: to produce young animals; to raise animals for breeding
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物が子を産むことや、繁殖させること。
words.example: Some birds breed here during the summer months.

words.japanese: 賞賛されるべき、立派な
words.englishDefinition: Worthy of high praise
words.japaneseExplanation: 高い賞賛に値する。
words.example: What you're doing is commendable.

words.englishDefinition: The act of departing
words.japaneseExplanation: 出発する行為。
words.example: Could you change the departure date for this ticket?

words.englishDefinition: The act of describing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かについて説明する行為。
words.example: I don't know anyone in the city who would match this description.

words.englishDefinition: One who supervises or has charge and direction of
words.japaneseExplanation: 監督したり責任をとったり指揮をしたりする人。
words.example: I want to talk to your supervisor.

words.englishDefinition: Something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action
words.japaneseExplanation: 決定または行動方針に関しての指示またはアドバイスを提供する何か。
words.example: We thank you for your guidance.

words.englishDefinition: An expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
words.japaneseExplanation: 一目で見られる景色の広がり。
words.example: I've never seen a landscape this big.

words.englishDefinition: The men and women who man a vehicle (ship, aircraft, etc.)
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗り物（船、飛行機など）に勤務する男と女。
words.example: My son wants a crew cut, but not too short, please.

words.englishDefinition: A pipe through which liquid is carried away
words.japaneseExplanation: 液体が運び去られる管。
words.example: You dropped the keys down the drain!

words.englishDefinition: A conventional or formulaic conception or image
words.japaneseExplanation: 従来の、または、公式の概念かイメージ。
words.example: I don't want to be a stereotype.

words.englishDefinition: The form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published
words.japaneseExplanation: テキスト（特に印刷された本）が出版される形。
words.example: The book is now in its 6th edition.

words.englishDefinition: An image that is generated by a computer
words.japaneseExplanation: コンピュータにより生成されるイメージ。
words.example: You will need a graphic card to play this game.

words.englishDefinition: A trodden path
words.japaneseExplanation: 歩く道。
words.example: Ziri saw a figure standing in the pathway.

words.englishDefinition: The act of coming together again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び集まる行為。
words.example: I will go to the reunion.

words.englishDefinition: A steep high face of rock
words.japaneseExplanation: 岩の高くて急な斜面。
words.example: You must be careful that she doesn't fall over the cliff.

words.englishDefinition: Someone whose task is to see that work goes harmoniously
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事が調和して進んでいるか確認することを任務とする人。
words.example: I'd like to talk to the coordinator of this project.

words.englishDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
words.example: I hear the competition is brutal.

words.englishDefinition: Qualified by reservations
words.japaneseExplanation: 条件によって制限される。
words.example: Their love feels conditional at times.

words.englishDefinition: Taking place within the mind and modified by individual bias
words.japaneseExplanation: 心の内に起こること、また個々の偏見により正される。
words.example: Some say that art is subjective.

words.englishDefinition: Being or from or characteristic of another place or part of the world
words.japaneseExplanation: 世界の別の場所または地域にいる、または、世界の別の場所または地域から来た、または、世界の別の場所または地域に特徴的な。
words.example: What is the most exotic language you speak?

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form
words.japaneseExplanation: 高度または強度で特徴づけられる。
words.example: I wanted to do an intensive Berber course.

words.englishDefinition: Not clearly understood or expressed
words.japaneseExplanation: 明確に理解されないか、または表現されない。
words.example: The reason why he left the tennis club is obscure.

words.englishDefinition: So lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
words.japaneseExplanation: そのため原因精神的な疲労に関しての関心を欠くさま。
words.example: I find this kind of work very tedious.

words.englishDefinition: Not divided or shared with others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他と分割されない、または分担しない。
words.example: We have the exclusive right to sell them.

words.englishDefinition: Socially or conventionally correct; refined or virtuous
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会的にまたは通常正しい。優雅であるか高潔である。
words.example: I can't find a decent place to eat around here.

words.englishDefinition: Showing concern for the rights and feelings of others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他人の権利と感情に対する関心を示すさま。
words.example: You should be more considerate of your parents.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of withstanding wear and tear and decay
words.japaneseExplanation: 消耗と腐敗に耐えることができる。
words.example: This seems expensive, but it's so durable it will pay off in the long run.

words.englishDefinition: Continuing forever or indefinitely
words.japaneseExplanation: 永遠に、または、無期限に続けるさま。
words.example: We are all perpetual learners.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識、技能、および才能を持っているか、または示すさま。
words.example: You won't become proficient if you only study the things you enjoy.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the science of acoustics
words.japaneseExplanation: 音響効果の科学の、または、音響効果の科学に関する。
words.example: When was the last time you played an acoustic guitar?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or being biography
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝記の、伝記に関する、または、伝記である。
words.example: Oleg watched a Japanese biographical film.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to plants or botany
words.japaneseExplanation: 植物または植物学に関する、またはそれの。
words.example: We found many strange plants in a botanical garden.

words.englishDefinition: An open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵対する2グループ（または2人）の間の公然の衝突。
words.example: I don't see a conflict.

words.englishDefinition: (economics) the ratio of the quantity and quality of units produced to the labor per unit of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間の1単位当たりの労働に対して生じる単位の量と質の比率。
words.example: What's the productivity per person?

words.englishDefinition: A living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
words.japaneseExplanation: 独立して行うまたは機能する能力を持つ（またはそのように発達することができる）生き物。
words.example: Our planet is a living organism.

words.englishDefinition: A person who represents others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他者の代理をする人。
words.example: He is in a sense a representative of his company.

words.englishDefinition: A storehouse for goods and merchandise
words.japaneseExplanation: 品物や商品の貯蔵庫。
words.example: We have probably about three hundred of those in our warehouse.

words.englishDefinition: The act of returning money received previously
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前受け取った金を返す行為。
words.example: I told you I wasn't interested in a refund.

words.englishDefinition: A fee paid for instruction (especially for higher education)
words.japaneseExplanation: 教育に支払われる授業料（特に高等教育のための）。
words.example: I am working to save for my college tuition.

words.englishDefinition: An area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが行動したり、稼動したり、権力や影響力をもったりする区域：。
words.example: We do have something which is more in your price range.

words.englishDefinition: An unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの不利な状況に悩む不幸な人。
words.example: You don't have to be a victim.

words.englishDefinition: The quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time
words.japaneseExplanation: 1回に吸収されるもしくは飲まれる、反応性のある薬品（物質もしくは放射）の量。
words.example: Please give him a dose of medicine every six hours.

words.englishDefinition: The main land mass of a country or continent; as distinguished from an island or peninsula
words.japaneseExplanation: 国または大陸の大部分を占める中心的な陸地。島や半島と区別した言い方。
words.example: We took a ferry from the island to the mainland.

words.englishDefinition: A steep descent of the water of a river
words.japaneseExplanation: 川の水の急な落下。
words.example: I need to take a picture of that waterfall.

words.englishDefinition: Man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon
words.japaneseExplanation: 人工の装置で、地球あるいは月の周りの軌道を周回する。
words.example: Vladimir used a satellite phone to call for help.

words.englishDefinition: A process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物が異なる段階（特により発達した、または成熟した段階）に次第に移行する過程。
words.example: Do you believe in evolution?

words.englishDefinition: Make amendments to
words.japaneseExplanation: を改正させる。
words.example: We'll need to amend the contract so that we can pay you more.

words.englishDefinition: The extent downward or backward or inward
words.japaneseExplanation: 下方、後方、または、内部への範囲。
words.example: I have no doubt about the depth of his feelings.

words.englishDefinition: Large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity; secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat; synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood; synthesizes vitamin A; detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes
words.japaneseExplanation: 腹腔の右上部にある大きくて複雑な赤茶色の腺器官。胆汁を分泌し、タンパク質と炭水化物と脂肪の代謝に機能する。
words.example: I have a history of liver trouble.

words.englishDefinition: (economics) a market in which there are many buyers but only one seller
words.japaneseExplanation: 多くの買い手がいるのに1人の売り手しかいない市場。
words.example: You don't have a monopoly on good taste.

words.englishDefinition: The act of using
words.japaneseExplanation: 使う行為。
words.example: You should try to be more creative with your word usage.

words.englishDefinition: A visual display of information
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報のビジュアルな表示。
words.example: I want to see that chart.

words.englishDefinition: An expectation
words.japaneseExplanation: 期待。
words.example: We are in expectancy of which event could happen yet.

words.englishDefinition: Not anywhere; in or at or to no place
words.japaneseExplanation: どこでもない。いかなる場所で、そこにおいて、あるいはそのほうへでもない。
words.example: I have nowhere else to go. Can I sleep at your place?

words.englishDefinition: A government building that houses the offices of a county government
words.japaneseExplanation: 郡政府のオフィスを収容する政府の建物。
words.example: This building is not a courthouse.

words.englishDefinition: A small inlet
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さな入江。
words.example: The secret cove was a aesthete's dream.

words.englishDefinition: A platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles; provides access to ships and boats
words.japaneseExplanation: 海岸から水のある方へ突き出て作られた、柱で支えられた台。船をつけて荷を積み降ろしするための埠頭。
words.example: I saw Tom sitting on the dock.

words.englishDefinition: A government department under the direction of a minister
words.japaneseExplanation: 閣僚の指示下に置かれた政府の部門。
words.example: Sami worked for the ministry of health.

words.englishDefinition: A response of body tissues to injury or irritation; characterized by pain and swelling and redness and heat
words.japaneseExplanation: 損傷あるいは刺激に対する生体組織の反応。痛みと腫れ、赤み、熱を生じる。
words.example: I'm afraid the inflammation is going to get worse and worse.

words.englishDefinition: An animal sterol that is normally synthesized by the liver; the most abundant steroid in animal tissues
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常肝臓によって合成される動物ステロール。動物の組織で最も豊富なステロイド。
words.example: My cholesterol levels are high.

words.englishDefinition: The properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles
words.japaneseExplanation: 生殖の役割に基づいて生物を区別する特性。
words.example: Please don't assume my gender.

words.englishDefinition: Repeat a passage from
words.japaneseExplanation: 一節を再び述べる。
words.example: You can quote me on that.

words.englishDefinition: Arising from or marked by despair or loss of hope
words.japaneseExplanation: 絶望または希望の喪失から生ずる、またはこれらを特徴とする。
words.example: I know the situation is desperate.

words.japanese: 浪費的な、ぜいたくな、過度な
words.englishDefinition: Unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に感情に関して抑圧されていない。
words.example: I know that this is a little extravagant.

words.englishDefinition: Vile; despicable
words.japaneseExplanation: 不潔な。卑劣な。
words.example: You always leave your bike filthy.

words.englishDefinition: Not agitated; without losing self-possession
words.japaneseExplanation: 扇動されない。冷静さを失うことなく。
words.example: He's, without a doubt, a serene child.

words.englishDefinition: Well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force
words.japaneseExplanation: 論理、真実、または、持っている強制力に関する基礎がしっかりしている。
words.example: I think you have a very valid point here.

words.englishDefinition: Existing as an essential constituent or characteristic
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的な成分、あるいは特質として存在するさま。
words.example: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.

words.englishDefinition: And nothing more
words.japaneseExplanation: そして、多くは何もない。
words.example: You should never look down on a person merely because he is poor.

words.englishDefinition: In some unspecified way or manner; or by some unspecified means
words.japaneseExplanation: 若干の明らかでない方法または状態で。または若干の明らかでない手段で。
words.example: I somehow knew that that day would be like no other.

words.englishDefinition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
words.example: I subsequently moved to the village.

words.englishDefinition: In a deliberate unhurried manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 慎重で急がない態度で。
words.example: You didn't do that deliberately, did you?

words.englishDefinition: In a gentle manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 柔らかい態度で。
words.example: He loves to touch his wife gently.

words.englishDefinition: by way of a place or method
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所を経由することや、手段を通すことを表す。
words.example: We flew to Australia via Singapore last year.

words.englishDefinition: Side by side
words.japaneseExplanation: 並んで。
words.example: You were found alongside the road.

words.englishDefinition: Portray in words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で描写する。
words.example: I still can't work out what the artist intended to portray.

words.englishDefinition: Send away towards a designated goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 示された目標に向けて送り出す。
words.example: Did he dispatch them to you?

words.englishDefinition: A person who is the aim of an attack (especially a victim of ridicule or exploitation) by some hostile person or influence
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵意を抱いている人または影響による攻撃を目的とする人（特に嘲笑または搾取の犠牲者）。
words.example: Cats attack their prey from the side or the back.

words.englishDefinition: A nonparticipant spectator
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分は参加しないで見物する人。
words.example: A bystander captured it on video.

words.englishDefinition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: I wonder what I did to upset that creature.

words.englishDefinition: A particular society at a particular time and place
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の時間と場所における特定の社会。
words.example: How long will our civilization last?

words.englishDefinition: A social division of (usually preliterate) people
words.japaneseExplanation: （通常は文字使用以前の）人々の社会的区分。
words.example: We can't marry outside our tribe.

words.englishDefinition: Approval to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをすることの承認。
words.example: You are not to leave this room without my permission.

words.englishDefinition: A structure or object that impedes free movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由な運動を妨げる構造または物体。
words.example: I tried to move the barrier.

words.englishDefinition: Something that remunerates
words.japaneseExplanation: 報いるもの。
words.example: My wife helps me to spend my wage.

words.englishDefinition: An aircraft without a pilot that is operated by remote control
words.japaneseExplanation: リモートコントロールによって操作される操縦者のいない航空機。
words.example: I want to buy a drone, but my parents won't let me.

words.englishDefinition: Outward or visible aspect of a person or thing
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物の、外に現われた目に見える様子。
words.example: How do I feel about my appearance right now?

words.japanese: 大使館、大使および大使館員
words.englishDefinition: A diplomatic building where ambassadors live or work
words.japaneseExplanation: 大使館員が住んだり働いたりしている建物。
words.example: I work at the embassy.

words.japanese: 大使館員骨格、骸骨、骨組み
words.englishDefinition: Something reduced to its minimal form
words.japaneseExplanation: その最小の形になる何か。
words.example: Do you have the skeleton key?

words.englishDefinition: All living things (except people) that are undomesticated
words.japaneseExplanation: 飼いならされていない（人間以外の）すべての生物。
words.example: The animal later died at a wildlife hospital.

words.japanese: 潜在的な、可能性を秘めた
words.englishDefinition: Existing in possibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能性の中で存在する。
words.example: I think that there's some real potential here.

words.englishDefinition: Be false to; be dishonest with
words.japaneseExplanation: いんちきである。不正直である。
words.example: Do you think it is easy to deceive children?

words.japanese: うつ病、意気消沈、不景気
words.englishDefinition: A mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 力量不足であるという悲観的な感情と、非活動的な意気消沈が特徴の精神状態。
words.example: How did you get through your depression?

words.englishDefinition: A slender or elongated structure that supports a plant or fungus or a plant part or plant organ
words.japaneseExplanation: 植物、真菌、植物部位または植物器官を支える細長いまたは長い構造。
words.example: You can't eat the stem of a fig.

words.englishDefinition: Group of people willing to obey orders
words.japaneseExplanation: 命令に従う準備のある人の集団。
words.example: The rest of the personnel were fired without notice.

words.englishDefinition: A contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 議論のある言語行為。強い意見の相違がある論争。
words.example: We did have a controversy.

words.japanese: (人・物が)それと分かること
words.englishDefinition: The state or quality of being recognized or acknowledged
words.japaneseExplanation: 認識されるか、認められる状態または品質。
words.example: I was never given the recognition I deserved.

words.japanese: かること応募者、志願者
words.englishDefinition: A person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission
words.japaneseExplanation: 援助や雇用や許可を求める人。
words.example: The applicant didn't know how to answer the question.

words.englishDefinition: A social scientist who specializes in anthropology
words.japaneseExplanation: 人類学を専門とする社会科学者。
words.example: Mouloud Mammeri was an Algerian writer and anthropologist.

words.englishDefinition: Waste matter carried away in sewers or drains
words.japaneseExplanation: 下水や排水管で運び去られる汚物。
words.example: Sami opened the door and was hit with a smell of sewage.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of acceptance or satisfactory
words.japaneseExplanation: 受諾にふさわしい、または満足である。
words.example: We can work something out that's acceptable to both of us.

words.englishDefinition: related to the energy released by changes in atoms
words.japaneseExplanation: 原子核や、原子核の変化から生じるエネルギーに関すること。
words.example: We discussed the advantages and disadvantages of nuclear power.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with principles of right and wrong or conforming to standards of behavior and character based on those principles
words.japaneseExplanation: 善し悪しの原則、品行標準に従うことおよびそれらの原則に基づく品格に関係している。
words.example: What is the moral of the story?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 海の、または、海に関する。
words.example: Our country is rich in marine products.

words.japanese: 伝統的な、型にはまった
words.englishDefinition: In accord with or being a tradition or practice accepted from the past
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝統にしたがい伝統そのものとなりまたは過去から受け継いで受け入れられてきた形態を実行する。
words.example: The women in this film are dressed in a very conventional way.

words.englishDefinition: Exceptionally bad or displeasing
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に悪いか、または不快である。
words.example: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.

words.japanese: カンニングする、だます
words.englishDefinition: Defeat someone through trickery or deceit
words.japaneseExplanation: 詐欺または偽りを通して誰かを打ち倒す。
words.example: I couldn't even think that he'd want to cheat me.

words.englishDefinition: Deliver to an enemy by treachery
words.japaneseExplanation: 裏切りによって敵に取り込む。
words.example: I should have known they would betray me.

words.englishDefinition: Wither, as with a loss of moisture
words.japaneseExplanation: 湿気の損失と同時にしぼむ。
words.example: What is left when the flowers of time wither away?

words.englishDefinition: Prevent from being included or considered or accepted
words.japaneseExplanation: 含まれる、考慮される、または受け入れられることを防ぐ。
words.example: You should omit this word from the sentence.

words.englishDefinition: to invent false information
words.japaneseExplanation: 事実ではない話や証拠を作り上げること。
words.example: The reporter was accused of fabricating the story.

words.englishDefinition: Act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
words.japaneseExplanation: 法、規則、契約、または約束を無視して、行動する。
words.example: You are not allowed to violate the rules.

words.englishDefinition: Report or maintain
words.japaneseExplanation: 報告する、または支持する。
words.example: I allege that you are wrong, so I don't want to say a word anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Make into a whole or make part of a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体を作るか、全体の一部を作る。
words.example: She didn't integrate into our group.

words.englishDefinition: Assign too low a value to
words.japaneseExplanation: 低過ぎる値を割り当てる。
words.example: I think you underestimate us.

words.englishDefinition: Accompany or escort
words.japaneseExplanation: 伴う、または付き添う。
words.example: Please allow me to escort you.

words.englishDefinition: Make easier
words.japaneseExplanation: 易しくする。
words.example: I think I can facilitate that.

words.englishDefinition: Bring into being
words.japaneseExplanation: 生む。
words.example: You shouldn't wait for changes to come – you should initiate them yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Make known; pass on, of information
words.japaneseExplanation: 知らせる。情報を、伝える。
words.example: I will convey the information to the manager.

words.englishDefinition: Inhabit or live in; be an inhabitant of
words.japaneseExplanation: 居住するか、生きる。住民である。
words.example: Algeria was populated a long time ago.

words.englishDefinition: Make stronger
words.japaneseExplanation: より強くする。
words.example: We need to reinforce the roof.

words.englishDefinition: To gain with effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力で得る。
words.example: We must attain our goal at any cost.

words.englishDefinition: small in amount or restricted in some way
words.japaneseExplanation: 量や範囲などに限りがあること。
words.example: We have limited time, so let's start now.

words.englishDefinition: Living in or characteristic of farming or country life
words.japaneseExplanation: 農業や田園の生活を送る、またはそれらに特有の。
words.example: You will soon be used to rural life.

words.japanese: 進歩した、前進した、上級の
words.englishDefinition: Comparatively late in a course of development
words.japaneseExplanation: 発育過程が比較的遅れるさま。
words.example: Our teacher advanced the date of the exam.

words.englishDefinition: Promoting or enhancing well-being
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸福を促進するか、または高めるさま。
words.example: Do you really think doing that would be beneficial?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or produced by or being a gene
words.japaneseExplanation: 遺伝子の、遺伝子に関する、遺伝子よって生じる、または遺伝子であるさま。
words.example: There seems to be some genetic problem with this animal.

words.englishDefinition: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
words.japaneseExplanation: ［意見と行動で使用される］規範を超えた。
words.example: You only think it's radical.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by enmity or ill will
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵意か悪意を特徴とする。
words.example: I couldn't survive in such a hostile environment.

words.japanese: 健康な、元気な、ふさわしい
words.englishDefinition: Physically and mentally sound or healthy
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的に、精神的に丈夫であるか健康な。
words.example: I never felt like I fit in.

words.japanese: 長期にわたる、長期的な
words.englishDefinition: continuing for or considering a long period
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い期間にわたることや、長期的な視点を表す。
words.example: We need a long-term plan for improving the school.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the Arctic
words.japaneseExplanation: 北極の、または、北極に関する。
words.example: The arctic summer is short, but intense.

words.englishDefinition: Limited in size or scope
words.japaneseExplanation: サイズまたは範囲で制限される。
words.example: You do know I'm a minor, right?

words.englishDefinition: Involving risk or danger
words.japaneseExplanation: リスクや危険を伴うさま。
words.example: I don't think it would be risky to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 構造が複雑な。相互に連結された部品から成ること。
words.example: What seems simple to you seems complex to me.

words.englishDefinition: Involving competition or competitiveness
words.japaneseExplanation: 競争または競争力を含むさま。
words.example: I think all three of us are competitive.

words.englishDefinition: An established line of travel or access
words.japaneseExplanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
words.example: Do you have an itinerary for your business trip?

words.englishDefinition: (sometimes followed by 'with') in agreement or consistent or reliable
words.japaneseExplanation: 一致しているか、首尾一貫しているか、信頼できる。
words.example: I think that's consistent with everything I've done.

words.englishDefinition: Belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術的な開発の初期の段階に属するさま。単純さと（しばしば）未熟さによって特徴づけられる。
words.example: You think that your language is more primitive.

words.japanese: (精神的・肉体的に)十分発達した
words.englishDefinition: Fully considered and perfected
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全に考慮され、仕上げられる。
words.example: I think our son is mature enough to understand it.

words.japanese: 不慣れな、よく知らない
words.englishDefinition: Not known or well known
words.japaneseExplanation: 知られていない、またはよく知られていない。
words.example: You should look up all unfamiliar words in a dictionary.

words.japanese: 実用的でない、非現実的な
words.englishDefinition: Not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters
words.japaneseExplanation: 実用的でない。実行できないか実際問題ではない。
words.example: We all consider that your idea is impractical.

words.japanese: 変わりやすい、予測できない
words.englishDefinition: Not capable of being foretold
words.japaneseExplanation: 予言できない。
words.example: You can never be too careful in this unpredictable world.

words.japanese: 誤解させる、紛らわしい
words.englishDefinition: Designed to deceive or mislead either deliberately or inadvertently
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図的に、または何かの事情で、騙すあるいは欺くようにデザインされている。
words.example: How long have you been misleading him?

words.englishDefinition: Affording an abundant supply
words.japaneseExplanation: たくさん供給する。
words.example: We have a plentiful supply of water.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or characteristic of or located near the Mediterranean Sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 地中海の、地中海に関する、地中海に特徴的な、または、地中海の近くに位置する。
words.example: I like dark Mediterranean women.

words.englishDefinition: Not safe from attack
words.japaneseExplanation: 攻撃から安全でない。
words.example: I don't think it would be unsafe to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Completely unclothed
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全に裸の。
words.example: I caught a big fish yesterday with my bare hands.

words.englishDefinition: Pathetically lacking in force or effectiveness
words.japaneseExplanation: 痛ましく、力または有効性を欠いている。
words.example: We could get no information from her, as she is very old and feeble.

words.japanese: 実にひどい、ぞっとする
words.englishDefinition: Provoking horror
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐怖を引き起こす。
words.example: What a horrible thing war is!

words.englishDefinition: Used of locations; having beautiful natural scenery
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所に使われる。美しい自然な風景のある。
words.example: I cannot stand the loud scenic music.

words.englishDefinition: An armed adversary (especially a member of an opposing military force)
words.japaneseExplanation: 武装した相手（特に対立する軍事力の一員）。
words.example: Better a new friend than an old foe.

words.englishDefinition: Hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
words.japaneseExplanation: （努力、計画または欲求）邪魔する、妨げる。
words.example: What do you do when you feel frustrated?

words.englishDefinition: Support through subsidies
words.japaneseExplanation: 補助金による援助。
words.example: How do you subsidize those programs?

words.japanese: (2つの状態の間を)行き来する
words.englishDefinition: Go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 行ったり来たり動く。2つの状況か状態の間で行ったり来たり揺れ動く。
words.example: In this test, easy questions alternate with more difficult ones.

words.englishDefinition: Give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人、行動または理由に完全に貢献する。
words.example: I want to dedicate my life to language learning.

words.englishDefinition: Attempt by employing effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力を費やして試みる。
words.example: We wish him all success in his future endeavor.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be interested or curious
words.japaneseExplanation: 興味か好奇心を持たせる。
words.example: I am intrigued by what is happening.

words.japanese: (物価・価値などが)急上昇する
words.englishDefinition: Go or move upward
words.japaneseExplanation: 上昇する。
words.example: My flag will soar in the sky.

words.englishDefinition: Harass with persistent criticism or carping
words.japaneseExplanation: しつこい批評または文句で困らせる。
words.example: My mom used to tease me all the time about it.

words.englishDefinition: Present
words.japaneseExplanation: プレゼント。
words.example: I need to confer with my lawyer before I make a statement.

words.englishDefinition: Command against
words.japaneseExplanation: 反対する命令を出す。
words.example: I forbid you to speak with anyone about what just happened.

words.englishDefinition: Express or signify by nodding
words.japaneseExplanation: うなずくことによって、表すか、意味する。
words.example: I often nod off on the bus and miss my stop.

words.englishDefinition: Force somebody to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に何かを強制する。
words.example: I was happy to oblige.

words.englishDefinition: A longing for something better than the present situation
words.japaneseExplanation: 現状よりさらに良いことを望むこと。
words.example: I write to express my discontent.

words.englishDefinition: The act or means of getting rid of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを取り除く行為または手段。
words.example: My car, such as it is, is at your disposal.

words.englishDefinition: The act of expelling a person from their native land
words.japaneseExplanation: ある人を故国から追放する行為。
words.example: I did not want to go into exile.

words.englishDefinition: happening now or without delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 間を置かずすぐに起こること、または目前のこと。
words.example: The problem needs immediate attention from the manager.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
words.japaneseExplanation: 神性な事柄、宗教または教会に関する。
words.example: Do you consider yourself a religious person?

words.englishDefinition: Connected by kinship, common origin, or marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 親類関係、共通起源、または結婚によって関係のある。
words.example: Do you think that these two problems are related?

words.englishDefinition: That you have the financial means for
words.japaneseExplanation: に対してあなたには経済的資力を持っている。
words.example: You wouldn't happen to know of an affordable hotel nearby?

words.englishDefinition: Give to a charity or good cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 慈善団体または立派な大義名分に与える。
words.example: What do I need to do to donate my blood?

words.englishDefinition: Make smaller
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さくする。
words.example: I need medicine to lessen the pain.

words.englishDefinition: Create or produce in a mechanical way
words.japaneseExplanation: 機械的に創造するまたは生産する。
words.example: We don't manufacture anything any more.

words.englishDefinition: to travel regularly between home and work or school
words.japaneseExplanation: 自宅と職場や学校の間を定期的に移動すること。
words.example: I commute to work by train every day.

words.japanese: 誇張する、強調しすぎる
words.englishDefinition: To enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
words.japaneseExplanation: 限界または真実を越えて拡大する。
words.example: I don't want to exaggerate.

words.englishDefinition: Imagine to be the case or true or probable
words.japaneseExplanation: 本当であるか、真実であるか、可能性があるか、想像する。
words.example: I suspect Tom didn't do what you said he did.

words.englishDefinition: Gain knowledge or skills
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識または能力を獲得する。
words.example: I managed to acquire two tickets for the concert.

words.englishDefinition: Introduce anew
words.japaneseExplanation: 新たに導入する。
words.example: These wild horses were reintroduced in the area.

words.englishDefinition: Assign a new time and place for an event
words.japaneseExplanation: イベントの新しい時間と場所を指定する。
words.example: Do you want to reschedule or see another doctor?

words.englishDefinition: Adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい異なった状況に順応するまたは対応させる。
words.example: We could adapt that to so many different things.

words.englishDefinition: A source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険の源。損失か不運を被る可能性。
words.example: This is a hazard to your health.

words.englishDefinition: Functioning in a supporting capacity
words.japaneseExplanation: 収容力を補助する機能のある。
words.example: You may need a supplementary dose after six months.

words.japanese: 詮索好きな、おせっかいな
words.englishDefinition: Offensively curious or inquisitive
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快なほど好奇心が強い、または詮索好きな。
words.example: I didn't mean to be nosy.

words.englishDefinition: Lying between two extremes in time or space or state
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間、空間または状態において2つの両極端の間にあるさま。
words.example: My level in English is intermediate.

words.japanese: 共通の、全員の、普遍的な
words.englishDefinition: Of worldwide scope or applicability
words.japaneseExplanation: 世界的な範囲または適用性の。
words.example: I don't believe any other language will replace English as the universal language.

words.englishDefinition: Succeed in representing or expressing something intangible
words.japaneseExplanation: 漠然としたものを描写または表現できる。
words.example: We were never able to capture him.

words.englishDefinition: Come into existence; take on form or shape
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在に至る。形態または形状を取る。
words.example: I always try to deal with problems as soon as they arise.

words.englishDefinition: Pursue to a conclusion or bring to a successful issue
words.japaneseExplanation: 結論まで追求する、あるいは良好な結果へと導く。
words.example: I don't see why I should implement that.

words.englishDefinition: Recreate a sound, image, idea, mood, atmosphere, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 音、イメージ、アイデア、ムード、雰囲気などを再現する。
words.example: Try to reproduce the music in your mind.

words.japanese: 差し押さえる、奪い取る
words.englishDefinition: Take temporary possession of as a security, by legal authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 法的権限により、担保として一時的に所有する。
words.example: You have to seize the opportunity with both hands.

words.englishDefinition: Be in control
words.japaneseExplanation: 管理している。
words.example: The US wants to dominate the whole world.

words.englishDefinition: Make more complicated
words.japaneseExplanation: より複雑にする。
words.example: Please don't make things more complicated than they already are.

words.englishDefinition: to look over something quickly to find information
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な情報を探すために全体をざっと見ること。
words.example: I scanned the timetable to find the next train.

words.englishDefinition: Discuss the terms of an arrangement
words.japaneseExplanation: 調整に関する条件を論議する。
words.example: I would like to negotiate with that party.

words.englishDefinition: Clarify by giving an example of
words.japaneseExplanation: の例を示すことにより明確にする。
words.example: I will give you a good example to illustrate what I mean.

words.englishDefinition: An organization created for business ventures
words.japaneseExplanation: ビジネス・ベンチャーのために創設された組織。
words.example: His enterprise started out of his garage.

words.englishDefinition: The act of persecuting (especially on the basis of race or religion)
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に人種や宗教に基づいて）虐げる行為。
words.example: I have developed a persecution complex. It seems to me that I am being followed.

words.englishDefinition: The act of issuing printed materials
words.japaneseExplanation: 印刷物を発行する行為。
words.example: We are expecting the publication of his book.

words.englishDefinition: A difficult problem
words.japaneseExplanation: 難しい問題。
words.example: I tried to solve the riddle, but I couldn't.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being clean and conducive to health
words.japaneseExplanation: 清潔で健康につながる状態。
words.example: Sanitation is a very important part of public health.

words.englishDefinition: An artifact that is one of the individual parts of which a composite entity is made up; especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system
words.japaneseExplanation: 合成実体が作られる個々の部品の1つである人工物。特にシステムから切り離したり付加したりできる部分。
words.example: What is an essential component of making money?

words.englishDefinition: an amount or number that is officially allowed or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 割り当てられた量や、達成するよう定められた数。
words.example: The team reached its sales quota for the month.

words.japanese: (国・地方の特徴を出した)料理
words.englishDefinition: The practice or manner of preparing food or the food so prepared
words.japaneseExplanation: 料理を準備するような食料の習慣、方法、あるいは準備。
words.example: Do you enjoy the cuisine of your country?

words.englishDefinition: A roundabout road (especially one that is used temporarily while a main route is blocked)
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に主ルートが封鎖されている間一時的に用いられる）迂回路。
words.example: I think I will take a detour to return home.

words.englishDefinition: One of several resident of a dwelling (especially someone confined to a prison or hospital)
words.japaneseExplanation: 居住施設で暮らす数人のうちの一人（特に刑務所あるいは病院に監禁された人）。
words.example: Don't take your eyes off that inmate.

words.englishDefinition: Temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work
words.japaneseExplanation: 激しい肉体的、精神的活動の結果生じる、一時的な力と活力の損失。
words.example: I feel like a heavy fatigue is falling on me.

words.englishDefinition: A state of commotion and noise and confusion
words.japaneseExplanation: 騒動、雑音、および混乱のある状態。
words.example: The whole town was in an uproar.

words.englishDefinition: An event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental
words.japaneseExplanation: 本当に偶然だったが、準備されていたかもしれない出来事。
words.example: I wonder if it really was a coincidence.

words.englishDefinition: Communication by the exchange of letters
words.japaneseExplanation: 手紙のやりとりによるコミュニケーション。
words.example: I have some correspondence to deal with.

words.englishDefinition: A choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative
words.japaneseExplanation: 各選択肢に賛成している人々の数を数えることによってなされる選択。
words.example: Do you know who's on the ballot?

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的にも知的にも、適度に、または十分能力に恵まれているという特質。
words.example: There's no doubt about your competence.

words.englishDefinition: Produce (energy)
words.japaneseExplanation: （エネルギーを）生産する。
words.example: Algeria should generate more solar power.

words.englishDefinition: Give surety or assume responsibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 確証するまたは責任を引き受ける。
words.example: I can guarantee you that Sami is no longer a problem.

words.englishDefinition: Throw away as refuse
words.japaneseExplanation: ゴミとして捨てる。
words.example: I think that Tom is going to dump Mary.

words.englishDefinition: Bring up to date; supply with recent information
words.japaneseExplanation: 最新の状態にする。最近の情報を供給する。
words.example: Do you need to update the address for the apartment?

words.englishDefinition: Arrange or order by classes or categories
words.japaneseExplanation: クラスまたはカテゴリーによって配置するまたは整える。
words.example: Please classify these books by subject.

words.englishDefinition: Accept as legally binding and valid
words.japaneseExplanation: 法的に拘束力があり有効であると認める。
words.example: You need to acknowledge this fact.

words.englishDefinition: Ensure observance of laws and rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律と規則の遵守を確実にする。
words.example: How are they going to enforce that law?

words.englishDefinition: Reestablish on a new, usually improved, basis or make new or like new
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しくするまたは新しいかのように、または新しいまたは通常改善された基礎のもとに再生する。
words.example: I still need to renew my passport.

words.englishDefinition: to choose not to notice or act on a mistake
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違いなどに気づいても問題にせず、大目に見ること。
words.example: The teacher agreed to overlook my mistake this time.

words.englishDefinition: Evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質、能力、程度または重要さを見極める、または見積もる。
words.example: I need to evaluate my behavior.

words.englishDefinition: Perform an act, usually with a negative connotation
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常否定的な意味合いで、行為を行う。
words.example: You don't need to commit right now.

words.englishDefinition: A contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 議論のある言語行為。強い意見の相違がある論争。
words.example: I wouldn't get involved in their argument.

words.englishDefinition: An anthropologist who studies prehistoric people and their culture
words.japaneseExplanation: 有史前の人々とその文化を研究する人類学者。
words.example: You sound like you don't want to be an archaeologist.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being held in high esteem and honor
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に尊敬され称えられていること。
words.example: You have something of a reputation.

words.englishDefinition: Tenaciously unwilling or marked by tenacious unwillingness to yield
words.japaneseExplanation: 執拗に嫌がる、あるいは放棄するために執拗に嫌がることにより特徴付けられる。
words.example: I have never come across such a stubborn person.

words.englishDefinition: Come together
words.japaneseExplanation: 団結する。
words.example: What kind of animals are you most afraid to encounter?

words.englishDefinition: Deprive of freedom; take into confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由を奪う。閉じ込める。
words.example: We should confine the discussion to the question at issue.

words.englishDefinition: Transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝達の媒体として伝えるかあるいは用いられる。
words.example: We have to transmit our culture to the next generation.

words.englishDefinition: Administer or bestow, as in small portions
words.japaneseExplanation: 管理するか、与える、少量のように。
words.example: Ziri entered the cabin and found drugs and things used to administer them.

words.englishDefinition: Lessen pain or discomfort; alleviate
words.japaneseExplanation: 痛みまたは不快症状を減少させる。軽減する。
words.example: I need some medicine to ease the pain.

words.englishDefinition: Take up or begin anew
words.japaneseExplanation: 再開するまたは新しく始める。
words.example: I wanted to resume my normal life.

words.englishDefinition: Follow in or as if in pursuit
words.japaneseExplanation: を追いかける、あるいは、求めるかのような。
words.example: You need to pursue your dream.

words.japanese: 虫歯になる、腐る、衰退する
words.englishDefinition: Undergo decay or decomposition
words.japaneseExplanation: 腐敗または分解を経る。
words.example: We have to pick those apples right now, otherwise they'll decay.

words.englishDefinition: Decrease in size, range, or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、範囲、または程度を縮小する。
words.example: Fruit that has been left for a long time will shrink.

words.englishDefinition: Be fond of; be attached to
words.japaneseExplanation: 好き。付随される。
words.example: I want to cherish the time that I spend together with my family.

words.englishDefinition: Begin with vigor
words.japaneseExplanation: 元気よく始める。
words.example: Our school will launch a newspaper.

words.japanese: 収容できる、宿泊させる
words.englishDefinition: Provide with something desired or needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 希望するもの、あるいは必要なものを提供する。
words.example: You must accommodate your plans to mine.

words.englishDefinition: Resist or confront with resistance
words.japaneseExplanation: 抵抗するか、抵抗に立ち向かう。
words.example: I think I'll be able to withstand that.

words.englishDefinition: Stop from happening or developing
words.japaneseExplanation: 発生または発達を止める。
words.example: The train was brought to a sudden halt.

words.englishDefinition: Tolerant or lenient
words.japaneseExplanation: 許容性があり、寛大な。
words.example: Can you be lenient on me this time?

words.englishDefinition: A violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
words.japaneseExplanation: 化学や核反応によるエネルギーの激しい放出。
words.example: I want to know what caused the explosion.

words.englishDefinition: A severe shortage of food (as through crop failure) resulting in violent hunger and starvation and death
words.japaneseExplanation: 激しい飢えと飢餓と死をもたらす（収穫不作を通した）厳しい食糧難。
words.example: Can you share food with others in the face of famine?

words.englishDefinition: The act of taking something that is offered
words.japaneseExplanation: 提供されたものを取る行為。
words.example: I want to read to you my acceptance speech.

words.englishDefinition: A small part or portion that remains after the main part no longer exists
words.japaneseExplanation: 主要部分がなくなった後に残った小さな部分または一部。
words.example: I didn't know what to do with the leftover food.

words.englishDefinition: Fearful expectation or anticipation
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れの混じった予感または予期。
words.example: Hope is born from the apprehension of tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Something or someone that has suffered ruin or dilapidation
words.japaneseExplanation: 崩壊し荒廃しているもの、あるいは人。
words.example: Our house is a wreck.

words.englishDefinition: The position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape
words.japaneseExplanation: ある特殊な土地で際立って、有名な物の位置。
words.example: Do you see a landmark?

words.englishDefinition: A person who inhabits a particular place
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の場所に居住する人。
words.example: Someone who lives in the city is called a city dweller.

words.englishDefinition: The pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces
words.japaneseExplanation: 点、線、曲線、および面の純粋数学。
words.example: The geometry students say that geometry is difficult.

words.englishDefinition: Ready for emergency use
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊急使用に備える。
words.example: Sami chose to wait in a standby list.

words.englishDefinition: Noticeable heterogeneity
words.japaneseExplanation: 目立つ異種性。
words.example: I can't tell if we're seeing more diversity or less.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being near to the true value
words.japaneseExplanation: 真の価値へ近い性質。
words.example: I doubt the accuracy of the report.

words.englishDefinition: A faucet for drawing water from a pipe or cask
words.japaneseExplanation: パイプか樽からの引水のための水栓。
words.example: My tap broke and now I don't have any water.

words.englishDefinition: Rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln; used as a building or paving material
words.japaneseExplanation: 太陽の光または窯で焼かれた粘土の矩形ブロック。建築、舗装などに使われる。
words.example: I feel like I'm talking to a brick wall.

words.englishDefinition: An indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf
words.japaneseExplanation: 入り江より大きい、しかし、湾より小さい海岸線のくぼみ。
words.example: You have only to push the button to open the bay window.

words.englishDefinition: The remains (or an impression) of a plant or animal that existed in a past geological age and that has been excavated from the soil
words.japaneseExplanation: 昔の地質時代に存在し、土から発掘された、植物または動物の遺体（または痕跡）。
words.example: I suspect this fossil would be around a hundred grand.

words.englishDefinition: The relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に社会における人や物事の相対的な位置、立場。
words.example: Do you know his status in the company?

words.englishDefinition: The opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較された物事の対立点または相違点。
words.example: What a contrast between them!

words.englishDefinition: A place where work is done
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事がなされる場所。
words.example: I was told not to eat in the workplace.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being the same in quantity or measure or value or status
words.japaneseExplanation: 量、寸法、価値、あるいは地位が同じである性質。
words.example: There is no equality in nature.

words.englishDefinition: An associate that one works with
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に仕事をする仲間。
words.example: My colleague filled in for me while I was sick.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: ニーズの実現や努力や目的の促進に寄与する活動。
words.example: You won't be able to do that without some assistance.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性よりむしろ道楽を目的としたもの。
words.example: I told her that we couldn't afford such a luxury.

words.englishDefinition: A sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
words.japaneseExplanation: 突然の激しい自然発生（通常いくつかの好ましくない状態の）。
words.example: We don't need another disease outbreak in the village.

words.englishDefinition: A body serving in an administrative capacity
words.japaneseExplanation: 運営機関として働く団体。
words.example: What will the city council do about it?

words.englishDefinition: Ceramic ware made from clay and baked in a kiln
words.japaneseExplanation: 粘土で作られ窯で焼かれる陶磁器。
words.example: This pottery is made by a local artist.

words.englishDefinition: A duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたが果たすよう命じられる義務（特に軍隊で）。
words.example: I can't help you. Do your assignment yourself.

words.englishDefinition: (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの小さな破片のこと。
words.example: We are a particle of the universe.

words.englishDefinition: Energy that is radiated or transmitted in the form of rays or waves or particles
words.japaneseExplanation: 光線、波動、または粒子の形で放射、あるいは伝達されるエネルギー。
words.example: We don't want any radiation around.

words.englishDefinition: Resistant to change
words.japaneseExplanation: 改革に抵抗する。
words.example: We often hear it said that Japanese people are conservative.

words.englishDefinition: Change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
words.japaneseExplanation: 調子外観が、または自然に、変化するあるいは変わる。
words.example: What can I do to transform the situation?

words.englishDefinition: Lift and reset in another soil or situation
words.japaneseExplanation: 掘り出して、他の土または位置に置き直す。
words.example: You need a heart transplant.

words.englishDefinition: Be sold at the retail level
words.japaneseExplanation: 小売りのレベルで売られる。
words.example: Sami worked retail pretty much his entire life.

words.englishDefinition: Forsake, leave behind
words.japaneseExplanation: 見放す、置き去りにする。
words.example: We had to abandon the car.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who develops real estate (especially someone who prepares a site for residential or commercial use)
words.japaneseExplanation: 不動産を開発する誰か（特に住宅、あるいは商業使用のサイトを準備する誰か）。
words.example: I want to be a developer.

words.englishDefinition: Free movement or passage (as of cytoplasm within a cell or sap through a plant)
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に、細胞の中の細胞質、または、植物の中を通る樹液のような）自由な動きまたは移動。
words.example: What is the circulation of this magazine?

words.englishDefinition: A device or control that is very useful for a particular job
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の仕事に大変役に立つ装置あるいは制御機器。
words.example: What kitchen appliance do you use every day?

words.englishDefinition: a close connection between people
words.japaneseExplanation: 人と人を結びつける強いつながり。この語には債券の意味もある。
words.example: Working together created a strong bond between us.

words.japanese: 周回すること、回路、巡回
words.englishDefinition: An electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow
words.japaneseExplanation: 電流が流れる経路となる電気装置。
words.example: Ziri looked around for a circuit box, but he couldn't find any.

words.englishDefinition: A creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation
words.japaneseExplanation: 研究と実験からもたらされる（新しい装置や手順の）創造。
words.example: They support innovation at every turn.

words.englishDefinition: A very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に年の若く（生後1年までの）、まだ歩いたり話したりできない子供。
words.example: How does an infant learn to walk?

words.englishDefinition: The act of transacting within or between groups (as carrying on commercial activities)
words.japaneseExplanation: （商業活動を営むときなどに）グループ内、もしくはグループ間で取引する行為。
words.example: I have to close this transaction within a week.

words.englishDefinition: A widely known person
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く知られている人。
words.example: I want to be a celebrity.

words.englishDefinition: A thorough physical examination; includes a variety of tests depending on the age and sex and health of the person
words.japaneseExplanation: 徹底的な身体検査。各人の年齢、性、健康状態に応じた様々なテストを含む。
words.example: I had a checkup the week before last.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or advocating or based upon the principles of democracy or social equality
words.japaneseExplanation: 民主主義の原理または社会的平等に特徴づけられる、の支持、あるいは、に基づく。
words.example: Do you really believe that you live in a democratic country?

words.englishDefinition: Showing lack of skill or aptitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術または適性の欠如を示すさま。
words.example: I may be clumsy, but I'm not as clumsy as you.

words.englishDefinition: Fraught with danger
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険を伴うさま。
words.example: You are in a perilous state, oh shepherd.

words.englishDefinition: Contrary to your interests or welfare
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたの利益または幸福とは反対である。
words.example: Our plane was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.

words.englishDefinition: Never-ceasing
words.japaneseExplanation: 決して終わらないさま。
words.example: I have a persistent pain here.

words.englishDefinition: Greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
words.japaneseExplanation: 分別または穏健さの領域をひどく超えた。
words.example: I think that this is pretty outrageous.

words.englishDefinition: Denying or questioning the tenets of especially a religion
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に宗教の教義を否定するか、疑うさま。
words.example: I admit that I was skeptical at first.

words.englishDefinition: In accordance with recognized or accepted standards or principles
words.japaneseExplanation: 認められたか認められた標準または原則に従って。
words.example: I think that's a legitimate question.

words.japanese: 不正な、道徳的に堕落した
words.englishDefinition: Lacking in integrity
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全性が不足するさま。
words.example: There have always been corrupt people in government.

words.englishDefinition: Of the nature of or undergoing an experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 実験の本質の、または、実験を経た。
words.example: Our experimental results left something to be desired.

words.englishDefinition: Not suitable or right or appropriate
words.japaneseExplanation: 適当でない、正しくない、または、適切でない。
words.example: He was late to realize that what he did was improper.

words.japanese: 自然発生的な、自発的な
words.englishDefinition: Happening or arising without apparent external cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 見た目の外因なしで起こるか、生じるさま。
words.example: I wish I could be more spontaneous.

words.englishDefinition: Not conditional
words.japaneseExplanation: 条件付きでない。
words.example: Do you believe in unconditional love?

words.englishDefinition: Not genuine; imitating something superior
words.japaneseExplanation: 本物でない。優れた何かを模倣すること。
words.example: Lots of things other than money can be counterfeit.

words.englishDefinition: feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分や周囲が回るように感じ、めまいがする状態。
words.example: I felt dizzy after spinning around too fast.

words.japanese: 持続できる、維持できる
words.englishDefinition: Capable of being sustained
words.japaneseExplanation: 支えられることができる。
words.example: We all want sustainable world peace.

words.englishDefinition: Status established in order of importance or urgency
words.japaneseExplanation: 重要性もしくは緊急性の順番に基づいて確立された地位。
words.example: I don't think Yanni's son was a priority to him.

words.englishDefinition: Everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something
words.japaneseExplanation: コレクションに含まれ、そして保持されるかまたは含まれるすべて。
words.example: What is the content of this book?

words.englishDefinition: The place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)
words.japaneseExplanation: 終わり（レースまたは旅行現在）に指定される場所。
words.example: I will call you when I arrive at my destination.

words.englishDefinition: Excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉱石と鉱物が抽出される土壌の発掘。
words.example: My father used to work in a mine.

words.englishDefinition: Any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 暴行、事故または骨折などによって引き起こされる体への肉体的ダメージ。
words.example: How did you get this injury on your foot?

words.englishDefinition: Players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
words.japaneseExplanation: プレーヤーは、チャンスを買い（または与えられ）、賞は、くじを引いて分配される。
words.example: What would you buy if you won the lottery?

words.englishDefinition: A prominent attribute or aspect of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの顕著な面。
words.example: Please add this feature request.

words.englishDefinition: Productive work (especially physical work done for wages)
words.japaneseExplanation: 生産的な仕事（特に賃金を得るためにする肉体的な仕事）。
words.example: How much did you pay for the labor on this?

words.englishDefinition: A polygenic disease characterized by abnormally high glucose levels in the blood; any of several metabolic disorders marked by excessive urination and persistent thirst
words.japaneseExplanation: 血中の血糖値が異常に高いことを特徴とする多因生成の病気。多尿と持続的な渇きが特徴の代謝異常の総称。
words.example: They all got their diabetes from their parents.

words.englishDefinition: Electric lamp consisting of a transparent or translucent glass housing containing a wire filament (usually tungsten) that emits light when heated by electricity
words.japaneseExplanation: 電気で熱せられると光を発するワイヤフィラメント（通常タングステン）を含む透明、半透明のガラスの収納器で成る電球。
words.example: Can you change the kitchen light bulb before you leave?

words.englishDefinition: A summary of your academic and work history
words.japaneseExplanation: 学歴と職歴の要約。
words.example: I don't worry so much about my resume.

words.englishDefinition: Water soaked soil; soft wet earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 水がしみた土。柔らかい湿った地面。
words.example: Can you please clean the mud off your shoes?

words.englishDefinition: The science of mental life
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神生活の科学。
words.example: My mother is a psychology teacher.

words.englishDefinition: A business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
words.japaneseExplanation: ある国でその会社定款が承認されている企業。
words.example: Damiano became the new face of the corporation.

words.japanese: 理解する、しっかりと握る
words.englishDefinition: Get the meaning of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 意味をとらえる。
words.example: You seem to have a really good grasp on this.

words.englishDefinition: The way in which someone or something is composed
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物が構成される方法。
words.example: I wash my face every evening to get my makeup off.

words.japanese: (調査・アンケートなど)回答者
words.englishDefinition: Someone who responds
words.japaneseExplanation: 応答する人。
words.example: The first respondent failed to fill out the entire questionnaire.

words.englishDefinition: a person's health, happiness, and comfort
words.japaneseExplanation: 心と体の健康や、安心して暮らせる状態。
words.example: Regular exercise can improve your health and well-being.

words.englishDefinition: An imperfection in an object or machine
words.japaneseExplanation: 物または機械の欠陥。
words.example: You have only one flaw.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be tense and uneasy or nervous or anxious
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊張や心配あるいは神経質であるか気がかりを引き起こす。
words.example: Take care not to strain your eyes.

words.englishDefinition: The act of competing as for profit or a prize
words.japaneseExplanation: 利益や賞を目的として競う行為。
words.example: How did your rivalry begin?

words.japanese: 一般的に知れ渡ること
words.englishDefinition: A message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution
words.japaneseExplanation: いくつかの製品、理念、アイデア、人、設定に出されるメッセージ。
words.example: I don’t regret it. To tell you the truth, this has given me some publicity.

words.englishDefinition: Permission to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをする許可。
words.example: I wouldn't do that without their consent.

words.englishDefinition: Being abnormally tolerant to and dependent on something that is psychologically or physically habit-forming (especially alcohol or narcotic drugs)
words.japaneseExplanation: 心理的、肉体的に習慣性のあるものに対する依存症（特にアルコールや麻薬など）。
words.example: Mark needs to accept that this is an addiction.

words.englishDefinition: The body of people in a learned occupation
words.japaneseExplanation: 学問的職業に就く人々の団体。
words.example: I picked this profession because I liked it.

words.englishDefinition: Personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective)
words.japaneseExplanation: 犠牲となった人（例えば、降伏したり目的の遂行のために亡くなるなど）。
words.example: What is the meaning of fighting without a sacrifice?

words.englishDefinition: The courage to carry on
words.japaneseExplanation: 続行する勇気。
words.example: I haven't got the nerve to ask you for a loan.

words.englishDefinition: A statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn
words.japaneseExplanation: 真であると想定され、そこから結論が導かれる言明。
words.example: We appreciate your asking a question rather than making an assumption.

words.englishDefinition: Discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation
words.japaneseExplanation: 言語の単位を取り囲み、解釈の決定を助ける会話。
words.example: Do you understand the context of what I'm saying?

words.englishDefinition: Look down on with disdain
words.japaneseExplanation: 軽蔑で見下ろす。
words.example: We should not despise a man because he is poor.

words.englishDefinition: Serving as an essential component
words.japaneseExplanation: 不可欠な要素として働く。
words.example: I want to present you with a fundamental question.

words.englishDefinition: Having a strong desire for success or achievement
words.japaneseExplanation: 成功または達成のための強い欲求を持っているさま。
words.example: I used to be young and ambitious, just like you.

words.englishDefinition: Capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚によって感知されることができる。抽象的でないまたは非実在的でない。
words.example: What do you intend to do with the concrete?

words.englishDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
words.example: I think it's cruel to keep a cat inside.

words.englishDefinition: Of low or inferior quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 低いか劣った品質の。
words.example: I think this one is inferior to that in quality.

words.englishDefinition: More than enough in size or scope or capacity
words.japaneseExplanation: サイズ、範囲または容量における十二分。
words.example: We have ample time to catch our train.

words.englishDefinition: Not exact
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確でない。
words.example: I believe this is inaccurate.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task
words.japaneseExplanation: 課題を満たすための必要条件の品質、または供給源に欠いた。
words.example: I just feel a little inadequate.

words.englishDefinition: Not suitable for a particular occasion etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の出来事などにふさわしくない。
words.example: I think that what you did was inappropriate.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 信用または保証が足りない、または足りないことを示している。
words.example: I can't take that last step. It's too difficult, too uncertain.

words.englishDefinition: Not clearly understood or expressed
words.japaneseExplanation: 明確に理解されないか、または表現されない。
words.example: Do you have a vague idea about what's in the box?

words.englishDefinition: Pull back or move away or backward
words.japaneseExplanation: 引っ込む、引き下がるまたは後退する。
words.example: Fyodor arrived just as the sun began to retreat.

words.englishDefinition: Make revolution
words.japaneseExplanation: 革命を起こす。
words.example: The cats are in open revolt.

words.japanese: (人の注意・非難など)そらす
words.englishDefinition: Prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening
words.japaneseExplanation: 発生を防ぐ。起こらないようにする。
words.example: Yanni wanted to deflect attention.

words.englishDefinition: Assign to a lower position; reduce in rank
words.japaneseExplanation: より低い位置へ割り当てる。ランクの中で縮小する。
words.example: Why did my coach demote me?

words.englishDefinition: A system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 生物の群集の物理的環境の相互作用によって形成された体系。
words.example: Snakes are an extremely important part of our ecosystem.

words.englishDefinition: Act of raising in rank or position
words.japaneseExplanation: 階級や地位を上げる行為。
words.example: I will do whatever it takes to get that promotion.

words.englishDefinition: A method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)
words.japaneseExplanation: あるグループの人の事象を管理する、または関わる方法（特にグループの事業において）。
words.example: We hope that the administration doesn't make the same mistake again.

words.englishDefinition: An expression of grievance or resentment
words.japaneseExplanation: 文句あるいは苦情を表現すること。
words.example: Do you have a complaint to make?

words.englishDefinition: The state of owing something (especially money)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（特に金銭）を借りている状態。
words.example: I went to pay off my debt at the bank.

words.englishDefinition: Anything indispensable
words.japaneseExplanation: 不可欠な何でも。
words.example: You enter, with the key word being a requirement.

words.englishDefinition: The force of workers available
words.japaneseExplanation: 利用できる労働者の力。
words.example: Algeria has a large and young workforce.

words.englishDefinition: A predisposition in favor of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを支持する傾向。
words.example: I don't know your preference, so please help yourself.

words.englishDefinition: An exile who flees for safety
words.japaneseExplanation: 安全のために逃げた亡命者。
words.example: I was born in a refugee camp.

words.englishDefinition: A person who inhabits a particular place
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の場所に居住する人。
words.example: I am an inhabitant of Earth.

words.englishDefinition: A pledged contribution
words.japaneseExplanation: 誓約された寄付。
words.example: I have a subscription to Time.

words.englishDefinition: A person who receives something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを受け取る人。
words.example: Do you know the recipient?

words.englishDefinition: A qualitative change
words.japaneseExplanation: 質的変化。
words.example: I thought your shift ended a couple of hours ago.

words.englishDefinition: A craft designed for water transportation
words.japaneseExplanation: 水上運輸のための船。
words.example: I see a small vessel.

words.englishDefinition: Make sense of; assign a meaning to
words.japaneseExplanation: その意味を理解する。意味を当てる。
words.example: How did you interpret what I said?

words.englishDefinition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
words.japaneseExplanation: 顕著な特徴または固定された時点または出来事で認められる時代。
words.example: I feel like I was born in the wrong era.

words.englishDefinition: A distinguishing feature of your personal nature
words.japaneseExplanation: その人個人の性質の際立った特徴。
words.example: I like this trait of his personality.

words.englishDefinition: A negotiable certificate that can be detached and redeemed as needed
words.japaneseExplanation: はずすことができ、必要なときに商品に換えることができる換金できる証券。
words.example: Do you have a voucher?

words.englishDefinition: Any of the various versions in the development of a written work
words.japaneseExplanation: 記述された書面の発達におけるさまざまなバージョンの総称。
words.example: I managed to write a draft in English with 150 words.

words.englishDefinition: A strong flame that burns brightly
words.japaneseExplanation: 明るく燃える強い炎。
words.example: It took an hour and a half to control the blaze.

words.englishDefinition: The metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在使われている金属ないしは紙でできた交換媒介物。
