words.example: What is the currency of your country?

words.englishDefinition: A rationalized mental attitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 合理化された心構え。
words.example: I don't really have a stance on this.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure
words.japaneseExplanation: 室温と室圧で流動性を有する物質。
words.example: You want to have a lot of fluid in your system before giving blood.

words.englishDefinition: Coming into conflict with
words.japaneseExplanation: 争いになること。
words.example: We can't dispute this fact.

words.englishDefinition: A person or thing having the same function or characteristics as another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のものと同じ機能、性質を持った人あるいは物。
words.example: I tried to close the discussions at noon, but my counterpart would not stop talking.

words.englishDefinition: A way of conceiving something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものを理解する方法。
words.example: Our perception of beauty has changed over time.

words.englishDefinition: A state of being confined (usually for a short time)
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁されていること（通常、短期間）。
words.example: We soon figured out that he had the wrong person in custody.

words.englishDefinition: The scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事または活動の現場（特に会議の場所）。
words.example: Do you remember that music venue that used to be there?

words.englishDefinition: Fearful expectation or anticipation
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れの混じった予感または予期。
words.example: My feelings of dread of being watched were strong.

words.englishDefinition: Compel to behave in a certain way
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の行動をするよう強制する。
words.example: I don't like to impose on my friends.

words.englishDefinition: Call in an official matter, such as to attend court
words.japaneseExplanation: 公的な問題で呼び出す、例えば法廷に出席するために。
words.example: We have to summon a spirit.

words.englishDefinition: Force to leave or move out
words.japaneseExplanation: 退去させられる、またはいなくなる。
words.example: He can expel me from here.

words.englishDefinition: to make up for a fault or failure
words.japaneseExplanation: 失敗や欠点を、よい行動などによって埋め合わせること。
words.example: He hoped to redeem himself by doing better next time.

words.englishDefinition: Include or contain; have as a component
words.japaneseExplanation: 包含するか、含む。構成要素として持つ。
words.example: How many days comprise a leap year?

words.japanese: 流布している、打ち勝つ
words.englishDefinition: Be larger in number, quantity, power, status or importance
words.japaneseExplanation: 数、量、力、地位または重要性をより大きくする。
words.example: I tried to prevail on her to change his mind.

words.japanese: 勝つ取り出す、追い出す
words.englishDefinition: Put out or expel from a place
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所から出るまたは追い出す。
words.example: The computer told Lukas to eject.

words.englishDefinition: Falsify knowingly
words.japaneseExplanation: 故意に偽造する。
words.example: I will falsify a permit so that I can go camping there this weekend.

words.englishDefinition: Hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か達成を妨げるか、または防ぐ。
words.example: Do not obstruct the emergency exit with your big boxes.

words.englishDefinition: Show in, or as in, a picture
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵などに示す。
words.example: It is impossible to depict that by means of words.

words.englishDefinition: Move or jerk quickly and involuntarily up and down or sideways
words.japaneseExplanation: 速く、不意に上下し、左右に動くまたは揺れ動く。
words.example: We will tremble with fear.

words.englishDefinition: Confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常プレッシャーの中で処罰されるまたは批難されるべき行為に対して自白する。
words.example: I must confess I haven't read it yet.

words.englishDefinition: Look at with fixed eyes
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された視線で見る。
words.example: We stopped to stare at them.

words.englishDefinition: Feel physical pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的な痛みを感じる。
words.example: I ache for your pain.

words.englishDefinition: Manifest or bring back
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきり表すまたは思い出す。
words.example: I need a little time to reflect upon it.

words.englishDefinition: Insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
words.japaneseExplanation: 意見と権利が認められるよう主張する。
words.example: I know how to assert myself.

words.englishDefinition: A component of a mixture or compound
words.japaneseExplanation: 混合物か化合物のコンポーネント。
words.example: I wonder what the secret ingredient is.

words.englishDefinition: Meeting the proper standards and requirements and training for an office or position or task
words.japaneseExplanation: 適切な基準と要件を満たすこと、そして、任務、地位または職務のための訓練をするさま。
words.example: I didn't get the job, even though I was qualified.

words.englishDefinition: Distributed over a considerable extent
words.japaneseExplanation: かなりの範囲へ分布される。
words.example: How widespread is this problem?

words.japanese: 代替の、どちらか一方の
words.englishDefinition: Serving or used in place of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の物の代わりとして役立つ、または使用される。
words.example: Can you give me another alternative?

words.englishDefinition: Unpleasantly stern
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快なほどに堅い。
words.example: I couldn't sleep well because of a harsh dream.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、範囲、量、力、または程度が異常に大きい。
words.example: The work took an enormous amount of time to finish.

words.englishDefinition: (sometimes followed by 'to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か特別な、特殊なまたは固有の物によって特徴づけられるまたはそれらに関連させる。
words.example: I must ask you to be more specific.

words.englishDefinition: Contrived by art rather than nature
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然ではなくむしろ人為的に考案された。
words.example: I don't like artificial flowers.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
words.japaneseExplanation: 毒素または毒物の、毒素または毒物に関する、あるいは、毒素または毒物に引き起こされる。
words.example: How do you get over a toxic job?

words.japanese: 融通のきく、柔軟性のある
words.englishDefinition: Capable of being changed
words.japaneseExplanation: 変わることができる。
words.example: My body isn't as flexible as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Up to the immediate present; most recent or most up-to-date
words.japaneseExplanation: まさにこの現在まで。最近で最新の。
words.example: Do you want to stay up to date with all the latest news?

words.englishDefinition: Referring to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one or ones of several)
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及された2つのものまたは人の最初のもの（あるいは、いくつかのうちの最初のひとつ）を参照する。
words.example: I went to the university only to see my former French teacher again.

words.japanese: 有能な、能力(才能)がある
words.englishDefinition: Have the skills and qualifications to do things well
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事をよく行う技術および資格を持っている。
words.example: Do you believe that people are capable of change?

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with actual use or practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 実際の使用または実行に関心を持つ。
words.example: I have no practical reason for learning this language.

words.englishDefinition: Clear or deep perception of a situation
words.japaneseExplanation: ある状況を深く、明解に見抜く力。
words.example: Please give us some insight.

words.englishDefinition: A positive motivational influence
words.japaneseExplanation: 積極的な動機づけの効果をもたらすもの。
words.example: We should offer children free movie tickets as an incentive to attend school.

words.englishDefinition: Strong feelings of dislike
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い嫌悪の感情。
words.example: I always look at this picture with disgust.

words.englishDefinition: The territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation
words.japaneseExplanation: 国家の中で、議会選出権を持った行政上の区域。
words.example: We came here from the province where we both grew up.

words.englishDefinition: A person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea
words.japaneseExplanation: 主義や主張を擁護する人。
words.example: James was unusual for a proponent of the old ways.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to commercialism
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業主義に関する、またはそれの。
words.example: I went to a commercial high school.

words.englishDefinition: Beyond normal limits
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の限界を超えて。
words.example: Is it excessive to say that an excessive sentence is excessive?

words.englishDefinition: Susceptible to attack
words.japaneseExplanation: 攻撃されやすい。
words.example: We are never as vulnerable as when we love.

words.japanese: 保護する、守ろうとする
words.englishDefinition: Intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind
words.japaneseExplanation: ある種の保護を意図する、あるいは、を提供するために構成される。
words.example: My dog is very protective.

words.englishDefinition: Free from fear or doubt; easy in mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れまたは疑いがない。安心している。
words.example: I feel secure with him.

words.englishDefinition: Easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚によって容易に知覚される、または心によって理解される。
words.example: I think that it's very obvious what's going to happen.

words.englishDefinition: Unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom
words.japaneseExplanation: いつもの習慣には反して何かをする気が起きない。
words.example: You seem to be reluctant to do that for us.

words.japanese: 確信して、自信に満ちた
words.englishDefinition: Persuaded of; very sure
words.japaneseExplanation: 確信して。非常に確かな。
words.example: I am confident he will keep his promise.

words.englishDefinition: Having the capacity for thought and reason especially to a high degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に高度に思考と理性の能力を持つ。
words.example: How common is intelligent life in the universe?

words.japanese: 不毛の、作物ができない
words.englishDefinition: Providing no shelter or sustenance
words.japaneseExplanation: 避難所または糧を提供しないさま。
words.example: The trees are barren or bear only small fruit.

words.englishDefinition: A distinctive odor that is pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりとした快いにおい。
words.example: The fragrance of roses is in the air.

words.englishDefinition: Give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人、行動または理由に完全に貢献する。
words.example: I will devote my life to the study of history.

words.englishDefinition: Grow worse
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪くなる。
words.example: It seems to me that the weather will deteriorate.

words.englishDefinition: Consider as a possibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能性であると考える。
words.example: You are the star I contemplate.

words.englishDefinition: Give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
words.japaneseExplanation: （人）を職に配置する、あるいは（人）に仕事を割り当てる。
words.example: He needs to learn to delegate.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move forward with force
words.japaneseExplanation: 力と共に前進させる。
words.example: Algeria needs to propel its economy forward.

words.englishDefinition: Pull back or move away or backward
words.japaneseExplanation: 引っ込む、引き下がるまたは後退する。
words.example: My memory of her has begun to recede.

words.englishDefinition: Scratch repeatedly
words.japaneseExplanation: 繰り返して引っ掻jく。
words.example: I hope I can scrape through this day.

words.englishDefinition: Hit hard
words.japaneseExplanation: 強烈に打つ。
words.example: You make me want to smash your face in.

words.englishDefinition: Censure severely or angrily
words.japaneseExplanation: 厳しくあるいは怒って避難する。
words.example: I saw his mother scold him.

words.englishDefinition: Occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion
words.japaneseExplanation: 気持ちのよい、愉快、あるいは良い感じの風習で占める。
words.example: I had to amuse myself with toys.

words.englishDefinition: to examine and repair or improve something thoroughly
words.japaneseExplanation: 機械や仕組みの全体を調べ、修理や改善をすること。
words.example: The company plans to overhaul its old computer system.

words.englishDefinition: A crowd especially of ordinary or undistinguished persons or things
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に普通で平凡な人や物の群れ。
words.example: You shouldn't be a sheep in the herd.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that serves as an enticement
words.japaneseExplanation: 誘惑として用いられる何でも。
words.example: I am not going to take the bait.

words.englishDefinition: A formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 当局に提出された何かを要求する公式のメッセージ。
words.example: We hope that you all will sign this petition.

words.englishDefinition: Money demanded for the return of a captured person
words.japaneseExplanation: 誘拐された人との引き替えに要求される金銭。
words.example: Yanni and his girlfriend went on the run with their ransom.

words.englishDefinition: Using (or as if using) mechanisms or tools or devices
words.japaneseExplanation: メカニズムまたはツールまたは装置を使うこと（または使うかのような）。
words.example: I got a piece of lead for my mechanical pencil from her.

words.japanese: 連邦政府の、米国(政府)の
words.englishDefinition: National; especially in reference to the government of the United States as distinct from that of its member units
words.japaneseExplanation: 国家的な。特に米国政府に関して、その加盟単位は除外して。
words.example: Karl was admitted into a federal prison in the US.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の目的への決心と熱意のある追及を示す、または持つ。
words.example: I want to try to be as aggressive as possible.

words.englishDefinition: Sufficient for the purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的のために十分な。
words.example: I don't consider that adequate.

words.englishDefinition: Not expected or anticipated
words.japaneseExplanation: 予想または予期されない。
words.example: My parents often joke that I was an unexpected surprise.

words.englishDefinition: Pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に美しさまたは魅力を通して、目または心に感じの良い。
words.example: What do women find attractive in a man?

words.englishDefinition: Of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant
words.japaneseExplanation: 豊富ではなく必要または必要条件を満たすことができる量の。
words.example: We need to be more self-sufficient.

words.englishDefinition: Having a high price
words.japaneseExplanation: 高価な。
words.example: Why did you get such a costly dictionary?

words.englishDefinition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
words.example: I think we're going to eventually have to do that.

words.englishDefinition: if not; in a different way
words.japaneseExplanation: 「そうでなければ」や「それ以外の点では」を表す。
words.example: Let's leave now. Otherwise, we will miss the train.

words.englishDefinition: At an earlier time or formerly
words.japaneseExplanation: より早い時間で、または以前に。
words.example: I will be here two hours earlier than previously said.

words.englishDefinition: In a relative manner; by comparison to something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 関連のある状態で。何か他のものと比べて。
words.example: I live in a relatively safe area.

words.englishDefinition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given
words.japaneseExplanation: あげられた理由のため。
words.example: Tom didn't study hard and he consequently failed.

words.englishDefinition: Without variation or change, in every case
words.japaneseExplanation: いずれの場合にも変化または変更のない。
words.example: I can't live without your love. I think of you constantly.

words.englishDefinition: A reciprocal relation between two or more things
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つ以上の物事における相互関係。
words.example: Do you think these two facts have some correlation between them?

words.englishDefinition: (especially of medicine) of disease or anything resembling a disease; attacking or affecting many individuals in a community or a population simultaneously
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気に似た何かまたは病気の（特に医学的な）。同時に、地域社会または住民の多く人々を襲うまたは侵す。
words.example: A serious epidemic broke out in the school, and three of the boys died.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of reliance or trust
words.japaneseExplanation: 信頼または信用にふさわしい。
words.example: How reliable do you think this information is?

words.englishDefinition: wanting to know or learn about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を知りたいと思う、好奇心のある状態。
words.example: I'm curious about how this machine works.

words.englishDefinition: Excessively quick
words.japaneseExplanation: 極端に速い。
words.example: I had a hasty breakfast and left home.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動の、または、行動に関する。
words.example: Oleg took part in a behavioral experiment.

words.englishDefinition: Of large size for its weight
words.japaneseExplanation: 重さの割にサイズが大きい。
words.example: This box is too bulky to carry.

words.japanese: (機械・装置などが)欠陥のある
words.englishDefinition: Having a defect
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠陥があるさま。
words.example: The weather report is faulty.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by intense agitation or emotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 激しい動揺または感情が特徴。
words.example: I don't work now and I lead a less hectic life.

words.englishDefinition: Highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
words.japaneseExplanation: 教養が高い。大きな情報を持っている、または理解している。
words.example: My father is more knowledgeable about cars than I am.

words.englishDefinition: In or of a state of physical or nervous tension
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的または神経質の緊張の状態にある。
words.example: We use the present tense for this kind of case.

words.englishDefinition: Constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged
words.japaneseExplanation: 少しも減少することなく全体を構成するさま。不可欠なものは何も欠けることなく、特に、破損もしていない。
words.example: You can write a sentence in many ways and still keep the general message intact.

words.japanese: 包括的な、広範囲にわたる
words.englishDefinition: Including all or everything
words.japaneseExplanation: すべてまたはすべてを含む。
words.example: I gave you a comprehensive answer.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking decisiveness of character; unable to act or decide quickly or firmly
words.japaneseExplanation: 明白な特性が欠如している。速くまたはしっかりと行動するかまたは決心することができない。
words.example: I thought you said you were hesitant to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
words.japaneseExplanation: 量や数が、需要に比べて不十分である。
words.example: Water is scarce in this area.

words.englishDefinition: How something is done or how it happens
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがされる方法またはそれが起こる方法。
words.example: I find her manner a little hard to take.

words.englishDefinition: The act of conquering
words.japaneseExplanation: 征服する行為。
words.example: What is the point of conquest?

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being open and truthful; not deceitful or hypocritical
words.japaneseExplanation: 率直で誠実な性質。うそつきでない、または偽善的でない。
words.example: I have no doubt as to his sincerity.

words.englishDefinition: A government tax on imports or exports
words.japaneseExplanation: 輸出入品に政府が課す税金。
words.example: We hope to lower the tariff.

words.englishDefinition: A mechanism of social control for enforcing a society's standards
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会の基準を強制するための社会的コントロールのメカニズム。
words.example: What did we do wrong to deserve this sanction?

words.englishDefinition: A particular environment or walk of life
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の環境や社会的階級。
words.example: The subject is out of his sphere.

words.englishDefinition: A person who is rejected (from society or home)
words.japaneseExplanation: （社会や家庭から）拒絶された人。
words.example: I don't want to be an outcast.

words.englishDefinition: A vaguely specified concern
words.japaneseExplanation: 漠然としたある関心。
words.example: I am not concerned with this affair.

words.japanese: スキャンダル、不正行為
words.englishDefinition: Disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people
words.japaneseExplanation: 他人の私生活に関する醜いゴシップ。
words.example: I think he has something to do with that scandal.

words.englishDefinition: Hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のアレルゲンへの超過敏反応。特定のアレルゲンに対する過敏反応。
words.example: I have an allergy to milk.

words.englishDefinition: The termination of something by causing so much damage to it that it cannot be repaired or no longer exists
words.japaneseExplanation: それにそれが修理されることができないか、もはや存在しないように大きく破壊されることによる何かの終了。
words.example: Why does no one talk about who is responsible for the destruction?

words.englishDefinition: One of a (chiefly European) class of agricultural laborers
words.japaneseExplanation: 農耕労働者階級（主にヨーロッパ人）の一つ。
words.example: What the peasant does not know, he does not eat.

words.englishDefinition: An onerous or difficult concern
words.japaneseExplanation: 煩わしいまたは難しい懸念。
words.example: I don't want to be a burden to my parents.

words.englishDefinition: the teachers at a university or college
words.japaneseExplanation: 大学などに所属する教員全体を指す。
words.example: The faculty met to discuss the new courses.

words.englishDefinition: The branch of military science dealing with detailed maneuvers to achieve objectives set by strategy
words.japaneseExplanation: 軍事科学の分野で、戦略により決められた目標物を陥落させる詳細な作戦を扱う。
words.example: We need to change our tactics.

words.englishDefinition: The sum charged for riding in a public conveyance
words.japaneseExplanation: 公共の乗物の利用に対する請求額。
words.example: How much is the fare on the bus?

words.englishDefinition: In a typical manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 典型的な方法で。
words.example: How much does a high-end computer typically cost?

words.englishDefinition: only just; almost not
words.japaneseExplanation: 「かろうじて」「ほとんど〜ない」を表す。
words.example: We barely had enough time to catch the train.

words.englishDefinition: without being prevented by something
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
words.example: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

words.englishDefinition: for each
words.japaneseExplanation: 数量や単位の前で「〜につき」「〜当たり」を表す。
words.example: The tickets cost ten dollars per person.

words.englishDefinition: In or to a place that is lower
words.japaneseExplanation: より低い場所で、または、それにおいて。
words.example: Can you feel the earth beneath your feet?

words.englishDefinition: used to show a contrast between two facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つの事実を「一方では」と対比する接続詞。
words.example: I prefer tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.

words.japanese: （メッセージなどを）投稿する
words.englishDefinition: to publish a message, picture, or other content online
words.japaneseExplanation: インターネット上に文章や写真などを公開すること。
words.example: Please ask me before you post that photo online.

words.japanese: 稿する拒絶する、拒否する
words.englishDefinition: Refuse entrance or membership
words.japaneseExplanation: 入ることまたは一員であることを拒否する。
words.example: I hope they don't reject me.

words.japanese: 相談する、 (辞書など)調べる
words.englishDefinition: Seek information from
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を集める。
words.example: You should consult the dictionary.

words.japanese: ど)調べる服従する、従う
words.englishDefinition: Be obedient to
words.japaneseExplanation: 従順である。
words.example: We should obey the law no matter what happens.

words.japanese: 従事させる、引きつける
words.englishDefinition: Carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in
words.japaneseExplanation: 活動を行うか、参加する。関わっていること。
words.example: My father never used to engage in such talk.

words.japanese: ける修復する、復活させる
words.englishDefinition: Return to its original or usable and functioning condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 元来の、または使用でき機能する状態に戻る。
words.example: I took advantage of the stay to restore my health.

words.englishDefinition: Settle as a colony; of countries in the developing world
words.japaneseExplanation: 入植者として定住する。開発途上地域の国の。
words.example: We need to colonize other planets.

words.englishDefinition: Act together or towards others or with others
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒にまたは他に向かって、あるいは他と共に行動する。
words.example: I have to use Berber to interact with people here.

words.englishDefinition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
words.japaneseExplanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
words.example: I think they're quite the peculiar person though.

words.englishDefinition: Attempting to justify or defend in speech or writing
words.japaneseExplanation: 十分な根拠を示すか、言葉で防御しようとするか、書くさま。
words.example: You don't need to be so defensive.

words.englishDefinition: For a long time without essential change
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的な変化のない長い時間。
words.example: I have permanently changed for the worse.

words.englishDefinition: Despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
words.japaneseExplanation: それと反対（通常、譲歩に続く）な何にもかかわらずでも。
words.example: You may not believe it, but it is nonetheless true.

words.englishDefinition: For the most part
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分。
words.example: This dictionary is primarily intended for high school students.

words.englishDefinition: With intention; in an intentional manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 意志をもって。意図的な方法で。
words.example: I think you did that intentionally.

words.englishDefinition: Quickly and without warning
words.japaneseExplanation: すぐにそして警告なしで。
words.example: He stopped the car abruptly.

words.japanese: 外注する、業務委託する
words.englishDefinition: Obtain goods or services from an outside supplier; to contract work out
words.japaneseExplanation: 外部の供給者から商品やサービスを入手する。下請に出すこと。
words.example: My company has decided to outsource my job.

words.englishDefinition: Clap one's hands or shout after performances to indicate approval
words.japaneseExplanation: 賞賛をするために演技の後で拍手をするまたは声を張り上げる。
words.example: Do you want me to applaud you?

words.englishDefinition: Make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
words.japaneseExplanation: ひいきまたは威力の見返りに不正支出をする。
words.example: I can't believe you're trying to bribe me.

words.englishDefinition: Make or do or perform again
words.japaneseExplanation: もう一度作る、するあるいは実行する。
words.example: No one was able to replicate the results of that study.

words.japanese: ぶらぶら歩く、散歩する
words.englishDefinition: Walk leisurely and with no apparent aim
words.japaneseExplanation: ゆっくり、そして、はっきりとした目的なく歩く。
words.example: What time in the morning do you take your morning stroll?

words.englishDefinition: Cause to become swollen
words.japaneseExplanation: 腫れるようにする。
words.example: I don't like that my eyes swell up when I cry.

words.englishDefinition: Keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
words.japaneseExplanation: 不変の状態に保つかまたは維持する。残させる、または持続させる。
words.example: We must uphold the law at all times.

words.englishDefinition: Eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: 口から胃の内容を放出する。
words.example: I feel so bad I want to vomit...

words.englishDefinition: Marked by extreme and violent energy
words.japaneseExplanation: 猛烈な激しいエネルギーによって特徴づけられる。
words.example: How can you stand that fierce heat all day?

words.englishDefinition: Any plant that crowds out cultivated plants
words.japaneseExplanation: 栽培された植物を追い遣る植物。
words.example: My mom wants me to help her weed her garden.

words.englishDefinition: An authoritative direction or instruction to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをする正式の指示か命令。
words.example: We are under his command.

words.englishDefinition: One of four periods into which the school year is divided
words.japaneseExplanation: 学年の4分の1。
words.example: Do you have a quarter I could borrow?

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being at hand when needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な時手もとにあること。
words.example: Mennad never changed his availability.

words.englishDefinition: The trait of being cautious; being attentive to possible danger
words.japaneseExplanation: 用心深い特性。あり得る危険に対して注意を払うこと。
words.example: I need to act with more caution.

words.englishDefinition: The act of preventing
words.japaneseExplanation: 防止行為。
words.example: Prevention is the best medicine.

words.englishDefinition: Any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises, turtles, snakes, lizards, alligators, crocodiles, and extinct forms
words.japaneseExplanation: 陸生のカメ、水生のカメ、蛇、トカゲ、アリゲーター、クロコダイル、それに絶滅種などを含む爬虫類綱の冷血脊椎動物。
words.example: Leonid’s eyes turned into a reptile’s.

words.englishDefinition: An event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future
words.japaneseExplanation: 未来に必ず起きること（または事の成り行き）。
words.example: I will accept my fate.

words.englishDefinition: An attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
words.japaneseExplanation: 特にある選択肢を他の選択肢より好むという精神的な意向。
words.example: I don't have the time or the inclination to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い嫌悪からくる尊敬の欠如。
words.example: You could see the look of scorn on Tom's face.

words.englishDefinition: Lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い嫌悪からくる尊敬の欠如。
words.example: I didn't feel anything for her: neither sorry nor contempt.

words.englishDefinition: A particular environment or walk of life
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の環境や社会的階級。
words.example: This domain name has already been taken.

words.englishDefinition: A fundamental principle or practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 根本的な原則や慣習。
words.example: My daughter is the pillar of my life.

words.englishDefinition: Easy to cut or chew
words.japaneseExplanation: 切る、または噛むのが容易な。
words.example: You have a tender body.

words.englishDefinition: Socially uncomfortable; unsure and constrained in manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会的に不快な。不安な、または不自然な態度の。
words.example: I hoped he would stop asking awkward questions.

words.englishDefinition: Heighten or intensify
words.japaneseExplanation: 高まる、または強まる。
words.example: I hope to inspire others who feel the same way.

words.englishDefinition: Institute legal proceedings against; file a suit against
words.japaneseExplanation: 訴訟手続きを起こす。訴訟を起こす。
words.example: I will sue him if he comes back to me.

words.englishDefinition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
words.japaneseExplanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
words.example: I estimate that the work will cost more than $10,000.

words.englishDefinition: Make strong or stronger
words.japaneseExplanation: 強くまたはより強くする。
words.example: We must strengthen the ties between our countries.

words.englishDefinition: Form by carving
words.japaneseExplanation: 彫刻により形成する。
words.example: Do you want to carve the bird?

words.englishDefinition: Make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something
words.japaneseExplanation: （誰かに）真実または何かの有効性を、同意させる、自覚させる、あるいは理解させる。
words.example: I tried to convince myself that he was doing the right thing.

words.japanese: 提案する、結婚を申し込む
words.englishDefinition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
words.example: I have made up my mind to propose to her.

words.englishDefinition: Put or pin the blame on
words.japaneseExplanation: 責めを負わせるまたは責任を負わせる。
words.example: I am not to blame any more than you are.

words.japanese: 崩れ落ちる、 (人が)倒れる
words.englishDefinition: Break down, literally or metaphorically
words.japaneseExplanation: 文字通り、または、比喩的に壊れる。
words.example: I feel like I'm about to collapse.

words.englishDefinition: Bring in from abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 外国から持ち込む。
words.example: Do you think we should import rice from the U.S.?

words.englishDefinition: Fill or place a load on
words.japaneseExplanation: 内容物を詰め込むまたは入れる。
words.example: What else do you want to load into the car?

words.englishDefinition: Make impure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不潔にする。
words.example: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.

words.englishDefinition: A point located with respect to surface features of some region
words.japaneseExplanation: ある地域の表面の特徴に関して見つけられたポイント。
words.example: My phone doesn't work in this spot of the city.

words.englishDefinition: Written instructions from a physician or dentist to a druggist concerning the form and dosage of a drug to be issued to a given patient
words.japaneseExplanation: 患者に発行される薬の形と量に関する薬剤師への医師または歯科医からの書面による指示。
words.example: You are not allowed to buy that without a prescription.

words.englishDefinition: Intended or having the power to induce action or belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動または信条を導く力を持つまたは意図する。
words.example: I can be persuasive when I want to be.

words.englishDefinition: to reach the end of the time something is valid
words.japaneseExplanation: 書類や契約などの有効期限が切れること。
words.example: My library card will expire at the end of this month.

words.englishDefinition: Register formally as a participant or member
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係者かメンバーとして正式に登録する。
words.example: We tried to recruit Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Increase
words.japaneseExplanation: 増大させる。
words.example: You had the opportunity to enhance your performance.

words.englishDefinition: Get or gather together
words.japaneseExplanation: 集合する、または集まる。
words.example: Snow started to accumulate in the yard.

words.englishDefinition: Decree or designate beforehand
words.japaneseExplanation: あらかじめ命じるか、指定する。
words.example: Each football team needs to designate a captain.

words.englishDefinition: Prevent from being seen or discovered
words.japaneseExplanation: 見られる、または発見されるのを防ぐ。
words.example: I can't conceal it from you.

words.englishDefinition: Refuse to acknowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 認めることを拒む。
words.example: Please disregard my last message.

words.englishDefinition: Move faster
words.japaneseExplanation: より速く動く。
words.example: What should we do to accelerate it?

words.japanese: 生き返らせる、復活させる
words.englishDefinition: Give new life or energy to
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい生命あるいはエネルギーを与える。
words.example: I tried to do what I could to revive Tom.

words.japanese: (法案を)制定する、通過させる
words.englishDefinition: Order by virtue of superior authority; decree
words.japaneseExplanation: 上級の権威者による命令。命じる。
words.example: The bill is expected to be enacted during the present session.

words.japanese: 行使する、（力などを）働かせる
words.englishDefinition: Put to use
words.japaneseExplanation: 使用される。
words.example: You should exert yourself to get better results.

words.englishDefinition: Tell anonymously
words.japaneseExplanation: 匿名で話す。
words.example: I think we have a gas leak.

words.englishDefinition: Lock up or confine, in or as in a jail
words.japaneseExplanation: 閉じ込める、あるいは監禁する、刑務所のように。
words.example: Do you want to spend the rest of your life in jail?

words.englishDefinition: Make changes for improvement in order to remove abuse and injustices
words.japaneseExplanation: 虐待と不正を取り除くために、改善のために変更を行う。
words.example: Algeria needs to reform its political system.

words.japanese: 忘れられない、記憶すべき
words.englishDefinition: Worth remembering
words.japaneseExplanation: 覚えている価値がある。
words.example: What was the most memorable day of your life?

words.englishDefinition: Not fake or counterfeit
words.japaneseExplanation: まやかしや偽物ではない。
words.example: I think William is one of the most genuine people I've ever met.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 力強くてエネルギッシュな行為か活動で、特徴付けられる。
words.example: My grandmother is still vigorous at 82 years old.

words.englishDefinition: Depressingly dark
words.japaneseExplanation: 陰うつなほど暗い。
words.example: I got gloomy and thought of giving up.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of the time of chivalry and knighthood in the Middle Ages
words.japaneseExplanation: 中世の騎士道と伯爵の時代の特性。
words.example: I am looking for a book about medieval Spain.

words.englishDefinition: Difficult to detect or grasp by the mind or analyze
words.japaneseExplanation: 心または分析により検出する、あるいは把握することが難しい。
words.example: I will pay him back later in a subtle way.

words.englishDefinition: Incapable of compromise or flexibility
words.japaneseExplanation: 妥協または柔軟にできない。
words.example: There's no need to be so rigid.

words.englishDefinition: Of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較的大きな粒子からなる感触的または物質的にざらついている質感の。
words.example: Her dress was made of coarse wool.

words.japanese: 謙虚な、地位などが低い
words.englishDefinition: Marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful
words.japaneseExplanation: 柔和さまたは謙虚さによって特徴付けられる。横柄でないまたは傲慢でない。
words.example: I am just a humble teacher.

words.englishDefinition: loose rather than pulled tight
words.japaneseExplanation: ひもなどがぴんと張られず、緩んでいること。
words.example: The rope is too slack to hold the tent up.

words.englishDefinition: (informal) small and of little importance
words.japaneseExplanation: 微小で重要でない。
words.example: It may seem trivial to you, but for me it's worth paying attention to.

words.englishDefinition: Common to or shared by two or more parties
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つまたはそれ以上の団体によって共有されたまたはそれらに共通の。
words.example: You and I have some mutual friends.

words.englishDefinition: More than is needed, desired, or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要である、希望される、あるいは必要であるより多いもの。
words.example: My father has been made redundant.

words.englishDefinition: happening or being done earlier than is suitable
words.japaneseExplanation: 適切な時期より早く行われること。
words.example: It is premature to decide before we hear everyone's ideas.

words.englishDefinition: (often followed by 'to') giving care or attention
words.japaneseExplanation: 世話または注意をするさま。
words.example: You need to be more attentive in class.

words.englishDefinition: Constituting the undiminished entirety; lacking nothing essential especially not damaged
words.japaneseExplanation: 少しも減少することなく全体を構成するさま。不可欠なものは何も欠けることなく、特に、破損もしていない。
words.example: The meaning is an integral part of the word.

words.englishDefinition: The social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたをその力によって要求された行動方針に結びつける社会的勢力。
words.example: You must do your duty, whether you like it or not.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being joined or united or linked
words.japaneseExplanation: 結合していること。
words.example: Our union no longer has any purpose.

words.englishDefinition: An abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の事例によって推論された、または導き出された抽象的、あるいは一般的な考え。
words.example: I don't know where this concept comes from.

words.englishDefinition: A number that, when multiplied by itself some number of times, equals a given number
words.japaneseExplanation: それ自身を何乗かすると元の数になるような数。
words.example: We need to get to the root of the problem.

words.englishDefinition: A state of surviving; remaining alive
words.japaneseExplanation: 生き残ること。生きたままでいること。
words.example: I gave up all hope of survival.

words.englishDefinition: Activity involved in maintaining something in good working order
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをきちんと使える状態で維持するような行為。
words.example: The police are responsible for the maintenance of law and order.

words.englishDefinition: The act of fabricating something in a particular shape
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の形で何かを作る行為。
words.example: We watched a school of fish swimming together in a tight formation.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who educates young people
words.japaneseExplanation: 若い人を教育する人。
words.example: Do you like the educator?

words.englishDefinition: Either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
words.japaneseExplanation: 血液から排泄物を濾過し（特に尿素）、それらを排泄し水分の中に分泌液を出す2つの豆形の排泄器官のどちらか。
words.example: How much do you think I can get for my kidney?

words.englishDefinition: A source of materials to nourish the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体を養うための材料の源。
words.example: In your opinion, what does good nutrition look like?

words.englishDefinition: A name given to a product or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに付けられた名前。
words.example: I have always wanted to buy this brand of bag.

words.englishDefinition: The act of storing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを格納する行為。
words.example: Do you have the keys to the storage room?

words.englishDefinition: The members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つまたはそれ以上の施設を所有しているか、または経営している企業のメンバー。
words.example: I am a member of the firm.

words.englishDefinition: A branch of applied mathematics concerned with the collection and interpretation of quantitative data and the use of probability theory to estimate population parameters
words.japaneseExplanation: 数量的データの収集と解釈、また母数を推定するための確率論の使用に関する応用数学の分野。
words.example: I don't remember the statistics.

words.englishDefinition: Obtain from someone after their death
words.japaneseExplanation: 彼らの死後、誰かから得る。
words.example: You will not inherit what your brother left.

words.englishDefinition: Declare to be
words.japaneseExplanation: であると宣言する。
words.example: I want so much to declare my love to her.

words.englishDefinition: Describe roughly or briefly or give the main points or summary of
words.japaneseExplanation: 要点または概要をざっと簡潔に記述するまたは、要点あるいは要約を与える。
words.example: Here is a general outline.

words.japanese: いらいらさせる、悩ます
words.englishDefinition: Cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快感にさせる。特に小さな苛立ちによって、妨げる。
words.example: I never allow what can't be changed to annoy me.

words.englishDefinition: Get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force
words.japaneseExplanation: 改正するためにまたは妨害するために、あるいは軍事的圧力または脅威を通じて関与する。
words.example: I don't want to interfere with your personal life.

words.englishDefinition: A structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物がその中で産卵あるいは子供を産む構造物。
words.example: I see a nest high up in the tree.

words.englishDefinition: A person who founds or establishes some institution
words.japaneseExplanation: ある団体を設立するまたは作る人。
words.example: He is the founder of a large company.

words.englishDefinition: (biology) a scientist who studies living organisms
words.japaneseExplanation: 生物を研究する科学者。
words.example: I was excited when the little boy said he wanted to be a biologist.

words.englishDefinition: The spatial property of the way in which something is placed
words.japaneseExplanation: 物の置き方の空間的性質。
words.example: I like the arrangement of the furniture in this room.

words.englishDefinition: A low area that has been filled in
words.japaneseExplanation: 埋め立てでできた低地。
words.example: I used to live next to a landfill.

words.englishDefinition: The main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber
words.japaneseExplanation: 木の主茎。通常、樹皮で覆われている。
words.example: The trunk is the main part of a tree.

words.japanese: ク(個人の)主義、信条、原則
words.englishDefinition: Rule of personal conduct
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人的な行動の規則。
words.example: What is the principle reason for going to school?

words.englishDefinition: Similar things placed in order or happening one after another
words.japaneseExplanation: 類似した事柄が、順番に置かれる、または、次々と起こること。
words.example: What happens in this series?

words.englishDefinition: Freedom from control or influence of another or others
words.japaneseExplanation: 相手あるいは他人の管理や影響から自由になること。
words.example: I like this independence a lot.

words.englishDefinition: To travel for the purpose of discovery
words.japaneseExplanation: 発見の目的で旅行すること。
words.example: What is the cost of exploration?

words.englishDefinition: Move back and forth or sideways
words.japaneseExplanation: 前後または横に動く。
words.example: The wind made the ship rock and sway.

words.englishDefinition: Most frequent or common
words.japaneseExplanation: 頻繁であるか、または一般的である。
words.example: This was a very prevalent issue at the time.

words.englishDefinition: (often followed by 'of') not aware
words.japaneseExplanation: 意識しない。
words.example: We were unaware that that was happening.

words.englishDefinition: Sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間、または関心を投資することに対し、正当化するための十分な価値。
words.example: I don't think it worthwhile to do such a thing.

words.englishDefinition: Surprising greatly
words.japaneseExplanation: 大いに驚かすさま。
words.example: How amazing that your mother speaks six languages!

words.englishDefinition: Qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen
words.japaneseExplanation: 選択される価値のある、そのことが許されるまたはそれにふさわしい。
words.example: I became eligible earlier than expected.

words.englishDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
words.example: It seems like you've done some pretty vicious things.

words.englishDefinition: Impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
words.japaneseExplanation: 見ることが不可能、またはほぼ不可能。目で感知できない。
words.example: I am an invisible man.

words.englishDefinition: Having no cogency or legal force
words.japaneseExplanation: 説得力または強制力がないさま。
words.example: My credit card was invalid.

words.englishDefinition: spoiled or decayed
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物などが腐って、よい状態でなくなったこと。
words.example: We threw away the rotten apples.

words.englishDefinition: Annoy continually or chronically
words.japaneseExplanation: 継続的に、または慢性的に悩ます。
words.example: We must stop this dangerous plague.

words.englishDefinition: Assume sponsorship of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かのスポンサーを受け持つ。
words.example: Would you like to sponsor our project?

words.englishDefinition: Bestow honor or rewards upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 名誉や報酬を付与する。
words.example: We should honor our parents.

words.englishDefinition: Make mention of
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及を行う。
words.example: I have another remark to make.

words.englishDefinition: Make into a whole or make part of a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体を作るか、全体の一部を作る。
words.example: I keep looking for new sounds I like to incorporate them into my music.

words.englishDefinition: Reach a decision
words.japaneseExplanation: 決断に到る。
words.example: I hope that you are able to resolve the situation soon.

words.englishDefinition: the amount of harm caused by an event or situation
words.japaneseExplanation: 災害などがもたらす被害。take a toll on は悪影響を与えること。
words.example: The long journey took a toll on our energy.

words.englishDefinition: a useful piece of advice
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを上手に行うための助言やこつ。
words.example: Can you give me a tip for remembering new words?

words.englishDefinition: The corporate executive responsible for the operations of the firm; reports to a board of directors; may appoint other managers (including a president)
words.japaneseExplanation: 会社の執行に責任を負った会社の重役。取締役会に報告する。
words.example: What is the name of our CEO?

words.englishDefinition: A condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの出来事か活動に伴うか、または影響を及ぼす状態。
words.example: What would you do in this circumstance?

words.englishDefinition: Someone who is excluded from or is not a member of a group
words.japaneseExplanation: 除外されたまたはその団体のメンバーでない人。
words.example: I feel like an outsider in my family.

words.englishDefinition: The act of decreasing or reducing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを小さく、あるいは少なくする行為。
words.example: We would ask you to give us a price reduction of 5%.

words.englishDefinition: Something settled or resolved; the outcome of decision making
words.japaneseExplanation: 決定あるいは解決されたもの。意志決定の結果。
words.example: I wasn't completely happy with the settlement.

words.englishDefinition: the legal end of a marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 婚姻関係を法律上終わらせる離婚。
words.example: After the divorce, they continued to care for their children together.

words.englishDefinition: The probability of a specified outcome
words.japaneseExplanation: 具体的に挙げられた結果に対しての見込み。
words.example: What is the likelihood of your getting fired?

words.englishDefinition: Any animals kept for use or profit
words.japaneseExplanation: 使用したり利益を生む各種の動物。
words.example: The animals living on a farm are the livestock.

words.englishDefinition: Anything owned or possessed
words.japaneseExplanation: 所有または占有されている物。
words.example: I have never had more than $500 in my possession.

words.englishDefinition: A secret scheme to do something (especially something underhand or illegal)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（特に後ろ暗いこと、非合法なこと）をするための秘密の計画。
words.example: I think most of them took part in the plot.

words.englishDefinition: A collection of things sharing a common attribute
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通の属性を有する物の集まり。
words.example: Should I pick a category, or do you want to?

words.englishDefinition: Something that aids or promotes well-being
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸福を助け、推進する何か。
words.example: We did everything for the welfare of our children.

words.englishDefinition: Be adjacent or come together
words.japaneseExplanation: 近接しているか、または一緒になる。
words.example: All the problems we mentioned converge into one main issue.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being just or fair
words.japaneseExplanation: 公正または公平である性質。
words.example: My grandfather was a justice of the peace.

words.englishDefinition: All of the living human inhabitants of the earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の全住民。
words.example: I feel a great love for all of humanity.

words.japanese: 関与、巻き込まれること
words.englishDefinition: The act of sharing in the activities of a group
words.japaneseExplanation: グループの活動に参加する行為。
words.example: I heard of his involvement in crime.

words.englishDefinition: A system that provides quantitative information about finances
words.japaneseExplanation: 財政についての量的な情報を扱う大系。
words.example: I work in an accounting office.

words.englishDefinition: Unfair treatment of a person or group on the basis of prejudice
words.japaneseExplanation: 偏見に基づく個人またはグループの不当な扱い。
words.example: They are poor because of the discrimination against them.

words.englishDefinition: Lack of equality
words.japaneseExplanation: 平等性の欠如。
words.example: No inequality should be allowed to exist between men and women.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who holds a master's degree from academic institution
words.japaneseExplanation: 大学の修士の学位を持っている人。
words.example: How can I show the garden to my master now?

words.englishDefinition: A span of 1000 years
words.example: A thousand years make up a millennium.

words.englishDefinition: The act of refusing
words.japaneseExplanation: 拒否する行為。
words.example: You set me up with your refusal.

words.englishDefinition: An injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin)
words.japaneseExplanation: 生体組織の損傷（特に皮膚の切り傷、ひび割れなどの怪我）。
words.example: My friend died from a wound.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being absent
words.japaneseExplanation: 不在であること。
words.example: I was not aware of his absence from the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: The act of distributing or spreading or apportioning
words.japaneseExplanation: 分配、または普及、割り当てる行為。
words.example: I love the distribution of gifts.

words.englishDefinition: A wild and uninhabited area left in its natural condition
words.japaneseExplanation: その自然の状態で残されている野生で無人の領域。
words.example: I was in the wilderness.

words.englishDefinition: The strength of a solution; number of molecules of a substance in a given volume
words.japaneseExplanation: 溶液の濃度。所定の体積における物質のモル数。
words.example: I immediately lost my concentration.

words.englishDefinition: Make a subtraction
words.japaneseExplanation: 引き算をする。
words.example: Ziri deducted four thousand dinars from the bill.

words.japanese: 大量に積む、積み重ねる
words.englishDefinition: Arrange in stacks
words.japaneseExplanation: 堆積で配置する。
words.example: How is it that dishes pile up so quickly?

words.englishDefinition: Restore to a previous or better condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 前であるかより良い状態に戻す。
words.example: I don't know how much it cost him to renovate his house.

words.englishDefinition: Make as big or large as possible
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きく、またはできるだけ大きくする。
words.example: We need to maximize this opportunity.

words.japanese: 発掘する、明るみに出す
words.englishDefinition: Make visible
words.japaneseExplanation: 可視化させる。
words.example: We need to uncover her secret life.

words.japanese: 誤った考えを持たせる
words.englishDefinition: Lead someone in the wrong direction or give someone wrong directions
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違った方向に誰かを案内する、あるいは間違った誰かに方向を示す。
words.example: I didn't want to mislead anyone.

words.englishDefinition: Select as an alternative over another
words.japaneseExplanation: 代替手段として、もう一つのものを選択する。
words.example: You can opt out if you like.

words.englishDefinition: Be larger in number
words.japaneseExplanation: 数においてより大きな。
words.example: They outnumber us three to one.

words.englishDefinition: Take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であるあるいは事実であると取る。確認または証明なしで受け入れる。
words.example: I presume that he has paid the money back.

words.japanese: 磨きをかける、洗練する
words.englishDefinition: Improve or perfect by pruning or polishing
words.japaneseExplanation: 刈り込むか磨くことにより改善するあるいは完璧にする。
words.example: Algeria needs to refine its own oil.

words.englishDefinition: Move an implement through
words.japaneseExplanation: その中で道具を動かす。
words.example: I need to stir the soup.

words.englishDefinition: Attempt by employing effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力を費やして試みる。
words.example: We still have something to strive for.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの知覚的な刺激によってぞくぞくさせる。
words.example: Yanni is thrill his daughter is gonna be with him.

words.englishDefinition: Make tight or tighter
words.japaneseExplanation: きついまたはよりきつく作る。
words.example: We need to tighten security.

words.englishDefinition: Call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses)
words.japaneseExplanation: （情緒、感情と反応を）引き起こす。
words.example: What should I do to arouse desire in the man I'm interested in?

words.englishDefinition: Make a buzzing sound
words.japaneseExplanation: ブーブーという音を出す。
words.example: I told Tom to buzz off.

words.englishDefinition: Wetness caused by water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水によって起こる湿り。
words.example: Giraffes can get most of the moisture they need from their food.

words.englishDefinition: More than average fatness
words.japaneseExplanation: 平均以上の肥満。
words.example: We have an obesity problem in this country.

words.englishDefinition: Any monetary aid
words.japaneseExplanation: あらゆる金銭的援助。
words.example: I don't think he'll grant it to us.

words.englishDefinition: Single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の厚さのある種の通例同質の物質。
words.example: I tried the layer cake of my aunt.

words.englishDefinition: An assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 上司や組織のために通信・文書事務を処理する補佐役。
words.example: My sister worked as a secretary before she got married.

words.englishDefinition: (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
words.japaneseExplanation: 心配と神経過敏の比較的永続する状態で、様々な精神障害で起こり、通常、強迫観念に取り付かれた行動またはパニックの発作を伴う。
words.example: I had an anxiety attack.

words.japanese: 所有権、所有者である事
words.englishDefinition: The relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others
words.japaneseExplanation: 所有されているものに対する所有者の関係。所有物を他人に譲渡する権利を伴う所有。
words.example: Our ownership in the company is 60%.

words.englishDefinition: The basis on which something is grounded
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを築く基礎となるもの。
words.example: My daughter is the foundation of my world.

words.englishDefinition: The act or process of dividing
words.japaneseExplanation: 分割の行為または過程。
words.example: What division of the company do you work in?

words.englishDefinition: The act of forming or establishing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを形成するか確立する行為。
words.example: It led to the establishment of lasting peace.

words.englishDefinition: The preservation and careful management of the environment and of natural resources
words.japaneseExplanation: 環境や天然資源の保護や注意深い管理。
words.example: The island is a conservation area closed to the public.

words.englishDefinition: the crime of intentionally killing a person
words.japaneseExplanation: 故意に人を殺す犯罪を表す名詞。
words.example: The detective in this novel is investigating a murder.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being present; current existence
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在すること。現在、存在すること。
words.example: You shouldn't say such a thing in the presence of children.

words.englishDefinition: (logic) a statement that contradicts itself
words.japaneseExplanation: それ自身矛盾している発言。
words.example: This has been a paradox, but now the time gives it proof.

words.englishDefinition: The branch of philosophy that analyzes the principles and procedures of inquiry in a particular discipline
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の分野における、調査の原則と手順を分析する哲学の部門。
words.example: Do you understand the methodology?

words.englishDefinition: The skilled practice of a practical occupation
words.japaneseExplanation: 実用的な仕事の熟練した実践。
words.example: Yanni wanted to get better at his craft.

words.englishDefinition: The outer layer of the Earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の外側の層。
words.example: I usually cut the crust off bread.

words.englishDefinition: The lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分的にまたは全体が地下にある構造物の最も低い部分。格納用にしばしば使用される。
words.example: How much money does a basement window like that cost?

words.englishDefinition: Someone employed to clean and maintain a building
words.japaneseExplanation: 建物を掃除し維持管理するために雇われた人。
words.example: I was a janitor a few years ago.

words.englishDefinition: A partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
words.japaneseExplanation: ある問題や状況を客観的に見ることを妨げる偏った見方。
words.example: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.

words.englishDefinition: An economic state of growth with rising profits and full employment
words.japaneseExplanation: 利益が上昇し、完全雇用である経済成長の状態。
words.example: You must realize that prosperity does not last forever.

words.englishDefinition: Larceny by threat of violence
words.japaneseExplanation: 暴力の脅威による窃盗罪。
words.example: I want it to look like a robbery.

words.englishDefinition: A written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications
words.japaneseExplanation: ある製品またはサービスが提供されるまたはある仕様を満たすという書面による保証。
words.example: What kind of warranty does this come with?

words.englishDefinition: A feeling of craving something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを切望する気持ち。
words.example: I built up an appetite while watching him make dinner.

words.englishDefinition: A projectile that is fired from a gun
words.japaneseExplanation: 銃から発射される発射体。
words.example: Please don't make me waste a bullet on you.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of putting or setting in order in advance of some act or purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 準備する行為。
words.example: My older brother did all the preparation for us.

words.englishDefinition: The status of a citizen with rights and duties
words.japaneseExplanation: 権利と任務をもつ市民の地位。
words.example: What is your citizenship status?

words.englishDefinition: no longer fresh or new
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物の鮮度が落ちたこと。考えなどが古くなる意味もある。
words.example: This bread is stale, so let's buy some more.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by deprivation especially of the necessities of life or healthful environmental influences
words.japaneseExplanation: 生活必需品または健康的な環境の影響が特に奪われることで強調される。
words.example: Many of these disadvantaged children had never seen a book before.

words.englishDefinition: A collection of things wrapped or boxed together
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に包装されたり箱に入れられたりしている物の集まり。
words.example: You must have dropped a bundle for that wedding ring!

words.englishDefinition: Pull the plug of (electrical appliances) and render inoperable
words.japaneseExplanation: （電気器具）のプラグを引き抜いて、使用不可能にする。
words.example: I have to disconnect from the chat.

words.englishDefinition: Wag one's tongue; speak about others and reveal secrets or intimacies
words.japaneseExplanation: ひっきりなしにしゃべる。他のものについて話し、秘密あるいは親密さをあらわにする。
words.example: I can't believe Tom would gossip about Mary like that.

words.englishDefinition: Move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば食物や雇用を求めて目的地なしに、あるいは目的なしに動きまわる。
words.example: I had some free time, so I decided to wander around town.

words.englishDefinition: Draw into the mouth by creating a practical vacuum in the mouth
words.japaneseExplanation: 口の中を実質的に真空にすることで、口に吸い込む。
words.example: I want to suck you off.

words.englishDefinition: Color with dye
words.japaneseExplanation: 染料により色をつける。
words.example: I thought we could dye our hair the same color.

words.englishDefinition: Commit a sin; violate a law of God or a moral law
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪事を働く。神の法や道徳的な法を侵害する。
words.example: How dare you trespass on my property!

words.englishDefinition: Feed as in a meadow or pasture
words.japaneseExplanation: 草地や牧草地などで食う。
words.example: I felt his hand graze my hair.

words.englishDefinition: Confer a trust upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 委託物を授与する。
words.example: You can entrust the tennis to me!

words.englishDefinition: A person who is of equal standing with another in a group
words.japaneseExplanation: 集団の中の別の人と、等しい立場である人。
words.example: I can't peer into the future.

words.englishDefinition: (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound
words.japaneseExplanation: 元素または化合物の最も単純な構成単位。
words.example: Each molecule in our body has a unique shape.

words.englishDefinition: The time between one event, process, or period and another
words.japaneseExplanation: ひとつの過程、期間と何らかの出来事の間の時間。
words.example: What would you like to do in the meantime?

words.englishDefinition: Any admirable quality or attribute
words.japaneseExplanation: 賞賛すべき特質や属性。
words.example: I don't know that there's any great merit in that.

words.englishDefinition: The possibility of future success
words.japaneseExplanation: 将来の成功の可能性。
words.example: I am excited at the prospect of seeing her.

words.japanese: くだらないおしゃべり
words.englishDefinition: Noisy talk
words.japaneseExplanation: 騒々しい会話。
words.example: I won't go there because I won't listen to their chatter.

words.englishDefinition: A ceremony at which a dead person is buried or cremated
words.japaneseExplanation: 死者が埋められたり火葬にされる儀式。
words.example: I am going to attend a funeral tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: A person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war
words.japaneseExplanation: 閉じこめられた人。特に戦争捕虜。
words.example: I wonder if you still remember the prisoner or not.

words.englishDefinition: A physician who specializes in surgery
words.japaneseExplanation: 外科を専門とする医師。
words.example: I had no idea you worked as a surgeon.

words.japanese: 頻度、しばしば起こること
words.englishDefinition: The number of occurrences within a given time period
words.japaneseExplanation: 所定の時間内に発生する回数。
words.example: The frequency of crime in the town is high.

words.englishDefinition: A place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country
words.japaneseExplanation: （海港、空港など）人々や商品などが国に入ったり出たりする場所。
words.example: Could you tell me the way to the port?

words.englishDefinition: (American football) the act of catching a pass in football
words.japaneseExplanation: フットボールで、パスを受ける行為。
words.example: Can you return the keys to the reception desk?

words.englishDefinition: someone who works with you
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ職場で働く人。co-worker とも書く。
words.example: My coworker showed me how to use the printer.

words.englishDefinition: A red or brown oxide coating on iron or steel caused by the action of oxygen and moisture
words.japaneseExplanation: 酸素と湿気の作用で鉄や鋼鉄の表面に生じる、赤色または茶色の酸化物。
words.example: How bad this rust really is?

words.englishDefinition: An active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体運動と競い合いを要づる活動的な娯楽。
words.example: Athletics are an important part of school life.

words.japanese: 船旅、 (ゆったりした長い)旅
words.englishDefinition: An act of traveling by water
words.japaneseExplanation: 船により旅行する行為。
words.example: My life is a voyage of discovery.

words.japanese: 生態学者、環境保護論者
words.englishDefinition: A biologist who studies the relation between organisms and their environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体とその環境の関係を研究した生物学者。
words.example: The ecologist warned us that petroleum was not merely a blessing but also a curse.

words.englishDefinition: The immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の非肉体的部分。個人の生活の原動力となる。
words.example: I don't have a soul, and neither does anyone else.

words.englishDefinition: Being or feeling set or kept apart from others
words.japaneseExplanation: 他と離れて設置される、他との距離が保たれる存在または感覚。
words.example: Ziri felt more isolated than he ever had before.

words.englishDefinition: Favoring one person or side over another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のものより一人の人、あるいはもう一方を好むさま。
words.example: I know I have a biased opinion.

words.englishDefinition: Having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
words.japaneseExplanation: 一部、すべてまたは個人よりも持つ、かかわる、またはそれらで成り立つ。
words.example: I prefer learning multiple languages at the same time.

words.englishDefinition: A standard or model or pattern regarded as typical
words.japaneseExplanation: 典型的とされる水準、模範または見本。
words.example: That has become the norm.

words.japanese: 継続している、進行中の
words.englishDefinition: Currently happening
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在起こっている。
words.example: Our lives are an ongoing process.

words.englishDefinition: Having rugged physical strength; inured to fatigue or hardships
words.japaneseExplanation: 丈夫な体力を持つさま。疲労や困難に慣れる。
words.example: You'll have to ask my sturdy brother.

words.englishDefinition: Not endowed with authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 権限を持たない。
words.example: I don't want unauthorized pictures of me on people's social media.

words.englishDefinition: Communicated in the form of words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉の形で伝えられる。
words.example: Our society is held up by verbal communication.

words.japanese: 疲れ果てた、うんざりした
words.englishDefinition: very tired or bored with something
words.japaneseExplanation: とても疲れた状態や、うんざりした気持ち。
words.example: We felt weary after the long train journey.

words.englishDefinition: Being essentially equal to something
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的に何かと等しいさま。
words.example: How many yen are four dollars equivalent to?

words.englishDefinition: Possessing or displaying a distinctive feature to a heightened degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 際立った特徴を強く持つ、または誇示する。
words.example: How can I ignore pain this intense?

words.englishDefinition: Successive (without a break)
words.japaneseExplanation: 連続的な（連続して）。
words.example: Our team has lost two consecutive games.

words.englishDefinition: Undesirably noticeable
words.japaneseExplanation: 不快なほど目立つ。
words.example: It's noticeable how this isn't the first time you've done it.

words.englishDefinition: Of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis
words.japaneseExplanation: 極めて重要である。危機の解決に不可欠な。
words.example: I believe love is a crucial part of life.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or concerned with electricity
words.japaneseExplanation: 電気に関連があるか、に関係している。
words.example: We need an electrical engineer for this job.

words.englishDefinition: Having a sharp inclination
words.japaneseExplanation: 鋭く傾斜しているさま。
words.example: We walked carefully down the steep mountain path.

words.englishDefinition: Applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
words.japaneseExplanation: 軍隊とは対照的に普通の市民に適用するさま。
words.example: I will write him a civil answer.

words.englishDefinition: Greatest in status or authority or power
words.japaneseExplanation: 地位、権限または力が最も大きい。
words.example: What is the supreme being?

words.englishDefinition: A document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 述べられている事実が真実であることを証明する文書。
words.example: I wonder where I can use this gift certificate.

words.englishDefinition: A thief who enters a building with intent to steal
words.japaneseExplanation: 窃盗目的で建物に侵入する泥棒。
words.example: I thought you were a burglar.

words.englishDefinition: A ravine formed by a river in an area with little rainfall
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんど雨の降らない地域で、川によって作られた峡谷。
words.example: What really happened in the canyon?

words.englishDefinition: The property of enduring or continuing in time
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間の持続または継続の特性。
words.example: Can you sit through the duration?

words.englishDefinition: A structure from which an artificially produced jet of water arises
words.japaneseExplanation: 人工的に作った水の噴出がおきる構造。
words.example: We ran around the fountain in the park.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who has exceptional intellectual ability and originality
words.japaneseExplanation: ずば抜けた知的能力と独創性を持つ人。
words.example: You don't have to be a genius to know who said that.

words.englishDefinition: Land where grass or grasslike vegetation grows and is the dominant form of plant life
words.japaneseExplanation: 草、または草のような植物が育ち、植物の優性型である土地。
words.example: Ziri made it back to the grassland.

words.englishDefinition: A definite length of time marked off by two instants
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの瞬間によって区切られる一定の時間。
words.example: How many minutes does the interval last?

words.englishDefinition: The property of being long-lived
words.japaneseExplanation: 長命である特性。
words.example: The secret of longevity is to choose your parents carefully.

words.englishDefinition: How something is done or how it happens
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがされる方法またはそれが起こる方法。
words.example: You can choose between dark mode and light mode.

words.englishDefinition: A slender pointer for indicating the reading on the scale of a measuring instrument
words.japaneseExplanation: 計器の目盛りを読みを示すための細い針。
words.example: I sat on a needle.

words.englishDefinition: A person who brings order and organization to an enterprise
words.japaneseExplanation: 企業に順序と組織化をもたらさす人。
words.example: He was the organizer of the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: A practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)
words.japaneseExplanation: （演劇、演説、または、コンサートなどの）公演のための準備としての練習の集り。
words.example: We were busy talking about the rehearsal.

words.englishDefinition: A person working in the service of another (especially in the household)
words.japaneseExplanation: 他人の雑用のために働く人（特に家事において）。
words.example: Do you want to be my servant and follow me?

words.englishDefinition: The study and classification of human societies
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間社会の研究と分類。
words.example: The student is studying sociology.

words.englishDefinition: Something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight)
words.japaneseExplanation: ものあるいは人物（特に有名なあるいは珍しい光景）。
words.example: Don't make a spectacle of yourself crying in the street.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
words.japaneseExplanation: 間違いや欠点を見つけ、それらに注視する傾向に特徴的な。
words.example: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

words.englishDefinition: far from towns or other places where people live
words.japaneseExplanation: 町や人の住む場所から遠く離れていること。
words.example: My grandparents live in a remote mountain village.

words.englishDefinition: Furnishing support and encouragement
words.japaneseExplanation: 供給と激励を提供するさま。
words.example: You were encouraging this woman to love her husband.

words.englishDefinition: Conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods
words.japaneseExplanation: 隠された目的または方法で行われる、あるいは特徴とされる。
words.example: You can get to the station either by bus or underground.

words.englishDefinition: Resistant to change of position or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 位置または状態の変化に抵抗する。
words.example: I put the horse back in the stable yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation
words.japaneseExplanation: 国内部事情に関する、またはその関係の。
words.example: I prefer to buy domestic rather than foreign products.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking physical depth; having little spatial extension downward or inward from an outer surface or backward or outward from a center
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的な深さを欠く。外面からの下にまたは内に向かう、あるいは、中心から後方または外側へ向かう空間の延長がほとんどない。
words.example: I don't want to be shallow.

words.englishDefinition: Disposed or inclined toward
words.japaneseExplanation: 気が向いた、または傾向がある。
words.example: I can't pay you. Are you still willing to help?

words.englishDefinition: Of high or superior quality or performance
words.japaneseExplanation: 高い、あるいは優れた品質か性能の。
words.example: You think you're superior to me in every way.

words.englishDefinition: Yielding material gain or profit
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質的利益または利益を生む。
words.example: What you've done is profitable only to the enemy.

words.englishDefinition: Of good quality and condition; solidly built
words.japaneseExplanation: 品質と状態が良い。頑丈な造りの。
words.example: I got some solid sleep for the first time in a while.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、範囲、量、力、または程度が異常に大きい。
words.example: I think we had a tremendous year.

words.englishDefinition: Of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 心の活用の、に関連した、あるいは、を必要とする。
words.example: Do you consider yourself an intellectual?

words.englishDefinition: Most important element
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も重要な要素。
words.example: Our chief want in life is somebody who shall make us do what we can.

words.englishDefinition: Not solid; having a space or gap or cavity
words.japaneseExplanation: 固体でない。空間または隙間または空洞を持つこと。
words.example: I kept watch in the hollow of the rock.

words.englishDefinition: A group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status
words.japaneseExplanation: 上級の知的、社会的、または経済的地位を享受する人々の集まり、または階級。
words.example: You are now among the elite.

words.englishDefinition: Having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 左右に大きな（あるいは、特定の）範囲を持つさま。
words.example: We're driving down a straight, broad road.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or resulting from industry
words.japaneseExplanation: 産業の、産業に関する、または、産業がもたらす。
words.example: You think that your country is a great industrial power now, but you have a dark history.

words.englishDefinition: Related by common characteristics or ancestry
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通する特徴、または系統によって関連する。
words.example: When they allied with them, few allied with others.

words.englishDefinition: Happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface
words.japaneseExplanation: ある限度または表面を超えてまたはその外側に起きているまたは上がってきているまたは、位置している。
words.example: I can't believe you did all this without external help.

words.englishDefinition: Being nothing more than specified
words.japaneseExplanation: 指定されただけの。
words.example: You are no longer a mere child.

words.englishDefinition: Referring to the second of two things or persons mentioned (or the last one or ones of several)
words.japaneseExplanation: 取り上げられた2個の物や2人の人物のうちの2番目に関して（あるいは、数個のうちの最後の一つ、またはいくつか）。
words.example: I watch more movies than I read books, but I still prefer the latter.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to a president or presidency
words.japaneseExplanation: 大統領か大統領職に関するさま。
words.example: The presidential election of 1876 was very close.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the philosophical study of ethics
words.japaneseExplanation: 倫理の哲学の研究の、または、それに関して。
words.example: I don't think it would be ethical to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Aware or expressing awareness of things as they really are
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事を、本当にあると認識すること、あるいは認識を表現するさま。
words.example: Do you really think that your plans are realistic?

words.englishDefinition: Not causing or capable of causing harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 引き起こさないことあるいは、害を引き起こす能力がある。
words.example: I think that Tom is harmless.

words.englishDefinition: Being or involving basic facts or principles
words.japaneseExplanation: 基本的な事実、原則である、またはそれに関わるさま。
words.example: We still have to solve the underlying problem.

words.englishDefinition: Compelling immediate action
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊急行動を余儀なくさせる。
words.example: I need to talk to you about an urgent matter.

words.englishDefinition: provided without charge
words.japaneseExplanation: 料金を取らずにサービスとして提供されること。
words.example: The hotel provides a complimentary breakfast for all guests.

words.englishDefinition: Happening or arising or located within some limits or especially surface
words.japaneseExplanation: ある限定的領域または特に表面内で起きる、起こるまたは存在する。
words.example: This is for internal use.

words.englishDefinition: A specific form of evildoing
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪行の特定の形式。
words.example: He would leave the job to his vice president.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various fastenings formed by looping and tying a rope (or cord) upon itself or to another rope or to another object
words.japaneseExplanation: ロープ（またはひも）を輪にして、自身か別のロープ、または物体に結びつけて作る様々な締め具。
words.example: You tie a knot in it and that's it.

words.englishDefinition: An elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees (especially trees of the genera Hevea and Ficus) that can be vulcanized and finished into a variety of products
words.japaneseExplanation: いろいろな製品に加硫されることができ、仕上げられる木（特に属パラゴムノキとイチジク属の植物の木）のラテックス樹液から得られる弾力のある材料。
words.example: Do you want to buy a rubber ball?

words.englishDefinition: Any of numerous small celestial bodies composed of rock and metal that move around the sun (mainly between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter)
words.japaneseExplanation: 公転する（主に火星と木星の軌道の間で）岩石と金属で構成された多数の小天体のいずれか。
words.example: An asteroid is a bit of rock.

words.englishDefinition: A complex of concurrent things
words.japaneseExplanation: 同時に起こることの複合。
words.example: I have a child with Down syndrome.

words.englishDefinition: A state of being confined (usually for a short time)
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁されていること（通常、短期間）。
words.example: You can give me a detention if you have to.

words.englishDefinition: Psychological suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: 心理的苦痛。
words.example: I know that my mistake has caused you some distress.

words.englishDefinition: The mechanism that ignites the fuel in an internal-combustion engine
words.japaneseExplanation: 内燃エンジンで燃料に点火するメカニズム。
words.example: I pulled the key out of the ignition.

words.englishDefinition: The condition of being honored (esteemed or respected or well regarded)
words.japaneseExplanation: ほめ称えられていること（尊敬され、尊重され、敬意を払われていること）。
words.example: I have self-esteem problems because I don't know if I'm doing things well.

words.englishDefinition: Kindness in welcoming guests or strangers
words.japaneseExplanation: 客または見知らぬ人を歓迎する際の親切。
words.example: I hope I get the opportunity to return your hospitality.

words.englishDefinition: (law) a gift of personal property by will
words.japaneseExplanation: 遺志による個人財産の寄贈。
words.example: What will be my legacy?

words.englishDefinition: Mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神的に健康である。精神障害がない。
words.example: I think that Tom is sane.

words.englishDefinition: Open to doubt or suspicion
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑いまたは疑念を受けやすい。
words.example: We thought it doubtful whether it would clear soon.

words.englishDefinition: Encouraging or approving or pleasing
words.japaneseExplanation: 奨励するか、承認するか、または喜ばせる。
words.example: What favorable wind pushed you towards us?

words.englishDefinition: Willing to give and share unstintingly
words.japaneseExplanation: 惜しみなく与えて、共有することを望んでいる。
words.example: How generous you are to give me so much money.

words.englishDefinition: Not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 特にふるまいにおける変更または変化への対象ではない。
words.example: You need to find yourself a steady job.

words.englishDefinition: Morally bad or wrong
words.japaneseExplanation: 道徳的に悪い、または間違っているさま。
words.example: We believe in evil only once it has come.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to a coast
words.japaneseExplanation: 海岸の、または、海岸に関する。
words.example: A coastal road is to be built here.

words.japanese: ミルクから作られる、乳製品
