words.englishDefinition: milk products; made from milk
words.japaneseExplanation: 牛乳や、牛乳から作る乳製品を指す。
words.example: This shop sells dairy products such as milk and cheese.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or having the power to cause or promote digestion
words.japaneseExplanation: 消化に関する、消化を引き起こす力がある、または、消化を促進する力がある。
words.example: Your digestive system is as long as a bus.

words.englishDefinition: Steadfast in allegiance or duty
words.japaneseExplanation: 忠誠または任務において不動である。
words.example: You can trust him, he's a loyal friend.

words.englishDefinition: Of a nerve fiber or impulse originating outside and passing toward the central nervous system
words.japaneseExplanation: 外部で葉発生し、中枢神経系の方へ通っている神経繊維または衝撃の。
words.example: The sensory nerves send messages to the brain.

words.englishDefinition: Not plain; decorative or ornamented
words.japaneseExplanation: 質素でない。装飾的であるか飾られた。
words.example: Do you fancy going swimming with us this afternoon?

words.japanese: 台無しにする、甘やかす
words.englishDefinition: Treat with excessive indulgence
words.japaneseExplanation: 過度の甘さで扱う。
words.example: Do you want to spoil the best moment in my life?

words.englishDefinition: Act as a stimulant
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮剤として働く。
words.example: We must do everything we can to stimulate the economy.

words.englishDefinition: Draw someone's attention away from something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かの注意を何かから引き離す。
words.example: What could I do to distract myself from my problems?

words.englishDefinition: Negotiate the terms of an exchange
words.japaneseExplanation: 交換条件を交渉する。
words.example: We will bargain with him.

words.englishDefinition: Come out of
words.japaneseExplanation: 出てくる。
words.example: I hope that one day I will emerge from darkness.

words.japanese: 見て歩く、拾い読みする
words.englishDefinition: Shop around; not necessarily buying
words.japaneseExplanation: 買い物に回る。買うとは限らない。
words.example: You can browse through sentences.

words.englishDefinition: Known widely and usually unfavorably
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く、通常好ましくなく知られている。
words.example: Tom is well-known and notorious.

words.englishDefinition: very interested and excited to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをしたいと強く思い、楽しみにしていること。
words.example: The students are eager to try the new game.

words.englishDefinition: With relatively high volume
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較的高いボリュームで。
words.example: I spoke loudly so that everyone could hear me.

words.englishDefinition: In accordance with
words.japaneseExplanation: それに一致して。
words.example: I will deal with Tom accordingly.

words.englishDefinition: Now and then or here and there
words.japaneseExplanation: 時々、あちこち。
words.example: We will visit you occasionally.

words.englishDefinition: With no problems or difficulties
words.japaneseExplanation: 問題または困難なしで。
words.example: I do hope everything will go smoothly.

words.englishDefinition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
words.japaneseExplanation: それは、誠実に本当である。
words.example: I quite frankly don't know.

words.englishDefinition: Especially; in particular
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に。
words.example: I like the weather notably when there are no clouds in the sky.

words.englishDefinition: With unflagging resolve
words.japaneseExplanation: 不断の決意で。
words.example: You cannot get along with him because he speaks continuously.

words.englishDefinition: Force somebody to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に何かを強制する。
words.example: I won't compel you to do it.

words.englishDefinition: Mark as different
words.japaneseExplanation: 異なっていると強調される。
words.example: We need to distinguish right from wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Make more extreme; raise in quantity, degree, or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: より極端にする。量、程度または強さの増加。
words.example: The risk of fire is heightened in low-energy houses.

words.japanese: 台無しにする、駄目にする
words.englishDefinition: Destroy completely; damage irreparably
words.japaneseExplanation: 撃滅する。修復不可能なほど破損する。
words.example: You will ruin your health if you drink too much.

words.englishDefinition: Provide with (something) usually for a specific purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、特殊の目的で（何かを）備える。
words.example: Yanni needs to equip himself to be alone.

words.englishDefinition: Sell or transfer abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 海外に売る、または移動させる。
words.example: What would you like to export?

words.englishDefinition: Recurring again and again
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返されるさま。
words.example: Santiago had the same recurrent dream five times in a row.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring among or involving several people
words.japaneseExplanation: 数人の中で起こるか、関係するさま。
words.example: Tom has no interpersonal skills.

words.englishDefinition: Necessary or important, especially regarding food or commodities
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に食物または商品について重要で必要な。
words.example: Bread is a staple food.

words.englishDefinition: Tolerant and forgiving under provocation
words.japaneseExplanation: 挑発に対し、懐が深く寛容なさま。
words.example: I find your behavior very tolerant.

words.englishDefinition: People in general (often used in the plural)
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般大衆。
words.example: I don't want to hold hands with a boy in a folk dance.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by extreme anger
words.japaneseExplanation: 極端な怒りで、マークされる。
words.example: My dad is often furious because of his car.

words.englishDefinition: Humorously sarcastic or mocking
words.japaneseExplanation: ユーモラスに皮肉であるか嘲笑的な。
words.example: I don't like her ironic smile at all.

words.englishDefinition: Abnormally deficient in color as suggesting physical or emotional distress
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的または感情的な苦痛を示すように、異常に顔色が十分でない。
words.example: I think you should rest a bit. You look pale.

words.englishDefinition: Carrying developing offspring within the body or being about to produce new life
words.japaneseExplanation: 体に発達中の子供を持つ、または、新しい生命を作り出す。
words.example: My family need to know that you got me pregnant.

words.englishDefinition: Providing personal satisfaction
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人の満足感を提供する。
words.example: I find learning languages to be very rewarding.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of respect or dedication
words.japaneseExplanation: 尊敬または献身に値する。
words.example: If anything is to be called sacred, it's the human body.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に良い、または大きい。特に強意語として使用される。
words.example: I had a terrific day on Monday.

words.englishDefinition: (used of texts) shortened by condensing or rewriting
words.japaneseExplanation: （テキストについて使用され）凝縮するか、または書き直すことによって、短くされた。
words.example: This book is abridged from the original.

words.englishDefinition: Emitting or reflecting very little light
words.japaneseExplanation: 光をほとんど出さない、または反射しない。
words.example: My life would be very dull without books.

words.englishDefinition: Deficient in magnitude; barely perceptible; lacking clarity or brightness or loudness etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさが不十分。ほとんど知覚できない。
words.example: I suddenly stood up and felt faint and light-headed.

words.englishDefinition: Showing lack of care for consequences
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果に対する注意の欠如を示す。
words.example: I can't believe how irresponsible you are.

words.englishDefinition: Determine the essential quality of
words.japaneseExplanation: の重要な特質を測定する。
words.example: How would define this word?

words.englishDefinition: Alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確性を得るため、または基準に従うため変える、あるいは調節する。
words.example: Please adjust the seat to fit you.

words.englishDefinition: Be worthy or deserving
words.japaneseExplanation: それにふさわしい、あるいはそれに値する。
words.example: You deserve a break after all your hard work.

words.englishDefinition: Pass through
words.japaneseExplanation: 通り抜ける。
words.example: I want to undergo this change for my own well-being.

words.englishDefinition: Be in contradiction with
words.japaneseExplanation: 矛盾する。
words.example: I don't always contradict myself. But when I do, I don't.

words.englishDefinition: Remove (a commodity) from (a supply source)
words.japaneseExplanation: （供給源）から（必需品を）移動させる。
words.example: I need to go to the bank to withdraw money.

words.englishDefinition: Go or travel along with
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に行く、または動く。
words.example: I am not going to accompany the children to school.

words.englishDefinition: Contaminate with a disease or microorganism
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気または微生物で汚染する。
words.example: You're not going to infect me with an illness that doesn't exist.

words.englishDefinition: Take part in a rebellion; renounce a former allegiance
words.japaneseExplanation: 反逆に参加する。以前の忠誠を放棄する。
words.example: It is quite natural for young people to rebel against their parents.

words.englishDefinition: Change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy
words.japaneseExplanation: あるシステムからもう一つのまたは新らしい計画または制作へ変化する。
words.example: My parents tried to convert me to their way of thinking.

words.englishDefinition: Make a mathematical calculation or computation
words.japaneseExplanation: 数学的演算や計算をする。
words.example: I must calculate how much money I'll spend next week.

words.englishDefinition: Put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 業務に入れられる。特定の目的のために、または、それ固有のあるいは自然な目的のために仕事または雇用を作る。
words.example: I want you to utilize that object.

words.englishDefinition: Declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実であることを宣言するあるいは存在、現実あるいは真実を認める。
words.example: I have to admit that he is right.

words.englishDefinition: Impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
words.japaneseExplanation: 処罰を加える。処罰を課す。
words.example: We thought it wrong that you should punish him.

words.englishDefinition: Excrete perspiration through the pores in the skin
words.japaneseExplanation: 皮膚の気孔を通して汗を排出する。
words.example: I perspire a lot at night.

words.englishDefinition: Throw a glance at; take a brief look at
words.japaneseExplanation: 一瞥を投げる。ちょっとの間見る。
words.example: I just want to glance at the paper.

words.englishDefinition: Inform (somebody) of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを（誰か）に知らせる。
words.example: I will notify you of the result in one week.

words.japanese: 使いすぎる、やりすぎる
words.englishDefinition: Do something to an excessive degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを過度の度合いにする。
words.example: You have to be very careful not to overdo things.

words.englishDefinition: Cut or make a way through
words.japaneseExplanation: 横切る、または、通り抜ける。
words.example: I wouldn't let my daughter pierce her nose.

words.englishDefinition: Make too high an estimate of
words.japaneseExplanation: 高過ぎる見積りをする。
words.example: We cannot overestimate the value of health.

words.englishDefinition: Search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on
words.japaneseExplanation: 警告なしで創作し、突然の不意の攻撃を行う。
words.example: The police did not dare to raid.

words.englishDefinition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
words.example: Do you recall what happened last year on your birthday?

words.englishDefinition: Make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: より単純であるか簡単にする、あるいは複雑さまたは範囲を減らす。
words.example: We need to simplify our lives.

words.englishDefinition: Gather or contract into wrinkles or folds; pucker
words.japaneseExplanation: しわまたはひだを寄せる、もしくは、しわまたはひだに縮める。しわを寄せる。
words.example: Hang up your shirts before they wrinkle.

words.englishDefinition: Engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
words.japaneseExplanation: 構想を練ることに関わるあるいは陰謀に加わる、共に悪態をつく。
words.example: The world decided to conspire against me.

words.englishDefinition: Reproduce someone's behavior or looks
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の行動や外観を再現する。
words.example: You should imitate his behavior.

words.englishDefinition: Draw in (air)
words.japaneseExplanation: （空気を）吸い込む。
words.example: I don't like to inhale someone's smoke while I'm working.

words.englishDefinition: Make too high an estimate of
words.japaneseExplanation: 高過ぎる見積りをする。
words.example: He tended to overrate himself.

words.englishDefinition: Be understanding of
words.japaneseExplanation: を理解している。
words.example: I do sympathize with you.

words.englishDefinition: Admit (to a wrongdoing)
words.japaneseExplanation: 認める（不正に）。
words.example: I concede I was wrong about that.

words.englishDefinition: Impossible to resist; overpowering
words.japaneseExplanation: 耐えるのが不可能なさま。圧倒的なさま。
words.example: What do you find irresistible?

words.englishDefinition: requiring someone to obey an agreement or rule
words.japaneseExplanation: 契約や決定などに従う義務があること。
words.example: They signed a binding agreement before starting the project.

words.englishDefinition: Affected or marked by low spirits
words.japaneseExplanation: 落胆によって影響される、または特徴のある。
words.example: He looks sort of dejected.

words.englishDefinition: Formed or conceived by the imagination
words.japaneseExplanation: 想像力によって作られる、または考えだされる。
words.example: I provided him with a fictitious name.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by kindness and warm courtesy especially of a king to his subjects
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に王などのその家臣に対する親切な態度と温かい行為によって特徴づけられる。
words.example: I didn't know that you are such a gracious person.

words.japanese: やがて起ころうとしている
words.englishDefinition: Of the relatively near future
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較的近い将来の。
words.example: You should study for the upcoming test.

words.englishDefinition: Present in great quantity
words.japaneseExplanation: かなりの量で存在する。
words.example: Oil is abundant in that country.

words.englishDefinition: Press or grind with a crushing noise
words.japaneseExplanation: つぶすような音を伴って圧縮する、またはつぶす。
words.example: Please grind your teeth from left to right.

words.englishDefinition: Put into an archive
words.japaneseExplanation: アーカイブに入れられる。
words.example: Women don't forget: they archive.

words.englishDefinition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
words.example: We need to devise a plan.

words.englishDefinition: Be earlier in time; go back further
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間より早く。さらに戻る。
words.example: Words that don't precede actions are worthless.

words.englishDefinition: Fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
words.japaneseExplanation: 不安または恐怖でいっぱいになる。ぎょっとさせられる。
words.example: I was horrified by what she had said.

words.japanese: (苦情などを)申し立てる、宿泊する
words.englishDefinition: Put, fix, force, or implant
words.japaneseExplanation: 置くか、定着させるか、強制するか、または移植する。
words.example: I would lodge a complaint.

words.englishDefinition: Act between parties with a view to reconciling differences
words.japaneseExplanation: 違いを調停することをねらった党の間の行為。
words.example: He always tends to mediate in arguments between friends.

words.englishDefinition: To bring or combine together or with something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 一緒に、あるいは何か別のものを集める、組み合わせる。
words.example: Ziri didn't want to mingle with other people.

words.englishDefinition: Give sanction to
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可を与える。
words.example: I don't think that your parents would approve.

words.englishDefinition: to have something because of someone's help or influence
words.japaneseExplanation: owe A to B で、A は B のおかげだと表す。
words.example: I owe my success to my family's support.

words.englishDefinition: Move ahead; travel onward in time or space
words.japaneseExplanation: 進行する。時間または空間を前へ進む。
words.example: How do we have to proceed in this case?

words.englishDefinition: Travel on water propelled by wind or by other means
words.japaneseExplanation: 風または他の手段により推進されて水上を進む。
words.example: Do you know how to navigate?

words.englishDefinition: Hold back to a later time
words.japaneseExplanation: しばらく隠しておく。
words.example: We had to postpone the game because of rain.

words.englishDefinition: Pass through the esophagus as part of eating or drinking
words.japaneseExplanation: 飲食することの一部として、食道を通過する。
words.example: How is he going to swallow that bread?

words.englishDefinition: Adjust to a specific need or market
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の必要または市場に適応する。
words.example: I know that Tom isn't a very good tailor.

words.englishDefinition: Hear, usually without the knowledge of the speakers
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、話し手に知られずに聞く。
words.example: Do you think anyone will be able to overhear what we're talking about?

words.englishDefinition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
words.japaneseExplanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
words.example: I think it is not the cause but the consequence.

words.englishDefinition: a formal request or the form used to make it
words.japaneseExplanation: 許可や採用などを求める申し込み、またはその書類。
words.example: Please send your application before the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
words.japaneseExplanation: 健康を維持するための様々な方法での筋肉の鍛錬。
words.example: I feel good after a workout.

words.englishDefinition: Something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted
words.japaneseExplanation: 行く手をふさいでいる重要でないもので、回避するなり乗り越えるなりしなくてはならない。
words.example: We need to find a way to get around the obstacle.

words.englishDefinition: A written agreement between two states or sovereigns
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの国または元首間の書面による合意。
words.example: A few years later, the treaty was put to a test.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being clear of trees
words.japaneseExplanation: 木々を無くしている状態。
words.example: Algeria needs to reverse deforestation.

words.englishDefinition: Become deflated or flaccid, as by losing air
words.japaneseExplanation: 空気を失うかのように、しぼむか、たるんでいるようになる。
words.example: I didn't want to deflate his ego.

words.englishDefinition: Move smoothly and effortlessly
words.japaneseExplanation: スムーズに、そして楽に動く。
words.example: Ziri watched the birds glide through the air.

words.englishDefinition: Take away to an undisclosed location against their will and usually in order to extract a ransom
words.japaneseExplanation: 彼らの意志に反して、通常、身代金を引き出すために、明らかにされていない場所に奪い去る。
words.example: You thought you were going to kidnap the kid, didn't you?

words.japanese: つもりになる、〜するふりをする
words.englishDefinition: Make believe with the intent to deceive
words.japaneseExplanation: だます意図でふりをする。
words.example: You don't need to pretend that you still like me.

words.japanese: ことこと煮える、弱火で煮る
words.englishDefinition: Boil slowly at low temperature
words.japaneseExplanation: 低温でゆっくりゆでる。
words.example: Please simmer the beans for a while over a low heat.

words.englishDefinition: Become or cause to become soft or liquid
words.japaneseExplanation: やわらかくまたは液状になる、またはそのように仕向ける。
words.example: Salt is used to thaw ice.

words.englishDefinition: Develop or come to a promising stage
words.japaneseExplanation: 発達するか、伸び盛りの段階にくる。
words.example: I can't tell how things will unfold.

words.englishDefinition: Deprive of freedom; take into confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由を奪う。閉じ込める。
words.example: Don't let me detain you.

words.englishDefinition: Pierce with a pointed object; make a hole into
words.japaneseExplanation: 先のとがった物で突き通す。穴を作る。
words.example: My back tyre has a slow puncture.

words.englishDefinition: to prevent something from developing or succeeding
words.japaneseExplanation: ここでは比喩的に、発展や活動を強く妨げること。
words.example: Too many rules can strangle creativity in a classroom.

words.englishDefinition: A condition promoting sanitary practices
words.japaneseExplanation: 衛生の慣行を促進している状態。
words.example: Personal hygiene is important for everyone.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being kept down by unjust use of force or authority: "after years of oppression they finally revolted"
words.japaneseExplanation: 力や権力の不正な行使によって抑圧される状態。
words.example: The oppression of women is a social issue.

words.englishDefinition: Act of working jointly
words.japaneseExplanation: 共同で働く行為。
words.example: I would like to thank you for your collaboration.

words.englishDefinition: A sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo
words.japaneseExplanation: 船が貨物を積み込んだり、荷揚げしたり保護港。
words.example: We can see the harbor from here.

words.englishDefinition: A field of cultivated and mowed grass
words.japaneseExplanation: 栽培されて刈られた草の畑。
words.example: I water our lawn several times a week.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to become detached or separated; take off
words.japaneseExplanation: 分離されるか、切り離させる。離す。
words.example: Ziri wanted to detach the ivy from the fence.

words.englishDefinition: Be a hindrance or obstacle to
words.japaneseExplanation: 障害または障害である。
words.example: There is nothing to hinder me.

words.englishDefinition: Be unsure or weak
words.japaneseExplanation: 不確かである、または弱い。
words.example: We will also not waver in our values and our principles as a nation.

words.englishDefinition: Elaborate, as of theories and hypotheses
words.japaneseExplanation: の理論と仮説のように精巧な。
words.example: We have to formulate a plan if we are to save her!

words.englishDefinition: Give out (breath or an odor)
words.japaneseExplanation: （呼吸または匂い）が衰える。
words.example: If you can see your breath when you exhale, you know it's cold.

words.englishDefinition: Spring back; spring away from an impact
words.japaneseExplanation: 後ろに跳ねる。衝撃から跳び離れる。
words.example: Algeria's economy is expected to rebound next year.

words.englishDefinition: Make happy or satisfied
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸せにする、または満足させる。
words.example: We wanted to gratify Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Promise solemnly and formally
words.japaneseExplanation: 厳粛に、かつ正式に約束する。
words.example: I pledge you, I pledge myself, to a new deal for the American people.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be firmly attached
words.japaneseExplanation: しっかりと付けさせる。
words.example: Please fasten your seat belt.

words.englishDefinition: Pass along
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝える。
words.example: I need you to relay some information for me.

words.englishDefinition: Place in a line or arrange so as to be parallel or straight
words.japaneseExplanation: 平行または直線になるように線状に並べ、調整する。
words.example: We can use braces to align your teeth better.

words.englishDefinition: Travel up, "We ascended the mountain"
words.japaneseExplanation: 上昇する。
words.example: Ziri continued to ascend the mountain.

words.englishDefinition: Look at with fixed eyes
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された視線で見る。
words.example: I gaze up at the sky.

words.englishDefinition: Love intensely
words.japaneseExplanation: 情熱的に愛する。
words.example: I just adore your new hat.

words.englishDefinition: Make cool or cooler
words.japaneseExplanation: 涼しいかより涼しくする。
words.example: I need to find people to chill with.

words.englishDefinition: Form an arch or curve
words.japaneseExplanation: アーチまたはカーブを形成する。
words.example: How do you make the ball curve like that?

words.englishDefinition: The basic structure or features of a system or organization
words.japaneseExplanation: システムや組織の基本構造か特徴。
words.example: Algeria still has some way to go on the infrastructure front.

words.englishDefinition: The part played by a person in bringing about a result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果をもたらすためにある人によって担われた役割。
words.example: I believe you have not yet made a contribution.

words.englishDefinition: Excessive accumulation of blood or other fluid in a body part
words.japaneseExplanation: 血液などの体液が体の一部に過剰に蓄積すること。
words.example: We were delayed by traffic congestion, so we had to hurry.

words.englishDefinition: The act of subjecting someone to an influencing experience
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響を及ぼすような経験を人にさせる行為。
words.example: Getting that exposure to another language at an early age is definitely important.

words.englishDefinition: A powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon
words.japaneseExplanation: 拳や武器で力まかせに殴ること。
words.example: You can't just blow me off like that.

words.englishDefinition: The act of sharing in the activities of a group
words.japaneseExplanation: グループの活動に参加する行為。
words.example: We need to change over to a different system of participation.

words.englishDefinition: An unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に危険あるいは困難な、不安定な状態。
words.example: How can we get past this crisis?

words.englishDefinition: Someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が系統を引く（通常、祖父母よりも遠い）人。
words.example: How do you know your ancestors even lived where you do now?

words.englishDefinition: Someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か（建物など）を作成するために使用される設計図を作る人。
words.example: I was an architect before you were born.

words.englishDefinition: The state or fact of existing
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在する状態または事実。
words.example: We must accept our existence as far as possible.

words.englishDefinition: A partial payment made at the time of purchase; the balance to be paid later
words.japaneseExplanation: 購入時に支払われる一部支払い金。後で支払われるべき残額。
words.example: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.

words.englishDefinition: The commercial activity of providing funds and capital
words.japaneseExplanation: 基金や資本を供給する商業活動。
words.example: How did you get interested in finance?

words.englishDefinition: Having knowledge of
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識を持つこと。
words.example: You have to practice self-awareness.

words.englishDefinition: An opening through which fluid is admitted to a tube or container
words.japaneseExplanation: 流体が管や容器に入る開口部。
words.example: You won't lose weight unless you cut back on your food intake.

words.englishDefinition: An occurrence that involves the production of a union
words.japaneseExplanation: 組合の発生を含む出来事。
words.example: Everyone coming together is an example of fusion.

words.englishDefinition: A person who travels by foot
words.japaneseExplanation: 徒歩で旅行する人。
words.example: I try to use the pedestrian bridge in order to exercise.

words.englishDefinition: Discriminatory or abusive behavior towards members of another race
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかの人種に対する差別的、または侮蔑的な振る舞い。
words.example: We have to stand up against racism.

words.englishDefinition: The top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの頂点または極点（通常山または丘）。
words.example: I reached the summit of the mountain in exactly five hours.

words.englishDefinition: A minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
words.japaneseExplanation: 微小生命体（特に病気をもたらすバクテリア）。その語は専門的には使われない。
words.example: I think I caught a bug over the weekend.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being covered with unclean things
words.japaneseExplanation: 清潔でない物に覆われている状態。
words.example: Do you like playing in the dirt?

words.japanese: 妊産婦の、母であること
words.englishDefinition: The state of being pregnant; the period from conception to birth when a woman carries a developing fetus in her uterus
words.japaneseExplanation: 妊娠していることの状態。女性が発育中の胎児を子宮で続ける場合の、受胎からの出産までの期間。
words.example: Did you give birth at home or at a maternity hospital?

words.englishDefinition: A sudden loss of consciousness resulting when the rupture or occlusion of a blood vessel leads to oxygen lack in the brain
words.japaneseExplanation: 血管の破裂や閉塞で脳の酸素が欠乏し、突然意識を失うこと。
words.example: My father had a stroke, but he's OK now.

words.englishDefinition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
words.japaneseExplanation: 出来事の行為、発生、詳細、進行を伝えるメッセージ。文書、劇、映画の中で、あるいはラジオまたはテレビの番組として示さた。
words.example: No one has ever been there and lived to tell the tale.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being certain
words.japaneseExplanation: 確かである状態。
words.example: I can't answer your question with any certainty.

words.englishDefinition: A lack of balance or state of disequilibrium
words.japaneseExplanation: 不均衡なこと。
words.example: There's a glaring imbalance between the costs and results.

words.englishDefinition: The relative frequency of occurrence of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事が起こる相対的な頻度。
words.example: Excuse me, sir, but is this an incidence of road rage?

words.englishDefinition: A concavity in a surface (especially an anatomical depression)
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面のくぼみ（特に解剖学上のくぼみ）。
words.example: How deep is this pit?

words.englishDefinition: The feel of a surface or a fabric
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面または布地の感触。
words.example: I like the texture of this towel.

words.englishDefinition: The thick short innermost digit of the forelimb
words.japaneseExplanation: 前肢の太く短い最も内側の指。
words.example: I hurt my thumb real bad.

words.englishDefinition: Breaking of hard tissue such as bone
words.japaneseExplanation: 骨のような硬い組識が壊れること。
words.example: You have a fracture, that is to say a broken bone.

words.englishDefinition: Close in; darkness enclosed him"
words.japaneseExplanation: 閉じ込める。暗闇は、彼を囲んだ。
words.example: I have enclosed your order form.

words.englishDefinition: Go or come after and bring or take back
words.japaneseExplanation: 後を追って行く、または追って来て、引き戻す、あるいは連れ戻す。
words.example: My mother asked me if I could fetch some milk.

words.englishDefinition: Declare formally; declare someone to be something; of titles
words.japaneseExplanation: 正式に宣言する。誰かを何かであると宣言する。
words.example: Yanni continued to proclaim his innocence.

words.englishDefinition: to create a strong relationship or agreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係や協力体制などを努力して築くこと。
words.example: The project helped us forge new friendships.

words.englishDefinition: An unrestrained expression of emotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 抑え切れなくなった感情を表現すること。
words.example: What was the point of that outburst?

words.englishDefinition: The magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の方向（特に長さ、幅または高さ）の何かの大きさ。
words.example: My soul is not human as it is from another dimension.

words.englishDefinition: A moving crowd
words.japaneseExplanation: 動く群集。
words.example: A swarm of insects hit the windows.

words.englishDefinition: Something that follows something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 別なものの後に続くこと。
words.example: I'm looking forward to the sequel of this film.

words.englishDefinition: A man-made object taken as a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体と見なされる人工の物体。
words.example: I heard they found an alien artifact on the moon.

words.englishDefinition: The feeling that motivates compassion
words.japaneseExplanation: 同情を誘う気持ち。
words.example: I am at your mercy.

words.englishDefinition: A person who follows next in order
words.japaneseExplanation: 順序において次に続く人。
words.example: I want to leave things in good order for my successor.

words.englishDefinition: A successful ending of a struggle or contest
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦いや競争が成功裏に終わること。
words.example: Our team came home in triumph.

words.englishDefinition: A separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
words.japaneseExplanation: （法令、契約書、遺言書のような）法律上の文書の独立した節。
words.example: We need to modify how the clause is written.

words.englishDefinition: Drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
words.japaneseExplanation: 何らかの点での類似性を示すために比較する。
words.example: I don't understand the analogy.

words.englishDefinition: Failure that results in a loss of position or reputation
words.japaneseExplanation: 地位や名声を失うことになった失敗。
words.example: Sami's plan was his downfall.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who sees an event and reports what happened
words.japaneseExplanation: 事件を目撃し、何が起こったかを知らせる人。
words.example: I am a witness to what happened.

words.englishDefinition: The news as presented by reporters for newspapers or radio or television
words.japaneseExplanation: 新聞、ラジオ、テレビ用に記者が提出するようなニュース。
words.example: Tom's stopped watching the news because the constant war coverage was getting him down.

words.englishDefinition: A comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人が法的救済を求める裁判手続きを総括的に指す言葉。
words.example: What is needed to win a lawsuit?

words.englishDefinition: A meeting for execution of a group's functions
words.japaneseExplanation: グループの機能の実行のための会議。
words.example: Can you meet me after school for a study session?

words.englishDefinition: How a result is obtained or an end is achieved
words.japaneseExplanation: いかにして、ある結果が得られたり、ある目的が達成されたりするかということ。
words.example: I can't tell you how much this means to me.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who helps to open up a new line of research or technology or art
words.japaneseExplanation: 研究または技術あるいは芸術の新しいラインの開拓を支援する人。
words.example: I don't feel like a pioneer.

words.englishDefinition: The contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを申し分なくやり終えた時に感じる満足。
words.example: I trust the room will be to your satisfaction.

words.englishDefinition: The fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが開始されるか、開発されるか、計算されるか、または説明される根本的な仮定。
words.example: What is the basis for the argument?

words.englishDefinition: An abstract part of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの抽象的な部分。
words.example: The key to success is the element of surprise.

words.englishDefinition: Any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
words.japaneseExplanation: 直感や推理よりも感覚を通じて知る状態や過程。
words.example: We have never managed to explain that phenomenon.

words.englishDefinition: Relative magnitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 相対振幅。
words.example: How happy are you on a scale of one to ten?

words.englishDefinition: A periodical dedicated to a particular subject
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の話題専用の定期刊行物。
words.example: I could write in my journal for a while.

words.englishDefinition: Foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses
words.japaneseExplanation: 穀草のでんぷん質の穀物で作られる食糧。
words.example: I take what he says with a grain of salt.

words.englishDefinition: One of the large landmasses of the earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の大きな広大な土地のうちの1つ。
words.example: What is the continent with the most people living on it in the world?

words.englishDefinition: An examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 死因、または病変を確定するため、死体を調べたり解剖したりすること。
words.example: I'd like to do an autopsy on this body.

words.englishDefinition: A university student who has not yet received a first degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大学のまだ第一学位を受けていない生徒。
words.example: The undergraduate library is that way.

words.englishDefinition: The trait of utilizing knowledge and experience with common sense and insight
words.japaneseExplanation: 良識と見識とともに、知識と経験を役立たせる特性。
words.example: I had one of my wisdom teeth pulled out last week.

words.englishDefinition: A woman who has recently been married
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚したばかりの女性。
words.example: I will bring my son a bride with blue eyes.

words.englishDefinition: A ruler who is unconstrained by law
words.japaneseExplanation: 法に拘束されない支配者。
words.example: Do you think that I'm a dictator?

words.englishDefinition: Your name written in your own handwriting
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の手書きで書いた自分の名前。
words.example: Please return one set to us with your signature.

words.englishDefinition: Strong evidence for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに関する有力な証拠。
words.example: You are a testament to the power of quiet resilience.

words.englishDefinition: a file sent together with an email
words.japaneseExplanation: 電子メールに付けて送るファイル。
words.example: I sent the photos as an attachment to my email.

words.englishDefinition: A man who has never been married
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚したことのいない男性。
words.example: How was the bachelor party?

words.englishDefinition: a small raised area of skin filled with liquid
words.japaneseExplanation: 皮膚に液体がたまって膨らんだ水ぶくれ。
words.example: My new shoes gave me a blister on my heel.

words.englishDefinition: A war measure that isolates some area of importance to the enemy
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵に対する重要性の若干の地域を孤立させる戦時措置。
words.example: I am not hindered by the blockade on the street.

words.englishDefinition: One of the dwelling units in a condominium
words.japaneseExplanation: 分譲住宅の住戸の1つ。
words.example: They live on the 12th floor of this condo.

words.englishDefinition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
words.example: We paid an invoice of more than one thousand dollars.

words.englishDefinition: Time available for ease and relaxation
words.japaneseExplanation: くつろぎとリラックスのための時間。
words.example: What do they do with all their leisure time?

words.englishDefinition: Continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature
words.japaneseExplanation: 深い対象、あるいは一連の対象、あるいは難解である本質についての継続的で、深い熟考または黙想。
words.example: My father sat deep in meditation with his eyes closed.

words.englishDefinition: An explosion (as of dynamite)
words.japaneseExplanation: （ダイナマイトのような）爆発。
words.example: I had a blast at the party last night.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is a source of danger
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険の源であるもの。
words.example: These people see us as a menace.

words.englishDefinition: An unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating
words.japaneseExplanation: 邪魔をするあるいは妨げる不運な出来事。邪魔をしている、またはいらいらさせる何か。
words.example: I don't think that this is a setback.

words.englishDefinition: Understanding and entering into another's feelings
words.japaneseExplanation: もう一人の感情を理解し、感情移入すること。
words.example: Show empathy towards others' feelings.

words.englishDefinition: A sudden drop from an upright position
words.japaneseExplanation: 立っている姿勢からの突然倒れること。
words.example: I took a really serious tumble.

words.englishDefinition: The length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference
words.japaneseExplanation: 円の中心点を通り、円周上の2点をつなぐ直線の長さ。
words.example: The lake has a diameter of 3 miles.

words.englishDefinition: An impelling force or strength
words.japaneseExplanation: 推進する力または強さ。
words.example: How do you keep the momentum going?

words.englishDefinition: A group of soldiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 軍人のグループ。
words.example: We saw a troop of monkeys moving from tree to tree.

words.englishDefinition: A retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold
words.japaneseExplanation: 薬品やその他の商品が売られている小売り店。
words.example: I need medicine. Where is the pharmacy?

words.englishDefinition: A situation resembling a terrifying dream
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪夢に似た状況。
words.example: I hope this dream is not a nightmare.

words.englishDefinition: An elevated geological formation
words.japaneseExplanation: 隆起した地形。
words.example: I ran down the slope.

words.englishDefinition: A slowly moving mass of ice
words.japaneseExplanation: ゆっくりと動く氷塊。
words.example: The glacier is moving slowly.

words.englishDefinition: Something that causes great unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな不幸を引き起こすもの。
words.example: I can't share my grief with anyone.

words.englishDefinition: A state of ill-being due to affliction or misfortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 苦悩や不運による悪い状態。
words.example: I can’t hide my misery.

words.englishDefinition: The usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
words.japaneseExplanation: ある特定の人々に固有の語の使い方や語彙。
words.example: I can tell by his accent that he is German.

words.englishDefinition: A diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another
words.japaneseExplanation: 最高位の外交官。ある国から別の国への代表として信任される。
words.example: I will soon be named ambassador.

words.englishDefinition: to continue for a period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: ある時間の間、続くこと。to は不定詞の印。
words.example: The meeting will last about an hour.

words.englishDefinition: Have an effect upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響を及ぼす。
words.example: We must not allow these problems to affect the project.

words.japanese: と主張する、を要求する
words.englishDefinition: Assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing
words.japaneseExplanation: 強く断言する、または主張する。真実または存在する状態。
words.example: I claim that is not true.

words.englishDefinition: Transport commercially
words.japaneseExplanation: 営利目的で輸送する。
words.example: You will ship the book before Monday.

words.englishDefinition: Make out and issue
words.japaneseExplanation: 作り上げて、発行する。
words.example: Please tell me what you know about that issue.

words.japanese: 行するを買う、購入する
words.englishDefinition: Obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction
words.japaneseExplanation: 購入によって得る。金融取引によって取得する。
words.example: We will purchase a new car next week.

words.englishDefinition: Come to pass
words.japaneseExplanation: 起こる。
words.example: I don't expect that to occur.

words.englishDefinition: Act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression
words.japaneseExplanation: 口頭で、あるいは何か芸術的な表現で行う。
words.example: We all need to learn to deal with this situation.

words.japanese: うを消費する、を使い果たす
words.englishDefinition: Use up (resources or materials)
words.japaneseExplanation: （資源または材料）使い果たす。
words.example: I am not allowed to consume sugar.

words.japanese: 果たすを提示する、を進呈する
words.englishDefinition: Bring forward and present to the mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 持ち出して、心に現れる。
words.example: We cannot continue our conversation while those people are present.

words.englishDefinition: Terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事を終了する。職務またはポジションから解放する。
words.example: I think that the boss is going to fire Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Deem to be
words.japaneseExplanation: そうであると考える。
words.example: Do you know what I think in this regard?

words.englishDefinition: to make someone pay money as a punishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 違反した人に罰金を支払わせること。
words.example: The city can fine drivers for parking here.

words.englishDefinition: Transfer somebody to a different position or location of work
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かを仕事での異なるポジションまたは場所へ転勤させる。
words.example: I haven't got any money on me, but I can transfer.

words.japanese: を産出する、譲る、屈する
words.englishDefinition: Give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 引き渡す。他の物理的コントロールに対して、引き渡す、または放棄する。
words.example: We had to yield to their request.

words.japanese: を感知する、を見つける
words.englishDefinition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
words.japaneseExplanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
words.example: Our eyes can detect light.

words.japanese: けるを撲滅しようとする、と交戦する
words.englishDefinition: Battle or contend against in or as if in a battle
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦う、または戦いであるかのように敵対する。
words.example: How can we combat climate change?

words.japanese: （問題などを）引き起こす、提起する
words.englishDefinition: Introduce
words.japaneseExplanation: 発表する。
words.example: I don't pose a danger to myself or to others.

words.englishDefinition: To stress, single out as important
words.japaneseExplanation: 強調するために、重要であるとして選び出す。
words.example: I was born to emphasize out my difference from most other people.

words.japanese: を強調する、を目立たせる
words.englishDefinition: Move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent
words.japaneseExplanation: もっとよく見えるようにまたははっきりとするように前部に移動する。
words.example: I was born to highlight my difference among all other people.

words.englishDefinition: Stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何かに対して立ち上がりまたは抵抗する。
words.example: I don't know if I can resist anymore.

words.englishDefinition: Be greater in scope or size than some standard
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲や大きさが基準より大きい。
words.example: I exceed you in height.

words.englishDefinition: Move or establish in a new location
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい場所で移動するまたは設立する。
words.example: Rent is too high, so we've decided to relocate the store.

words.japanese: 誤りを証明する、の反証を挙げる
words.englishDefinition: Prove to be false
words.japaneseExplanation: 偽りであることを示す。
words.example: Inability to disprove a theory does not mean it is right.

words.englishDefinition: Move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
words.japaneseExplanation: ゆっくり動く。地面の近くに体がある人や動物の場合において。
words.example: I just want to crawl into bed and get some sleep.

words.japanese: を促進する、 (里子として)育てる
words.englishDefinition: Help develop, help grow
words.japaneseExplanation: 発展を助ける、または成長を助ける。
words.example: How did you end up in foster care?

words.japanese: して)育てるを絶えず悩ます、を苦しめる
words.englishDefinition: Annoy continually or chronically
words.japaneseExplanation: 継続的に、または慢性的に悩ます。
words.example: I don't want you to harass them.

words.japanese: 苦しめるを拡大する、を誇張する
words.englishDefinition: To enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
words.japaneseExplanation: 限界または真実を越えて拡大する。
words.example: Is not a helping life ten times magnified?

words.englishDefinition: Put, bring, or take in a secretive or furtive manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 秘密またはひそかな方法で置く、持ち込むまたは受け入れる。
words.example: I told you not to sneak up on me like that.

words.englishDefinition: Develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control
words.japaneseExplanation: 指導と演習により（子供たちのもの）素行を発達させる。特に自制を教えること。
words.example: Sami isn't allowed to discipline my kids.

words.englishDefinition: Make unrecognizable
words.japaneseExplanation: 認識不可能にする。
words.example: You can't disguise sad eyes.

words.japanese: を抑制する、を制御する
words.englishDefinition: Lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits
words.japaneseExplanation: 強度を減じる。調節する。
words.example: Please give me some kind of medicine to curb the pain.

words.englishDefinition: Keep under control; keep in check
words.japaneseExplanation: 支配下においておく。抑制しておく。
words.example: We need to learn to restrain ourselves.

words.englishDefinition: Walk unsteadily
words.japaneseExplanation: よたよた歩く。
words.example: She walked carefully so as not to stumble over a rock.

words.englishDefinition: Decrease in size, extent, or range
words.japaneseExplanation: サイズ、または範囲を縮小する。
words.example: This doesn't give him the right to diminish Muslims.

words.japanese: 回転する(させる)、循環する
words.englishDefinition: Turn on or around an axis or a center
words.japaneseExplanation: 軸または中心で、あるいは軸または中心の周りで回転する。
words.example: How long does it usually take to rotate tires?

words.englishDefinition: Make more compact by or as if by pressing
words.japaneseExplanation: 圧迫することによりあるいは圧迫するかのようによりコンパクトにする。
words.example: You can use a program to compress the file.

words.englishDefinition: Convert code into ordinary language
words.japaneseExplanation: コードを普通の言語に変換する。
words.example: I need the key to decode this message.

words.englishDefinition: Compensate for or counterbalance
words.japaneseExplanation: 相殺するか、釣り合いを取る。
words.example: Is there any way to offset those costs?

words.englishDefinition: Propose a payment
words.japaneseExplanation: 支払いを申し出る。
words.example: I went to the airport to bid my friend goodbye.

words.englishDefinition: Burst outward, usually with noise
words.japaneseExplanation: 外側に破裂する、通常騒音を伴う。
words.example: My head feels like it's going to burst.

words.japanese: を追い越す、に追いつく
words.englishDefinition: Travel past
words.japaneseExplanation: そばを通過する。
words.example: I have to overtake him to win.

words.englishDefinition: Hold back within
words.japaneseExplanation: 取っておく。
words.example: We had to retain a lawyer.

words.englishDefinition: Make a place messy by strewing garbage around
words.japaneseExplanation: ゴミをばらまくことで場所を乱雑にする。
words.example: How often should I change the cat litter?

words.englishDefinition: Command against
words.japaneseExplanation: 反対する命令を出す。
words.example: You can't prohibit me from doing that.

words.englishDefinition: Refuse to accept
words.japaneseExplanation: 辞退する。
words.example: I intend to decline his offer to help me.

words.englishDefinition: Terminate, end, or take out
words.japaneseExplanation: 終わらせるか、途切れさせるか、取り除く。
words.example: You can't go back into the past to eliminate yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所、方向、人、または物事を指す。空間的または比喩的に。
words.example: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.

words.japanese: ということを確実にする
words.englishDefinition: Be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かするように注意するか、確実にする。何かを確かめる。
words.example: I want to ensure he feels comfortable talking about it.

words.englishDefinition: Extend in one or more directions
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つまたはそれ以上の方向に伸ばす。
words.example: Our company wants to expand into a new market.

words.englishDefinition: Act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression
words.japaneseExplanation: 口頭で、あるいは何か芸術的な表現で行う。
words.example: We need to address the problem right away.

words.englishDefinition: Recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在しているものとして認識する。人や物の独自性を確立する。
words.example: I don't want to identify myself with that group.

words.japanese: 建設する、を組み立てる
words.englishDefinition: Make by combining materials and parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料および部品を合成して作る。
words.example: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.

words.englishDefinition: Make an investment
words.japaneseExplanation: 投資を行う。
words.example: I want to invest a little money every month.

words.englishDefinition: Come into possession of
words.japaneseExplanation: その所有となる。
words.example: You just wanted to become my friend to obtain information.

words.japanese: 懸命に努力する、奮闘する
words.englishDefinition: Make a strenuous or labored effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 懸命であるか非常な努力をする。
words.example: You don't have to struggle.

words.englishDefinition: Speak in response
words.japaneseExplanation: それに応じて話す。
words.example: I work at an information counter at the airport.

words.englishDefinition: Make a logical or causal connection
words.japaneseExplanation: 論理的であるか因果関係を作る。
words.example: My sister doesn't wish to associate with them.

words.englishDefinition: Indicate a certain reading; of gauges and instruments
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の示度を指し示す。ゲージと器具の。
words.example: You need to register by Monday.

words.englishDefinition: A short trip that is taken in the performance of a necessary task or mission
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な仕事や任務の遂行のための短い旅。
words.example: I have an errand to do in town.

words.englishDefinition: Move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば食物や雇用を求めて目的地なしに、あるいは目的なしに動きまわる。
words.example: I will never stray from my path.

words.englishDefinition: Grow worse
words.japaneseExplanation: 悪くなる。
words.example: These problems are likely to worsen over time.

words.englishDefinition: Push for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを要求する。
words.example: He uses his voice to advocate for those in need.

words.englishDefinition: Move out of an unsafe location into safety
words.japaneseExplanation: 安全でない場所から安全なところへ移動する。
words.example: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.

words.englishDefinition: Check or regulate (a scientific experiment) by conducting a parallel experiment or comparing with another standard
words.japaneseExplanation: 並列実験を行なうか、別の基準と比較することにより、（科学実験を）確認、または調整する。
words.example: You have no way to verify it.

words.englishDefinition: Treat badly
words.japaneseExplanation: 下手に扱う。
words.example: I get more than my fair share of abuse.

words.englishDefinition: Distribute loosely
words.japaneseExplanation: 緩く分布する。
words.example: Where did you scatter them?

words.englishDefinition: Be behind; approve of
words.japaneseExplanation: 支持者である。承認する。
words.example: We certainly don't endorse that.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
words.japaneseExplanation: 変化させる。変える。
words.example: How can I modify what’s happening now?

words.englishDefinition: Pass into or through, often by overcoming resistance
words.japaneseExplanation: 抵抗を克服してつき通す。
words.example: She let me penetrate her.

words.englishDefinition: Adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい異なった状況に順応するまたは対応させる。
words.example: We must conform to the rules.

words.englishDefinition: The period of time during which you are absent from work or duty
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事または義務を離れる期間。
words.example: What time do you usually leave for work?

words.englishDefinition: Part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of cells having a similar structure and function
words.japaneseExplanation: 同種の構造と機能を持つ細胞の集合から成る器官の一部。
words.example: Do you have a tissue for me?

words.englishDefinition: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus
words.japaneseExplanation: 胃と肛門の間の消化管の部分。
words.example: I don't know why I didn't follow my gut feelings.

words.englishDefinition: A solemn statement made under oath
words.japaneseExplanation: 宣言の元で発表された厳粛な声明。
words.example: My testimony can't be bought.

words.englishDefinition: To cover or extend over an area or time period
words.japaneseExplanation: 地域または期間をカバーするあるいは、に広がる。
words.example: I asked him to sweep the floor.

words.englishDefinition: Issue commands or orders for
words.japaneseExplanation: コマンドまたは命令を出す。
words.example: You write what I dictate.

words.englishDefinition: Give an injection to
words.japaneseExplanation: 注射をする。
words.example: What did they inject you with?

words.englishDefinition: Push for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを要求する。
words.example: We urge you to be patient.

words.englishDefinition: Imitate (a person or manner), especially for satirical effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に皮肉な効果のために、模倣する（人または方法）。
words.example: She can mimic the teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば食物や雇用を求めて目的地なしに、あるいは目的なしに動きまわる。
words.example: My cat likes to roam at night.

words.englishDefinition: Estimate the value of (property) for taxation
words.japaneseExplanation: 課税のために（資産の）価値を査定する。
words.example: I need to assess the damage.

words.englishDefinition: Show off
words.japaneseExplanation: 見せびらかす。
words.example: I have nothing to boast about.

words.englishDefinition: Pull, as against a resistance
words.japaneseExplanation: 引く、抵抗に対して。
words.example: I had to drag him out of bed.

words.englishDefinition: Make repayment for or return something
words.japaneseExplanation: 返済する、または何かを返す。
words.example: I only wish there was some way I could repay you.

words.englishDefinition: Cause the downfall of; of rulers
words.japaneseExplanation: 急激な転落を引き起こす。統治者の。
words.example: Tom wants to overthrow the government.

words.englishDefinition: Put in effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 実施する。
words.example: I need time to fulfill my dreams.

words.englishDefinition: Decree or designate beforehand
words.japaneseExplanation: あらかじめ命じるか、指定する。
words.example: What would driving a car be without doom metal?

words.englishDefinition: Keep company with; hang out with
words.japaneseExplanation: 付き合う。屯する。
words.example: Why did you decide to affiliate yourself with Company A?

words.englishDefinition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
words.example: He probably went to assault someone.

words.englishDefinition: Make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前数人の人のみに知られていた、または機密にされていたことを意味する公開情報を明らかにする。
words.example: I want to reveal my secret to you.

words.englishDefinition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
words.japaneseExplanation: 異種交配できる分類群。
words.example: I had never before seen this species of fish.

words.englishDefinition: A prescribed selection of foods
words.japaneseExplanation: 選択を指示された食事。
words.example: I have to lose weight, so I'm on a diet.

words.englishDefinition: The piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがある（予定の）土地の区画。
words.example: I just started using this site a little while ago.

words.englishDefinition: A small room in a prison; the word can also mean the basic unit of a living thing or a device that produces electricity.
words.japaneseExplanation: 刑務所の小さな独房。ほかに、生物の細胞や電池という意味もあります。
words.example: We won't be able to get out of this cell.

words.englishDefinition: A building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のサービスを提供する、または特定の産業に使用される建物あるいは場所。
words.example: First, the waste is brought to the facility.

words.englishDefinition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
words.example: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い期間特定の場所に、または生まれた場所に住んでいる人。
words.example: I'm a resident of Boston.

words.englishDefinition: One of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
words.japaneseExplanation: 多くの物のうちで、ただ一つだけが選択される1つ。
words.example: I think that's an option we need to look into.

words.englishDefinition: A fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の機能に分化した動物の完全に差別化された構造上、機能上の単位。
words.example: I want to learn how to play the organ.

words.englishDefinition: A person who is professionally engaged in the analysis and interpretation of works of art
words.japaneseExplanation: 美術作品の分析と解釈に携わる専門家。
words.example: I realize that I'm my own worst critic.

words.englishDefinition: The extended spatial location of something
words.japaneseExplanation: ものの広がった空間的位置。
words.example: We use this word a lot in our region.

words.englishDefinition: Charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の財源のために市民自体・財産・活動に対して課されて徴収される金銭。
words.example: We must pay the tax.

words.japanese: 接近(の手段)、利用の機会
words.englishDefinition: The act of approaching or entering
words.japaneseExplanation: 近づいたり入ったりする行為。
words.example: What is the access number to open this gate to the beach?

words.englishDefinition: The financial means whereby one lives
words.japaneseExplanation: 人が生活していくに当たっての財政手段。
words.example: My bike is my livelihood.

words.englishDefinition: Abrupt electric discharge from cloud to cloud or from cloud to earth accompanied by the emission of light
words.japaneseExplanation: 発光によって伴われる、突然の雲から雲へまたは雲から地上への放電。
words.example: I was scared by the lightning.

words.englishDefinition: Cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions
words.japaneseExplanation: 砂漠地域で役畜または乗用獣として使われる反芻動物。
words.example: I have never eaten camel meat.

words.japanese: 抗酸化物質、酸化防止剤
words.englishDefinition: Substance that inhibits oxidation or inhibits reactions promoted by oxygen or peroxides
words.japaneseExplanation: 酸化を抑制する、または酸素や過酸化物で促進される反応を抑制する物質。
words.example: Figs improve the antioxidant activity of your body.

words.englishDefinition: A physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning
words.japaneseExplanation: 正常の機能に乱れがある物理的状態。
words.example: I have an eating disorder.

words.englishDefinition: Domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age
words.japaneseExplanation: 性別や年齢に関わらずグループとしての家畜化したウシ科の動物。
words.example: I still need to feed the cattle.

words.englishDefinition: A solemn promise, usually invoking a divine witness, regarding your future acts or behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常神の証人を呼び起こして、将来の行為や行動に関す神聖な誓い。
words.example: Do you remember the oath you took?

words.englishDefinition: A structure erected to commemorate persons or events
words.japaneseExplanation: 人物や出来事を記念するために建てられた構築物。
words.example: Do you want to visit this monument?

words.englishDefinition: Utility to warm a building
words.japaneseExplanation: 建物を暖める装置。
words.example: Our old house needs a heating system.

words.englishDefinition: A minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
words.japaneseExplanation: 微小生命体（特に病気をもたらすバクテリア）。その語は専門的には使われない。
words.example: This milk is germ-free.

words.japanese: 伝説、言い伝え、伝説的な人
words.englishDefinition: A story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
words.japaneseExplanation: 神話上のまたは超自然の存在または出来事についての物語。
words.example: I can make you a legend.

words.englishDefinition: The area of a theater or concert hall where the audience sits
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇場かコンサート・ホールで、聴衆が座る領域。
words.example: I knew it would be hot in the auditorium.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)
words.japaneseExplanation: （内科学）（薬物療法や治療上のトレーニングなどで）ある人を手当てする行為。
words.example: I have a therapy appointment next Monday.

words.englishDefinition: That which is inherited; a title or property or estate that passes by law to the heir on the death of the owner
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け継がれるそれ。所有者の死に際して相続人に法律を見過ごすタイトルまたは資産または地所。
words.example: You always tell me I should be proud of my heritage.

words.englishDefinition: The act of invading; the act of an army that invades for conquest or plunder
words.japaneseExplanation: 侵略行為。
words.example: We must resist the invasion of the English language.

words.englishDefinition: A document certifying the successful completion of a course of study
words.japaneseExplanation: 学業の課程を修了したことを証明する文書。
words.example: I finished the course, but they didn't give me the diploma.

words.englishDefinition: A state of conflict between persons
words.japaneseExplanation: 人と人が争うこと。
words.example: There's always been some friction between Tom and Mary.

words.englishDefinition: An organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty
words.japaneseExplanation: 契約や条約にかかわる人々（や国々）の組織。
words.example: The coalition of the willing.

words.japanese: (人・物)の殺到、 (水・空気の)流入
words.englishDefinition: The process of flowing in
words.japaneseExplanation: 流れ込む作用。
words.example: The influx of foreign workers has caused a serious housing problem in this area.

words.englishDefinition: An appeal to some supernatural power to inflict evil on someone or some group
words.japaneseExplanation: ある人または集団に不幸を与えるために、ある超能力に訴えること。
words.example: I wanted to avoid the curse.

words.englishDefinition: a computer program for a particular task
words.japaneseExplanation: スマートフォンなどで使うソフトウェア。application の略。
words.example: I use an app to review new English words.

words.japanese: 視界、視野、目に見える事
words.englishDefinition: Quality or fact or degree of being visible; perceptible by the eye or obvious to the eye
words.japaneseExplanation: 見ることができる品質または事実または程度。目によって知覚できる、目に見えて明らかである。
words.example: What is the degree of visibility?

words.englishDefinition: Artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
words.japaneseExplanation: 天然繊維あるいは合成繊維を織ること、フェルトにすること、編むこと、または鉤針編みすることによって作られる人工物。
words.example: You should have seen the fabric with your own eyes.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) a brief event in which two or more bodies come together
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つ以上の物体がぶつかること。
words.example: We may be on a collision course.

words.japanese: 二酸化物（carbon dioxide は二酸化炭素）
words.englishDefinition: a compound containing two oxygen atoms for each atom of another element
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の元素の原子一個に酸素原子二個が結びついた二酸化物。carbon dioxide は二酸化炭素。
words.example: We learned about carbon dioxide in science class.

words.englishDefinition: The (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のものについてその革命において1つの天体により記述される（通常楕円）経路。
words.example: How many planets orbit the sun?

words.englishDefinition: The act of testing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをテストする行為。
words.example: How long do you think the trial will last?

words.englishDefinition: knowledge and ability in a particular field
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の分野の情報を理解して使う知識や能力。
words.example: Digital literacy helps students use the internet responsibly.

words.englishDefinition: An elaborate and systematic plan of action
words.japaneseExplanation: 入念で体系的な行動計画。
words.example: What if the scheme doesn't work out?

words.englishDefinition: A concluding action
words.japaneseExplanation: 締めくくる行動。
words.example: I just wish Tom had lived to see the completion of the project that he started.

words.japanese: 専門的知識(技術・意見)
words.englishDefinition: Skillfulness by virtue of possessing special knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な知識を持つことで熟達すること。
words.example: You know how much I appreciate your expertise.

words.japanese: ウイルス、ウイルス疾患
words.englishDefinition: (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きている宿主の細胞内のみでそれ自身を複製する極微の感染性の病原菌。多くは病原性である。
words.example: I think I have a virus on my computer.

words.englishDefinition: A statute in draft before it becomes law
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律になる前の草稿段階の法令。
words.example: We don't need to pay this bill until next Monday.

words.englishDefinition: Your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 信じる、信じないの基礎となるもの。信じることの基礎を形成する知識。
words.example: We have all the evidence against you we need.

words.englishDefinition: Earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをしよう、または達成しようとするまじめで良心的な行動。
words.example: We couldn't get anywhere in our attempt to convince him.

words.englishDefinition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
words.example: What do I need to do to get an account?

words.englishDefinition: an explanation or set of ideas about how something works
words.japaneseExplanation: 物事の仕組みを説明する考え方や理論。科学では証拠に支えられた体系的な説明。
words.example: We discussed a theory about how children learn languages.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that contributes causally to a result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果に偶然結びつくもの。
words.example: I don't think that that's a factor.

words.englishDefinition: The merchandise that a shop has on hand
words.japaneseExplanation: 店の手元にある商品。
words.example: We will help you order the stock.

words.englishDefinition: Material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules
words.japaneseExplanation: 原子または分子の変化を含む反応により生成される、また使われる物質。
words.example: The laboratory stores each chemical in a clearly labeled container.

words.japanese: マスメディア、マスコミ
words.englishDefinition: ways of sharing news and information with the public
words.japaneseExplanation: 新聞、テレビ、インターネットなど情報を伝える媒体。
words.example: Social media helps me keep in touch with friends.

words.englishDefinition: The financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の期間に生じる（労働による、または労働によらない）財務利益。
words.example: Our income is small, but we get by.

words.englishDefinition: Offering goods and services for sale
words.japaneseExplanation: 売るために財と用役を提供すること。
words.example: Our supply of sugar has run out.

words.englishDefinition: The property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが予測または必要より少ないときの、その少ない分であることの特質。
words.example: There is never a shortage of things to do here.

words.englishDefinition: The state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
words.japaneseExplanation: お金が殆どないか全くなく,物質的な所有物が僅かしかないか全くない状態。
words.example: If you don't respect your money, at least respect our poverty.

words.englishDefinition: Having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
words.japaneseExplanation: それ押して注意を呼びこむ特性を持つ。
words.example: Algeria is striking a new course for a new age.

words.englishDefinition: A message describing how something is to be done
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをするやり方を示すメッセージ。
words.example: I wish I had followed his instructions at that time.

words.japanese: 、教育(家系、種などの)絶滅、消滅
words.englishDefinition: Complete annihilation
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全消滅。
words.example: What will it take to save the human species from extinction?

words.englishDefinition: The ability to create
words.japaneseExplanation: 創造する能力。
words.example: We make our products using our creativity as a service to you.

words.englishDefinition: An estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品作物が大規模に栽培されている土地（特に熱帯地方で）。
words.example: Small children work as slaves on the chocolate plantation.

words.englishDefinition: A shortage of rainfall
words.japaneseExplanation: 降雨量の不足。
words.example: If it doesn't rain soon, there will be a drought.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of profuse abundance
words.japaneseExplanation: 豊富である状態。
words.example: You were loved by this person because of your wealth.

words.japanese: 思い出させるもの、記念品
words.englishDefinition: An experience that causes you to remember something
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたに何かを思い出させる経験。
words.example: Can you set a reminder on your phone?

words.japanese: 記念品問い合わせ、質問、調査
words.englishDefinition: A search for knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識を得るための調査。
words.example: Thank you for your inquiry.

words.englishDefinition: An inquiry into unfamiliar or questionable activities
words.japaneseExplanation: よく知らない、疑問が残る活動について調査すること。
words.example: How is the investigation going?

words.englishDefinition: The line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something
words.japaneseExplanation: ものの限界または範囲を示す線あるいは面。
words.example: Where is the boundary between your field and his field?

words.englishDefinition: A partitioned section, chamber, or separate room within a larger enclosed area
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きい囲まれた場所の中の、仕切られた区域、部屋、または別室。
words.example: I asked for a seat in the no-smoking compartment.

words.englishDefinition: A person or thing that takes or can take the place of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のもの代わりをするか、代わりをすることができる人、または物。
words.example: I don't like the substitute teacher.

words.japanese: 人)(動植物の)雑種、混成物
words.englishDefinition: A composite of mixed origin
words.japaneseExplanation: 混ざった元の物の混合。
words.example: You could at least buy a hybrid.

words.englishDefinition: A prominent attribute or aspect of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの顕著な面。
words.example: A green color is a characteristic of that type of apple.

words.englishDefinition: Stemming from evil characteristics or forces; wicked or dishonorable
words.japaneseExplanation: 邪心の特徴、及び力から湧き出るもの。不快な、または不名誉な。
words.example: Ziri had the most sinister evil face I've ever seen.

words.englishDefinition: The psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体が望む目的に向かって行動を起こすように仕向ける心理学的特性。行動の理由。
words.example: What was his motive for doing it?

words.englishDefinition: The state of the economy declines; a widespread decline in the GDP and employment and trade lasting from six months to a year
words.japaneseExplanation: 経済が後退する状態。GDPと雇用率、貿易の全般的な後退で、6ヶ月から1年間続く。
words.example: I was fired during the recession and never came back.

words.japanese: 周囲の（名詞「周囲の状況・環境」は通常 surroundings）
words.englishDefinition: located around a particular place or thing
words.japaneseExplanation: 形容詞では「周囲の」。名詞で「周囲の状況・環境」を表す場合は通常 surroundings を使う。
words.example: We explored the surrounding countryside during our trip.

words.englishDefinition: A large amount of wealth or prosperity
words.japaneseExplanation: 大規模な富ないしは繁栄。
words.example: I had the fortune to meet him live.

words.englishDefinition: An individual instance of a type of symbol
words.japaneseExplanation: 記号のタイプの個々の例。
words.example: Please accept this gift as a token of friendship.

words.englishDefinition: An indication that something has been present
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが存在したという徴候。
words.example: How far back can you trace your family tree?

words.japanese: 冒険的(ベンチャー)企業
words.englishDefinition: A commercial undertaking that risks a loss but promises a profit
words.japaneseExplanation: 損失覚悟ではあるが利益の見込みがある、商業的企て。
words.example: I wish my venture would work out.

words.englishDefinition: A licensed medical practitioner
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可された医者。
words.example: I want to be a physician in the future.

words.englishDefinition: A way of regarding situations or topics etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 状況や話題などを評価する方法。
words.example: Can you help me understand your perspective?

words.englishDefinition: The science of matter and energy and their interactions
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質とエネルギーとその相互作用の科学。
words.example: I cannot understand the physics teacher. I am completely lost!

words.englishDefinition: The act of making or enacting laws
words.japaneseExplanation: 法を作るかまたは制定する行為。
words.example: We have to pass this legislation.

words.englishDefinition: An outlying farm building for storing grain or animal feed and housing farm animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 穀物や動物の餌を保管したり家畜を収容している郊外の農舎。
words.example: I ended up sleeping in the barn.

words.englishDefinition: Disposed to venture or take risks
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険を冒して進みたい、あるいはリスクを負いたい。
words.example: What a daring thing to say!

words.englishDefinition: Transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity
words.japaneseExplanation: 光を伝えるさま。明確に見ることができる。
words.example: I believe he isn't being fully transparent.

words.englishDefinition: Very sad; especially involving grief or death or destruction
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に悲しい。特に、悲しみ、死、または破滅などに関わる。
words.example: I was moved to tears by the tragic story.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime
words.japaneseExplanation: 犯罪を犯した、あるいは犯罪の有罪判決を受けた人。
words.example: I don't know which room the criminal went inside.

words.englishDefinition: A sum of money allocated for a particular purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的のために割り当てられる金額。
words.example: How are you doing with your budget this year?

words.englishDefinition: The power or right to give orders or make decisions
words.japaneseExplanation: 命令をするか、決定をする力または権利。
words.example: I don't have the authority to give you the green light.

words.englishDefinition: The ordering of genes in a haploid set of chromosomes of a particular organism; the full DNA sequence of an organism
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の生物の単相染色体の一組にある遺伝子の順序。有機体の完全なDNA連鎖。
words.example: Flavio has a pure human genome.

words.englishDefinition: A particular environment or surrounding influence
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の環境または周囲の影響。
words.example: I don't like the atmosphere of that school.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: ニーズの実現や努力や目的の促進に寄与する活動。
words.example: I expect him to come to our aid.

words.englishDefinition: Any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的への過程の一部としてなされる措置。
words.example: How do you measure your progress in different languages?

words.englishDefinition: A person who is subjected to experimental or other observational procedures; someone who is an object of investigation
words.japaneseExplanation: 実験的であるか他の観察の対象となる人。「この調査の対象者は無作為に選ばれた」。
words.example: I think it's about time we change the subject.

words.englishDefinition: A period of 10 years
words.japaneseExplanation: 10年間。
words.example: How many years are there in a decade?

words.englishDefinition: Any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦いまたは狩猟に使われる機材または道具。
words.example: Do you carry a weapon?

words.japanese: 栄養分、栄養になるもの
words.englishDefinition: Any substance that can be metabolized by an animal to give energy and build tissue
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを与え、組織を形成するために動物が代謝する物質。
words.example: This is native soil and it has nutrients in it.

words.englishDefinition: Amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品やサービスに対する支払額で容易に税控除の対象となりうるもの（設備投資と区別して）。
words.example: I had a good dinner at his expense.

words.englishDefinition: A thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 建築された物。多くの部品で建設される複雑な実体。
words.example: The windshield is part of the structure of the car.

words.englishDefinition: A juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
words.japaneseExplanation: 思春期の入り口と成年の間にいる若者。
words.example: A boy is an adolescent between 14 and 20, while a girl is an adolescent between 12 and 18.

words.englishDefinition: Sharply exact or accurate or delimited
words.japaneseExplanation: 鋭く正確であるか間違いのない、あるいは区切られた。
words.example: I should have been more precise.

words.japanese: 日課、決まり切った仕事
words.englishDefinition: An unvarying or habitual method or procedure
words.japaneseExplanation: 変わらないか習慣的方法または手順。
words.example: You have a routine on Monday, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: The boundary of a surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 表面の境界。
words.example: We walked as far as the edge of the forest.

words.englishDefinition: A single distinct event
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の顕著な出来事。
words.example: Do you know about the incident from the other day?

words.englishDefinition: A slight indication
words.japaneseExplanation: わずかな暗示。
words.example: You don't have a clue what you're talking about.

words.englishDefinition: The act of removing
words.japaneseExplanation: 除去する行為。
words.example: I had laser hair removal.

words.englishDefinition: Something that results
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果として生じる何か。
words.example: I am not planning to tell you the outcome at all.

words.englishDefinition: Elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に海水面または地表からの高さ。
words.example: I don't feel well at such a high altitude.

words.englishDefinition: An obstruction in a pipe or tube
words.japaneseExplanation: パイプや管の中の詰まり。
words.example: We hope that there is closure.

words.englishDefinition: A whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つあるいはそれ以上の要素や部分が結合した全体。
words.example: Do you know what compound words are?

words.englishDefinition: A quantity much larger than is needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要とされるよりずっと大きい量。
words.example: We have a surplus of food.

words.englishDefinition: Immunogen consisting of a suspension of weakened or dead pathogenic cells injected in order to stimulate the production of antibodies
words.japaneseExplanation: 抗体の生産を刺激するために注射される弱められたか死病原性細胞の懸濁からなる免疫原。
words.example: We are looking for the vaccine.

words.englishDefinition: A remark that calls attention to something or someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 物や人に注意を促す発言。
words.example: I want to look at the reference books.

words.englishDefinition: The social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたをその力によって要求された行動方針に結びつける社会的勢力。
words.example: I think we have an obligation to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Any customary observance or practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 慣習的な行事、もしくは慣例のいずれか。
words.example: What is your favorite self-care ritual?

words.japanese: 信じられない、驚くほどの
words.englishDefinition: Beyond belief or understanding
