words.japaneseExplanation: 信念または理解を越えて。
words.example: I know this must seem incredible to you.

words.englishDefinition: The form of a word that is used to denote more than one
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つ以上であること示すために使われる単語の語形。
words.example: I could not find the plural form of this word.

words.englishDefinition: Urgently needed; absolutely necessary
words.japaneseExplanation: 至急必要とされるさま。絶対に必要であるさま。
words.example: I view sleep as a vital need.

words.englishDefinition: Responsive to physical stimuli
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的な刺激に敏感な。
words.example: My eyes are very sensitive to the light.

words.englishDefinition: Worthy of notice
words.japaneseExplanation: 注目に値する。
words.example: Our students showed remarkable progress.

words.englishDefinition: The least possible
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も可能性の低い。
words.example: I think that the economic impact will be minimal.

words.englishDefinition: unable to pay debts
words.japaneseExplanation: 借金を支払えず、破産した状態。
words.example: The company went bankrupt after several difficult years.

words.englishDefinition: Not counterfeit or copied
words.japaneseExplanation: 偽造でない、またはコピーされていない。
words.example: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.

words.englishDefinition: Being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme
words.japaneseExplanation: 妥当な、または標準的な範囲内にある。過剰でないか極端でない。
words.example: I thought you were a moderate.

words.englishDefinition: Not contained in or deriving from the essential nature of something
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものに不可欠な性質を含まない、またはこれに由来しない。
words.example: My cat is blue, because he's an alien cat.

words.englishDefinition: Ready and willing or quick to act
words.japaneseExplanation: 準備ができて、望んであるいはすぐに行動するさま。
words.example: You can use this prompt.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking any definite plan or order or purpose; governed by or depending on chance
words.japaneseExplanation: 確かな計画または順序または目的が欠如しているさま。偶然に決まることにより制御される。
words.example: I won't trust my child with a random person.

words.englishDefinition: Determining or having the power to determine an outcome
words.japaneseExplanation: 決定すること、または結果を決定する力を持っているさま。
words.example: I took a picture at the decisive moment.

words.japanese: 避けられない、必然的な
words.englishDefinition: Incapable of being avoided or prevented
words.japaneseExplanation: 避けられるか防がれることができない。
words.example: You have to accept the inevitable.

words.japanese: 酸っぱい、酸性の、皮肉な
words.englishDefinition: Being sour to the taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 酸っぱい味がする。
words.example: I read an article about acid rain yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to a climate
words.japaneseExplanation: 気候の、または、気候に関する。
words.example: What do we know about the climatic history of Mars?

words.englishDefinition: A particular course of action intended to achieve a result
words.japaneseExplanation: 結果を達成しようと試みた、ある特定の行動の過程。
words.example: Could you walk me through the procedure?

words.englishDefinition: The smallest possible quantity
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能な限り最も小さい量。
words.example: I can barely pay the minimum every month.

words.englishDefinition: A substance that can be consumed to produce energy
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを生み出すために消費される物質。
words.example: How much fuel do you need?

words.englishDefinition: Available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 財貨を生じる源。必要なときに引き出せる新しい、または貯蓄された供給源。
words.example: We don't have the resources we need.

words.englishDefinition: An authoritative rule
words.japaneseExplanation: 権威のある規則。
words.example: We should do away with this regulation.

words.englishDefinition: A binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
words.japaneseExplanation: 2人以上の間の、法により実施できる拘束力のある協定。
words.example: I should've read the contract more carefully.

words.englishDefinition: Promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
words.japaneseExplanation: 損失の場合に償還する契約。危険を心配して保険会社に前納した人々または会社に支払われる。
words.example: My son-in-law works at an insurance company.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being employed or having a job
words.japaneseExplanation: 雇用されている、あるいは仕事をもっていること。
words.example: Do you have an employment lawyer?

words.englishDefinition: A decree that prohibits something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを禁止する命令。
words.example: You came despite my ban.

words.englishDefinition: A conveyance that transports people or objects
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物を運ぶ乗物。
words.example: How did that vehicle end up here?

words.englishDefinition: The part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
words.japaneseExplanation: 腐植土や分解した岩石から成る地表の一部。
words.example: It's difficult to grow anything in this soil.

words.japanese: (主に船・飛行機の)積荷、貨物
words.englishDefinition: Goods carried by a large vehicle
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きい車両で運ばれる品物。
words.example: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.

words.englishDefinition: A vehicle that can fly
words.japaneseExplanation: 飛ぶことができる乗り物。
words.example: I went up into the aircraft.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring in or belonging to the present time
words.japaneseExplanation: 今現在に起こるか、属しているさま。
words.example: I can’t take time off for a trip with my current pay.

words.englishDefinition: Take hold of; grab
words.japaneseExplanation: つかむ。つかみ取る。
words.example: He'll clutch at any straw.

words.englishDefinition: (used of persons or behavior) characterized by or indicative of lack of generosity
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または行動について使用され）寛大さの欠如によって特徴づけられた、または、寛大さの欠如を示す。
words.example: I really don't understand what he means by that.

words.englishDefinition: a hard material formed by small sea animals; made of this material
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さな海の動物が作る硬い骨格であるサンゴ、またはその材料の。
words.example: We saw colorful coral while swimming near the island.

words.englishDefinition: Original and of a kind not seen before
words.japaneseExplanation: 原初、またこれまでに見られない種類。
words.example: I remember having read that novel before.

words.englishDefinition: Having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
words.japaneseExplanation: 論争中のテーマに関係すること、あるいはつながりのあるさま。
words.example: Do you have a relevant point to make?

words.englishDefinition: Being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間または努力または実費を浪費することなく効果的であるさま。
words.example: I am not so efficient as I used to be.

words.englishDefinition: Easily broken or damaged or destroyed
words.japaneseExplanation: 容易に壊されるか、または傷つけられるか、または破壊される。
words.example: Could you put these fragile things in a safe place?

words.englishDefinition: Making a strong or vivid impression
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い、または、鮮明な印象を与えるさま。
words.example: You were both impressive today. I am proud of you.

words.englishDefinition: Unpleasant or disgusting especially to the senses
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に気持ちが不快な、または不愉快な。
words.example: We weren't a good offensive team.

words.englishDefinition: (often followed by 'from') not alike; different in nature or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 同様でない。本質または質において異なる。
words.example: My opinion is very distinct from yours.

words.englishDefinition: Not permanent; not lasting
words.japaneseExplanation: 永久的でない。持続しない。
words.example: You must be the temporary we asked for.

words.englishDefinition: Having or showing feelings of unwarranted importance out of overbearing pride
words.japaneseExplanation: 横柄なプライドから不当な重要さの感情を持つまたは示す。
words.example: I don't like him because he is too arrogant.

words.englishDefinition: (of buildings and rooms) having ample space
words.japaneseExplanation: （建物や部屋について）十分な空間のある。
words.example: I have a spacious shower.

words.englishDefinition: Showing reason or sound judgment
words.japaneseExplanation: 理由または正常な判断を示すさま。
words.example: I got this car for a very reasonable price.

words.englishDefinition: Fairly large
words.japaneseExplanation: かなり大きい。
words.example: I haven't eaten anything substantial in 48 hours.

words.englishDefinition: Be a mystery or bewildering to
words.japaneseExplanation: 神秘か目まぐるしい。
words.example: I was bewildered by his behavior in the restaurant.

words.englishDefinition: Having incalculable monetary, intellectual, or spiritual worth
words.japaneseExplanation: 無数の金銭的な、理知的な、または、精神的な価値を持つ。
words.example: Life is invaluable, don't waste it like this for nothing.

words.englishDefinition: Of a stern or strict bearing or demeanor; forbidding in aspect
words.japaneseExplanation: 振る舞いや態度において厳しい。局面において気難しい。
words.example: I gave him a stern talking-to.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by a lack of interest
words.japaneseExplanation: 無関心で特徴付けられる。
words.example: I don't usually feel indifferent, but today is different.

words.englishDefinition: Showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity
words.japaneseExplanation: 共感、理解、および寛大さで表す、または共感、理解、および寛大さに動機づけられた。
words.example: I want to contribute to a charitable cause.

words.japanese: 大量の、大規模の、巨大な
words.englishDefinition: Imposing in size or bulk or solidity
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、体積、または剛性が立派な。
words.example: I think that it's a massive problem.

words.englishDefinition: Able to be compared or worthy of comparison
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較されることができるか比較に値する。
words.example: A comparable car would cost far more in Japan.

words.englishDefinition: Not consistent with or using reason
words.japaneseExplanation: 首尾一貫していない、または道理を用いないさま。
words.example: I have many irrational wants.

words.englishDefinition: Believing the worst of human nature and motives; having a sneering disbelief in e.g. selflessness of others
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間性と真意の最悪の事態を信じているさま。例えば他人の無私無欲について、あざ笑い信じないこと。
words.example: How did you get to be so cynical?

words.englishDefinition: To a degree exceeding normal or proper limits
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常であるか適当な限度を上回っている。
words.example: I think you're overly concerned with how other people are seeing you.

words.englishDefinition: In a literal sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 文字どおりの意味で。
words.example: I took what he said literally.

words.englishDefinition: Out of your own free will
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分の自由意思の外で。
words.example: I won't leave this house voluntarily.

words.englishDefinition: according to the exact facts or rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 細かな事実や規則に照らして厳密に言うこと。
words.example: Technically, a tomato is a fruit, not a vegetable.

words.englishDefinition: To a complete degree or to the full or entire extent ('whole' is often used informally for 'wholly')
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全な程度、一杯になるまで、または全範囲。
words.example: I am not wholly convinced that you are right.

words.englishDefinition: (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
words.japaneseExplanation: （量について）不正確であるがとても正確に近い。
words.example: I lived in Algiers for approximately 14 years.

words.englishDefinition: So as to be unique
words.japaneseExplanation: ユニークに。
words.example: Each person views the world uniquely.

words.englishDefinition: (usually plural) the office that serves as the administrative center of an enterprise
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業の管理経営の中心として動くオフィス。
words.example: Our headquarters will open tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Growth to a global or worldwide scale
words.japaneseExplanation: 世界的であるか世界的なスケールへの成長。
words.example: Globalization doesn't just take place in the economy, but also in culture.

words.englishDefinition: A small book usually having a paper cover
words.japaneseExplanation: 普通紙表紙の小さな本。
words.example: What did I do with that brochure?

words.englishDefinition: A formal or official examination
words.japaneseExplanation: 正式または公式の調査。
words.example: Please wait in the waiting room until the inspection results are ready.

words.englishDefinition: The act of being present (at a meeting or event etc.)
words.japaneseExplanation: （ミーティングや催しなどに）出席する行為。
words.example: Please put your name down on the attendance list.

words.englishDefinition: A ductile malleable reddish-brown corrosion-resistant diamagnetic metallic element; occurs in various minerals but is the only metal that occurs abundantly in large masses; used as an electrical and thermal conductor
words.japaneseExplanation: 延性順応性のある赤褐色の防腐反磁性金属元素。様々な鉱物の中に存在するが、大きな塊で豊富に見つかる唯一の金属。
words.example: I think Tom's a copper.

words.englishDefinition: The cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one
words.japaneseExplanation: 11と1の合計である集合数。
words.example: I wonder why eggs are sold by the dozen.

words.englishDefinition: An acute febrile highly contagious viral disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に感染力の強い急性のウィルス性熱病。
words.example: What you have is a common cold, not the flu.

words.englishDefinition: The ritual placing of a corpse in a grave
words.japaneseExplanation: 死体を墓に入れる儀式。
words.example: When was the last time you were at a burial ceremony?

words.englishDefinition: The process of becoming mildewed
words.japaneseExplanation: カビが生える過程。
words.example: You remind us that life is too short to fit into a mold.

words.englishDefinition: A piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
words.japaneseExplanation: 装飾、穴を繕ったり塞ぐものとして使用される布の断片。
words.example: My people are working on a patch.

words.englishDefinition: A drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがどう働くのかを説明することを意図した図。部分同士の関係を示す図。
words.example: Could you explain this diagram to me?

words.englishDefinition: The spatial property of the way in which something is placed
words.japaneseExplanation: 物の置き方の空間的性質。
words.example: I could also take a placement test, if necessary.

words.japanese: 配置残念なこと、恥、不名誉
words.englishDefinition: A painful emotion resulting from an awareness of inadequacy or guilt
words.japaneseExplanation: 欠点または罪に対する意識から生じる苦しい感情。
words.example: What a shame you weren't able to come.

words.englishDefinition: Repetitive and persistent
words.japaneseExplanation: 反復的で持続的な。
words.example: Why are you so insistent on going with me?

words.englishDefinition: The group action of a collection of people or animals or vehicles moving ahead in more or less regular formation
words.japaneseExplanation: ほぼ整然とした隊形で進行する人、動物、あるいは乗り物の集団の行動。
words.example: We saw a procession of giraffes.

words.englishDefinition: A state of agitation or turbulent change or development
words.japaneseExplanation: 動揺、不穏な変化または開発の状態。
words.example: There was some unrest in the city.

words.englishDefinition: An imaginary line around the Earth forming the great circle that is equidistant from the north and south poles
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の南極と北極から等距離の所で大きな円を描く想像上の線。
words.example: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.

words.englishDefinition: Drained of energy or effectiveness; extremely tired; completely exhausted
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーまたは効率性が外に流れて。とても疲れている。
words.example: You didn't look like you were exhausted.

words.englishDefinition: Making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな精神的な要求を行うさま。理解する、解決する、あるいは信じることが難しい。
words.example: But he did not lose his smile, not in the problematic situation.

words.englishDefinition: Worth having or seeking or achieving
words.japaneseExplanation: 持つ、探すあるいは達成する価値がある。
words.example: I used to see Layla so desirable.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or based on geology
words.japaneseExplanation: 地質学の、地質学に関する、または、地質学に基づく。
words.example: Can you give me a geological explanation of lava?

words.englishDefinition: Imprudently incurring risk
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険を軽率に招くさま。
words.example: You don't want to do anything rash.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or preferring solitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 孤独を特徴とする、または孤独を好む。
words.example: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people!

words.englishDefinition: Not even or uniform as e.g. in shape or texture
words.japaneseExplanation: 形態または素地において一様でない。
words.example: It's good for your back to walk on uneven ground.

words.englishDefinition: Out of fashion
words.japaneseExplanation: 時代遅れ。
words.example: I bought this watch at an antique store.

words.japanese: (霧・曇などが)濃い、密集した
words.englishDefinition: Permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
words.japaneseExplanation: 物の密度が濃いために、もしあったとしても、どんな光も通り抜けさせない。
words.example: I hid in the dense woods.

words.japanese: 密集した 経済的な、安上がりな
words.englishDefinition: Using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
words.japaneseExplanation: 効果を得るために必要な最小限の時間または資源を使用する。
words.example: Bread with oil is a very healthy and economical food.

words.japanese: 架空の、フィクションの
words.englishDefinition: Formed or conceived by the imagination
words.japaneseExplanation: 想像力によって作られる、または考えだされる。
words.example: The story I'm about to tell is completely fictional.

words.japanese: 大急ぎの、気が狂いそうな
words.englishDefinition: Excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 過度に撹拌される。恐れまたは他の激しい感情で取り乱した。
words.example: My cat became frantic as soon as the car began to move.

words.englishDefinition: An examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 死因、または病変を確定するため、死体を調べたり解剖したりすること。
words.example: I'd like to do an autopsy on this body.

words.englishDefinition: An explosion (as of dynamite)
words.japaneseExplanation: （ダイナマイトのような）爆発。
words.example: I had a blast at the party last night.

words.englishDefinition: A courteous or respectful or considerate act
words.japaneseExplanation: 礼儀正しく、丁寧で思いやりのある行為。
words.example: I thank you for your courtesy.

words.englishDefinition: Something that people do or cause to happen
words.japaneseExplanation: 人々が行う、あるいは起こす事。
words.example: I was glad to do a good deed.

words.englishDefinition: Extended verbal expression in speech or writing
words.japaneseExplanation: 話し言葉または書き言葉における拡張された言語表現。
words.example: The subject of their discourse was the same as usual.

words.englishDefinition: An instinctive motive
words.japaneseExplanation: 本能的な動機。
words.example: I just said it on an impulse.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles
words.japaneseExplanation: 取っ手のない（通例筒状の）広口容器。
words.example: I tried to open the jar, but I couldn't.

words.englishDefinition: A person's brother or sister
words.japaneseExplanation: 兄弟や姉妹。
words.example: I came across your sibling on the street.

words.englishDefinition: A feeling of excitement
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮した気持ち。
words.example: I can't say I share your enthusiasm for the idea.

words.englishDefinition: Accumulated wealth in the form of money or jewels etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 貨幣や宝石などの形で蓄積された富。
words.example: I will never tell anyone where I hid the treasure.

words.englishDefinition: Parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
words.japaneseExplanation: 平行線または基線に対して平行または同じ面に属して。
words.example: I used a spirit level to make sure the shelf was perfectly horizontal.

words.englishDefinition: Vague or not clearly defined or stated
words.japaneseExplanation: あいまいな、はっきりと定義されないまたは述べられない。
words.example: These plans have been put on indefinite hold.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 上品さ、教養、あるいは趣がないさま。
words.example: You could say it that way, but it's quite vulgar.

words.englishDefinition: Elastic; rebounds readily
words.japaneseExplanation: 伸縮性のあるさま。簡単にはねかえるさま。
words.example: Tom doesn't seem to be as resilient as Mary seems to be.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or consisting of or being in water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水に関する、水から成る、または、水の中にいる。
words.example: Later, we'll visit the aquatic park.

words.englishDefinition: A movable chair mounted on large wheels; for invalids or those who cannot walk; frequently propelled by the occupant
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな車輪に乗った移動可能な椅子。病人または歩くことのできない人のための。
words.example: Can you help get me out my wheelchair?

words.englishDefinition: Having experience; having knowledge or skill from observation or participation
words.japaneseExplanation: 経験があるさま。観察、参加から知識または技術を持つこと。
words.example: I have never experienced anything like that before in my life.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring at the beginning
words.japaneseExplanation: 始めに起こるさま。
words.example: We couldn't reach the initial goal.

words.englishDefinition: accepted or used by most people
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会の多くの人に受け入れられ、主流となっていること。
words.example: Electric cars are becoming a mainstream choice for many drivers.

words.englishDefinition: Suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人か場所、条件などにふさわしい。
words.example: We did not think her loud dress was appropriate for the time and place.

words.englishDefinition: Fraudulent; having a misleading appearance
words.japaneseExplanation: いかさまの。紛らわしい外観をした。
words.example: You don't need to be perfect, just don't be fake.

words.englishDefinition: Engaged in or accustomed to close observation
words.japaneseExplanation: 近くでの観察に従事された、順応された。
words.example: My son needs to be more alert at school.

words.englishDefinition: Bringing death
words.japaneseExplanation: 死をもたらすさま。
words.example: You have made a fatal mistake.

words.englishDefinition: Of or providing nourishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 栄養の、または、栄養を供給する。
words.example: You can't eat it just because it is nutritious.

words.englishDefinition: Having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
words.japaneseExplanation: 世間の知識と改良と機転があるそれらを持つか、訴えるさま。
words.example: You think I'm not as sophisticated as you, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: Operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の介入が最小の状態で作動する。外部のコントロールから独立した。
words.example: I am a translation system but I am not automatic!

words.englishDefinition: Not processed or subjected to analysis
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理されていない、または分析されていない。
words.example: I thought that you said you couldn't eat raw fish.

words.englishDefinition: (quantifier used with mass nouns) small in quantity or degree; not much or almost none or (with 'a') at least some
words.japaneseExplanation: 量または程度が小さい。それほどない、ほとんどない、（冠詞の「a」の場合）ちょっとある。
words.example: We had a slight difference of opinion.

words.englishDefinition: made by people rather than occurring naturally
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然にできたものではなく、人の手で作られたもの。
words.example: The park has a small man-made lake.

words.englishDefinition: Not in physical motion
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的な運動の状態にないさま。
words.example: Static came out from the phone.

words.englishDefinition: Proceeding in small stages
words.japaneseExplanation: 小さな場面で進む。
words.example: Gradual changes take place in our city every year.

words.japanese: 心地よい、親しい、親密な
words.englishDefinition: Having or fostering a warm or friendly and informal atmosphere
words.japaneseExplanation: 暖かいか好意的で堅苦しくないの雰囲気を持っているか、助長するさま。
words.example: I would never tell her the most intimate stuff.

words.englishDefinition: Relatively long in duration; tediously protracted
words.japaneseExplanation: 期間について、比較的長いさま。退屈なほど長々しいさま。
words.example: Ziri's ivy didn't make it through the lengthy road trip.

words.englishDefinition: Furthest or highest in degree or order; utmost or extreme
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度または順序が最も離れた、または最も高い。最大であるか極端な。
words.example: What is your ultimate goal in your life?

words.englishDefinition: Having won
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝ったさま。
words.example: I will return to this house victorious!

words.englishDefinition: Combining clever conception and facetious expression
words.japaneseExplanation: 賢明な概念とひょうきんな表現を結合するさま。
words.example: My father always comes up with something witty to say.

words.englishDefinition: Indistinct or hazy in outline
words.japaneseExplanation: アウトラインが不明瞭、あるいはかすんでいる。
words.example: I can't read it because it's too blurry.

words.japanese: 例外的に優れた、まれな
words.englishDefinition: Far beyond what is usual in magnitude or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさか度で普通のことを超えて遠い。
words.example: I know you'll do an exceptional job.

words.englishDefinition: Bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きさ、空間、時間範囲が有界であるあるいは、制限された。
words.example: We cannot have infinite growth on a finite planet.

words.englishDefinition: happening while doing a job
words.japaneseExplanation: 実際に仕事をしながら行うこと。on-the-job training は実務を通した研修。
words.example: New employees receive on-the-job training during their first month.

words.japanese: 空いている、使用されていない
words.englishDefinition: empty and available for someone to use
words.japaneseExplanation: 人が使っておらず、空いていること。
words.example: Is there a vacant seat near the window?

words.englishDefinition: Bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer
words.japaneseExplanation: 明るくて楽しい。元気な感覚を促進すること。
words.example: Mary put on a cheery smile.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted
words.japaneseExplanation: 勇気が欠如しているさま。卑劣に臆病で気が弱い。
words.example: He's just too cowardly to end his life.

words.japanese: 計り知れない、果てしない
words.englishDefinition: Beyond calculation or measure
words.japaneseExplanation: 計算または測定できない。
words.example: My disappointment is immeasurable, and my day is ruined.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 安心感が欠如しているか、楽または安心の余裕を持たないさま。
words.example: I am uneasy about the future of this country.

words.englishDefinition: Causing one to believe what is not true or fail to believe what is true
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に真実でないことを信じさせる、あるいは真実であることを信じさせなくするさま。
words.example: I believe that dreams are not always deceptive.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking in correct logical relation
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しい論理的な関係を欠いている。
words.example: Life is most often illogical.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by complexity and richness of detail
words.japaneseExplanation: 複雑さと詳細の豊かさで特徴付けられる。
words.example: Can you elaborate on this a little more?

words.englishDefinition: Having attained to kindliness or gentleness through age and experience
words.japaneseExplanation: 年齢と経験を通じて親切心またはやさしさを得た。
words.example: Most women mellow as they age.

words.englishDefinition: Seemingly boundless in amount, number, degree, or especially extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 一見して量、数、程度または特に範囲が果てしない。
words.example: My love is boundless! I'll follow you to the ends of the earth!

words.englishDefinition: Diffusing warmth and friendliness
words.japaneseExplanation: 思いやりと親しみやすさを広めるさま。
words.example: We received a cordial welcome from them.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring at or dependent on a particular season
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の季節に発生すること、あるいは依存するさま。
words.example: I know a very rich girl who only eats seasonal vegetables.

words.englishDefinition: Having a sharp biting taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 鋭く刺すような味がするさま。
words.example: I was prepared if things were to go sour.

words.englishDefinition: Moving very fast
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に速く動くさま。
words.example: He who speaks the truth needs a swift horse.

words.englishDefinition: Increasing by successive addition
words.japaneseExplanation: 連続した追加によって増加するさま。
words.example: Lost sleep has a cumulative effect, I've been told.

words.englishDefinition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
words.japaneseExplanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
words.example: He is quite a savage.

words.englishDefinition: Deserving of the highest esteem or admiration
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も高い評価または賞賛に値するさま。
words.example: She is an admirable woman.

words.englishDefinition: Serving to instruct or enlighten or inform
words.japaneseExplanation: 指示するか、または啓発するか、または知らせるのに役立つさま。
words.example: I read informative books as much as I can.

words.englishDefinition: Properly related in size or degree or other measurable characteristics; usually followed by 'to'
words.japaneseExplanation: サイズ、程度あるいは他の測定可能な特性に適切に関係している。
words.example: The tax you pay is proportional to the income you have.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring or operating at the same time
words.japaneseExplanation: 同時に起こること、または作動するさま。
words.example: I want to become a simultaneous interpreter.

words.japanese: 高齢化が進む、老朽化している
words.englishDefinition: becoming older
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物が年を重ねたり、古くなったりしていること。
words.example: The town is repairing its aging school buildings.

words.englishDefinition: Concerned with sacred matters or religion or the church
words.japaneseExplanation: 神性な事柄、宗教または教会に関する。
words.example: You should find a religion that is really more spiritual than what you have now.

words.englishDefinition: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
words.japaneseExplanation: （植物相または動物相について）絶滅の差し迫った危険な状態である。
words.example: What makes you think that your language is endangered?

words.englishDefinition: Having the sticky properties of an adhesive
words.japaneseExplanation: 接着剤の粘質の特性を持っている。
words.example: I can't get this sticky ball out of my hand.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by great fruitfulness
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな有効性で特徴付けられる。
words.example: The land here is rich and fertile.

words.englishDefinition: In or to another place
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の場所にある、別の場所へ。
words.example: I think we need to look elsewhere.

words.englishDefinition: To a complete degree or to the full or entire extent ('whole' is often used informally for 'wholly')
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全な程度、一杯になるまで、または全範囲。
words.example: My students are few in number, no more than five altogether.

words.englishDefinition: In a stringent manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 厳格に。
words.example: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.

words.englishDefinition: Ahead of time; in anticipation
words.japaneseExplanation: 前もって。
words.example: You should've asked him beforehand how much it cost.

words.englishDefinition: In like or similar manner
words.japaneseExplanation: のような、あるいは類似したさまの。
words.example: I don't believe a single word he's saying, and suggest you do likewise.

words.englishDefinition: A predisposition in favor of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを支持する傾向。
words.example: I don't know your preference, so please help yourself.

words.englishDefinition: A method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)
words.japaneseExplanation: あるグループの人の事象を管理する、または関わる方法（特にグループの事業において）。
words.example: We hope that the administration doesn't make the same mistake again.

words.englishDefinition: Settle as a colony; of countries in the developing world
words.japaneseExplanation: 入植者として定住する。開発途上地域の国の。
words.example: We need to colonize other planets.

words.englishDefinition: Be obedient to
words.japaneseExplanation: 従順である。
words.example: We should obey the law no matter what happens.

words.englishDefinition: Impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
words.japaneseExplanation: 見ることが不可能、またはほぼ不可能。目で感知できない。
words.example: I am an invisible man.

words.englishDefinition: Diminished in strength, quality, or utility
words.japaneseExplanation: 強さ、品質、または有用性の減退した。
words.example: Are you in any way impaired?

words.englishDefinition: Incapable of being passed
words.japaneseExplanation: 通ることができない。
words.example: The road up ahead is impassable.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking in energy or will
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動力または意志が欠けている。
words.example: The volcano has been inactive for a long time.

words.englishDefinition: Not suited to your comfort, purpose or needs
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたの快適さ、目的または必要性に適していない。
words.example: I think that it would be inconvenient to live in a city with no door.

words.englishDefinition: Showing ignorance of the laws of nature and faith in magic or chance
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然法則への無知をさらけ出し魔術や偶然への信頼を示す。
words.example: You aren't superstitious by any chance, are you?

words.englishDefinition: Disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings
words.japaneseExplanation: 知覚、精神または感情に不快な。
words.example: You should enjoy your life without making others' lives unpleasant.

words.englishDefinition: Morally bad in principle or practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 主義または習慣上、倫理的に悪い。
words.example: What you give to the wicked, you always regret.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by the interdependence of living organisms in an environment
words.japaneseExplanation: 環境下の生物の相互依存関係を特徴とする。
words.example: The ecological situation here is quite poor.

words.englishDefinition: Not based on fact; unreal
words.japaneseExplanation: 事実に基づいていないさま。非現実的なさま。
words.example: I had an imaginary friend when I was a kid.

words.englishDefinition: Fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全に発達した、成熟した、食べられるまたは使われる準備ができている。
words.example: I'm afraid the time is not yet ripe for it.

words.englishDefinition: The scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事または活動の現場（特に会議の場所）。
words.example: Do you remember that music venue that used to be there?

words.englishDefinition: A distinguishing feature of your personal nature
words.japaneseExplanation: その人個人の性質の際立った特徴。
words.example: I like this trait of his personality.

words.japanese: ぶらぶら歩く、散歩する
words.englishDefinition: Walk leisurely and with no apparent aim
words.japaneseExplanation: ゆっくり、そして、はっきりとした目的なく歩く。
words.example: What time in the morning do you take your morning stroll?

words.englishDefinition: For the most part
words.japaneseExplanation: 大部分。
words.example: This dictionary is primarily intended for high school students.

words.englishDefinition: More than is needed, desired, or required
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要である、希望される、あるいは必要であるより多いもの。
words.example: My father has been made redundant.

words.englishDefinition: Poorly balanced or matched in quantity or value or measure
words.japaneseExplanation: 量、値、または寸法が十分に釣り合わない、または一致しない。
words.example: I must excuse myself from the task, because I am unequal to it.

words.englishDefinition: (of political bodies) not controlled by outside forces
words.japaneseExplanation: （政治団体について）外の力によって制御されない。
words.example: This is an autonomous machine.

words.englishDefinition: Fearless and daring
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れを知らなくて大胆な。
words.example: What a bold thing to do!

words.englishDefinition: Expecting the worst possible outcome
words.japaneseExplanation: 最悪の結果を予想するさま。
words.example: I have a more pessimistic view of the matter.

words.englishDefinition: Repetitive and persistent
words.japaneseExplanation: 反復的で持続的な。
words.example: We must try not to be repetitive.

words.englishDefinition: Pertaining to respiration
words.japaneseExplanation: 呼吸に関係するさま。
words.example: I am studying the respiratory system at school.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 整然として、論理的で、美学的に一貫した部分の関係によって特徴づけられる。
words.example: For certain things it's very coherent.

words.englishDefinition: Look at with fixed eyes
words.japaneseExplanation: 固定された視線で見る。
words.example: We stopped to stare at them.

words.englishDefinition: Feel physical pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的な痛みを感じる。
words.example: I ache for your pain.

words.englishDefinition: Force to leave or move out
words.japaneseExplanation: 退去させられる、またはいなくなる。
words.example: He can expel me from here.

words.englishDefinition: Hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か達成を妨げるか、または防ぐ。
words.example: Do not obstruct the emergency exit with your big boxes.

words.englishDefinition: Call in an official matter, such as to attend court
words.japaneseExplanation: 公的な問題で呼び出す、例えば法廷に出席するために。
words.example: We have to summon a spirit.

words.englishDefinition: Any plant that crowds out cultivated plants
words.japaneseExplanation: 栽培された植物を追い遣る植物。
words.example: My mom wants me to help her weed her garden.

words.englishDefinition: Lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
words.japaneseExplanation: 強い嫌悪からくる尊敬の欠如。
words.example: You could see the look of scorn on Tom's face.

words.englishDefinition: Of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較的大きな粒子からなる感触的または物質的にざらついている質感の。
words.example: Her dress was made of coarse wool.

words.englishDefinition: Involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians
words.japaneseExplanation: 政治、党または政治家と関係すること、または特徴。
words.example: We need a new political science for a new world.

words.englishDefinition: Important in effect or meaning
words.japaneseExplanation: 影響あるいは意味において重要な。
words.example: I desire to make a significant change in my life.

words.englishDefinition: Producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図した結果を創出しまたは創出することができ、または顕著な効果を生み出す。
words.example: Can you think of any more effective way to do this?

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦争の原則の研究の、または、戦争の原則の研究に関する。
words.example: I cannot train with the military.

words.englishDefinition: required to be paid at a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: 支払いをしなければならない時期が来ていること。
words.example: The payment is due at the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: Absolutely necessary; vitally necessary
words.japaneseExplanation: 絶対に必要なさま。きわめて必要であるさま。
words.example: I think that it's absolutely essential.

words.englishDefinition: Prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律で、あるいは公式であるか認められた規則によって禁止される。
words.example: I didn't know that what we were doing was illegal.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to the condition of immunity
words.japaneseExplanation: 免疫状態に関するさま。
words.example: You are not immune to me.

words.englishDefinition: Amounting to a large indefinite number
words.japaneseExplanation: かなりの不明確な数に達するさま。
words.example: I had numerous dreams about him.

words.japanese: 極端な、過敏な、急進的な
words.englishDefinition: Of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 可能な限りの程度、範囲、強度の。
words.example: I hear you've done some pretty extreme stuff.

words.japanese: 進的な全体の、一般的な
words.englishDefinition: Applying to all or most members of a category or group
words.japaneseExplanation: カテゴリやグループのすべてかほとんどの構成要素に適用するさま。
words.example: I love all animals in general.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or used in or promoting agriculture or farming
words.japaneseExplanation: 農業または農作業を促進する、またはそれらで使用される、またはそれらに関する。
words.example: It was an agricultural area.

words.englishDefinition: Involving only main features
words.japaneseExplanation: 主要な特徴だけを伴うさま。
words.example: I think that overall we're in good shape.

words.englishDefinition: Further or added
words.japaneseExplanation: 追加的である、あるいは付け加えられたさま。
words.example: I had to pay an additional three dollars.

words.englishDefinition: Make impure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不潔にする。
words.example: I don't want to contaminate the clean glasses by taking them out of the dishwasher.

words.englishDefinition: having a disability that may affect everyday activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 障害のある状態を表す。施設や社会の対応について話すときにも使う。
words.example: The new ramp improves access for disabled visitors.

words.englishDefinition: Without evasion or compromise
words.japaneseExplanation: 回避や妥協なしに。
words.example: I believe that the answer is straightforward.

words.japanese: 飼い慣らされた、おとなしい
words.englishDefinition: used to people and not wild or afraid
words.japaneseExplanation: 動物が人に慣れておとなしいこと。
words.example: The rabbit is tame enough for children to feed.

words.japanese: となしい義務的な、強制的な
words.englishDefinition: Required by rule
words.japaneseExplanation: 規定通りに必要である。
words.example: It's not mandatory for us to do it that way.

words.englishDefinition: Suitable for use as food
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物としての使用に適している。
words.example: I don't think this is edible.

words.englishDefinition: Distinguished from others in excellence
words.japaneseExplanation: 卓越性において他と区別される。
words.example: I thought it was outstanding.

words.japanese: 致命的な、命にかかわる
words.englishDefinition: Of an instrument of certain death
words.japaneseExplanation: 死に至らせる手段。
words.example: There's nothing more deadly than a human child.

words.englishDefinition: Inferior in rank or status
words.japaneseExplanation: ランクまたは地位において劣っている。
words.example: I don't think that I'm very petty.

words.englishDefinition: Without question and beyond doubt
words.japaneseExplanation: 確かにそして紛れもなく。
words.example: You should definitely ask him out.

words.englishDefinition: (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
words.japaneseExplanation: （量について）不正確であるがとても正確に近い。
words.example: You guys are roughly the same age as we are.

words.englishDefinition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
words.japaneseExplanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
words.example: He has virtually no social life.

words.englishDefinition: From appearances alone
words.japaneseExplanation: 外観だけから。
words.example: I thought Tom had paid Mary, but apparently I was wrong.

words.englishDefinition: In an unfair manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 不公平な方法で。
words.example: I felt that I was being treated unfairly.

words.englishDefinition: For a short time
words.japaneseExplanation: 少しの間、短時間。
words.example: I explained briefly to him how it happened.

words.japanese: 一致させる、和解させる
words.englishDefinition: Make (one thing) compatible with (another)
words.japaneseExplanation: （1つのもの）と互換性（別のものとの）を持たせる。
words.example: How is it possible to reconcile work and private life?

words.englishDefinition: Throw or cast away
words.japaneseExplanation: 投げ捨てる。
words.example: We can't discard the possibility of an accident.

words.englishDefinition: Join the military
words.japaneseExplanation: 入隊する、軍隊に入る。
words.example: I need to enlist your help.

words.englishDefinition: Pay close attention to; give heed to
words.japaneseExplanation: 細心の注意を充てる。配慮をする。
words.example: You must heed the advice of your teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Grant freedom to; free from confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由を与える。監禁されていない。
words.example: They died to liberate their land.

words.englishDefinition: Coincide partially or wholly
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分的または完全に一致してする。
words.example: My sentences and my opinions only sometimes overlap.

words.englishDefinition: Build again
words.japaneseExplanation: 再び構築する。
words.example: It was only after a few days that I was finally able to reconstruct the whole story.

words.englishDefinition: Utter a shrill cry
words.japaneseExplanation: かん高い叫び声をあげる。
words.example: I heard a sudden shriek.

words.englishDefinition: Twist suddenly so as to sprain
words.japaneseExplanation: 捻挫するように突然ねじる。
words.example: I had to walk off of the mountain with a bad sprain.

words.englishDefinition: Feel bitter or indignant about
words.japaneseExplanation: 恨めしいと感じる、あるいは憤然たる思いをする。
words.example: I really resent her for the situation.

words.englishDefinition: Grow vigorously
words.japaneseExplanation: 活発に増殖する。
words.example: We don't just want you to survive, but to thrive.

words.englishDefinition: to accept and support an idea or change
words.japaneseExplanation: 考えや変化などを進んで受け入れ、支持すること。
words.example: Our school is ready to embrace new teaching ideas.

words.englishDefinition: Distinguish oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: 目覚ましい働きをする。
words.example: Ziri had to excel at school.

words.englishDefinition: Register formally as a participant or member
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係者かメンバーとして正式に登録する。
words.example: I wish to enroll and I need help.

words.englishDefinition: Get or find back; recover the use of
words.japaneseExplanation: 得るまたは見直す。使用を回復する。
words.example: I will retrieve them tomorrow if I have time.

words.englishDefinition: to make someone lose dignity or respect
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の尊厳や評判を傷つけること。
words.example: We should never degrade someone for making a mistake.

words.englishDefinition: Constituting the full quantity or extent; complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 全数量か範囲を構成するさま。完全なさま。
words.example: I can't pay attention to the entire world at once!

words.englishDefinition: Intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 度合いまたは質において、極度にまたは非常に悪いまたは不快な。
words.example: I have a severe pain here.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
words.japaneseExplanation: 変化させる。変える。
words.example: I have to alter my clothes because I've lost weight.

words.englishDefinition: Take up and practice as one's own
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分のために採用し実践する。
words.example: I think it's better for us to adopt his plan.

words.japanese: 投票する、投票で決める
words.englishDefinition: Express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote
words.japaneseExplanation: 候補か測定か解決のための人の好みを表現する。一票を投じる。
words.example: I don't yet know who I'm going to vote for.

words.englishDefinition: Fix in scope; fix the boundaries of
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲において確定する。境界を決定する。
words.example: We should determine what is to be done first.

words.englishDefinition: Render capable or able for some task
words.japaneseExplanation: ある課題に対して有能な。
words.example: Reading books enable you to travel to another world.

words.englishDefinition: to organize and carry out an activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 調査や実験などを計画して実行すること。
words.example: Our class will conduct a survey about school lunches.

words.englishDefinition: Take somebody somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かをどこかに連れて行く。
words.example: Can you direct me to the train station?

words.englishDefinition: Suck or take up or in
words.japaneseExplanation: しゃぶる、または吸収する。
words.example: I tried to absorb as much of local culture as possible.

words.japanese: ほのめかす、...と暗に示す
words.englishDefinition: Express or state indirectly
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現するか、間接的に述べる。
words.example: I didn't mean to imply what you did was wrong.

words.japanese: 運営する、 (機械など)動かす
words.englishDefinition: Direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 指示する、または制御する。プロジェクト、ビジネス、等。
words.example: I can't figure out how to operate this machine.

words.japanese: 実演して見せる、論証する
words.englishDefinition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
words.japaneseExplanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
words.example: I don't know how to demonstrate it, since it's too obvious!

words.englishDefinition: Increase
words.japaneseExplanation: 増加させる。
words.example: You need to boost up your confidence.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being a hindrance
words.japaneseExplanation: 障害であるという特質。
words.example: Being overweight is a drawback in this sport.

words.englishDefinition: On or to one side
words.japaneseExplanation: 一面で、あるいは一面の方へ。
words.example: I stood aside to let them pass.

words.englishDefinition: By law; conforming to the law
words.japaneseExplanation: 法律によって。法律に従うさま。
words.example: I thought you said you could legally drive a bus.

words.englishDefinition: Have recourse to
words.japaneseExplanation: 頼みとする。
words.example: We spent the summer at a beach resort.

words.englishDefinition: Yield to the control of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 別の支配に明け渡す。
words.example: We need to submit the report before the end of the month.

words.japanese: 由来する、生じる、始まる
words.englishDefinition: Begin a trip at a certain point, as of a plane, train, bus, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所から飛行機、列車、バスなどで旅を始める。
words.example: Where did blood originate from?

words.englishDefinition: Feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
words.japaneseExplanation: 悔恨を感じる。遺憾に感じる。
words.example: I have a feeling I'm going to regret this later.

words.englishDefinition: Work together on a common enterprise of project
words.japaneseExplanation: 計画の共同作業を一緒にする。
words.example: We are working hard to cooperate more.

words.englishDefinition: Make revisions in
words.japaneseExplanation: で改訂を行う。
words.example: I am not going out because I have to revise.

words.japanese: (大きさ・数量・範囲など)制限する
words.englishDefinition: Place under restrictions; limit access to
words.japaneseExplanation: 制限の下に置く。アクセスを制限する。
words.example: You have no right to restrict Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Be on the mind of
words.japaneseExplanation: を気にかける。
words.example: I didn't have school to occupy my time.

words.japanese: (記憶などが徐々に)消えていく
words.englishDefinition: Become less clearly visible or distinguishable; disappear gradually or seemingly
words.japaneseExplanation: はっきりと見えなくなる、または区別できなくなる。徐々に、または一見したところ見えなくなる。
words.example: I don't want to colors of my towels to fade.

words.englishDefinition: Provide physical relief, as from pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的な痛みを軽減する。
words.example: This medicine will relieve the pain.

words.englishDefinition: Reduce the incidence or severity of or stop
words.japaneseExplanation: 発生率または重大性を減少する、あるいは、止める。
words.example: I wonder how I can suppress this feeling.

words.englishDefinition: Be hungry; go without food
words.japaneseExplanation: 空腹の。食物をなしですます。
words.example: You didn't want me to starve, did you?

words.englishDefinition: The state of being tense and feeling pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊張し、苦痛を感じている状態。
words.example: Have you been feeling a bit of discomfort lately?

words.englishDefinition: Throw into disorder
words.japaneseExplanation: めちゃくちゃにする。
words.example: I don't want to disrupt the party.

words.englishDefinition: Send on a course or in a direction different from the planned or intended one
words.japaneseExplanation: 計画的であるか意図されたものと異なるコース上で、あるいは方向に送る。
words.example: I tried to divert their attention without success.

words.englishDefinition: Show one's unhappiness or critical attitude
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の不幸または批判的な態度を示す。
words.example: I like to grumble at him.

words.englishDefinition: Evoke or provoke to appear or occur
words.japaneseExplanation: 現れるまたは起きるように喚起するまたは刺激する。
words.example: You don't need to provoke me.

words.englishDefinition: to be more important or valuable than something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 比べたときに、重要性や価値が上回ること。
words.example: The benefits of walking outweigh the inconvenience of leaving early.

words.englishDefinition: Have a craving, appetite, or great desire for
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱望、食欲またはものすごい願望を持つ。
words.example: You'll eventually get the attention you crave.

words.englishDefinition: Supply with necessities and support
words.japaneseExplanation: 必需品を供給し、支援を行う。
words.example: Our faith will sustain us.

words.englishDefinition: Make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前数人の人のみに知られていた、または機密にされていたことを意味する公開情報を明らかにする。
words.example: I am sorry, but we are not allowed to disclose this information.

words.englishDefinition: Dispose or incline or entice to
words.japaneseExplanation: したいと思わせる、心を向けさせる、あるいは誘惑する。
words.example: I didn't mean to tempt you.

words.englishDefinition: Leave (a job, post, or position) voluntarily
words.japaneseExplanation: 自発的に（仕事、役職、位置）を去る。
words.example: I don't want to resign my job at present.

words.englishDefinition: to remove someone from a job
words.japaneseExplanation: 雇っている人を仕事から辞めさせること。
words.example: The company decided to dismiss the manager.

words.englishDefinition: Distinguish oneself
words.japaneseExplanation: 目覚ましい働きをする。
words.example: Do you want so much to surpass me?

words.englishDefinition: Spring back; spring away from an impact
words.japaneseExplanation: 後ろに跳ねる。衝撃から跳び離れる。
words.example: We just have to bounce back.

words.englishDefinition: An administrative unit of government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の運営部門。
words.example: I intend to put this matter to the Bureau tonight.

words.englishDefinition: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何か他のものに依存している、コントロールされている状態。
words.example: Algeria needs to get rid of its dependency on oil.

words.japanese: であることがわかる、判明する
words.englishDefinition: Be shown or be found to be
words.japaneseExplanation: 示されるまたは、であることが発覚した。
words.example: I can prove that I am right.

words.englishDefinition: Keep tabs on; keep an eye on; keep under surveillance
words.japaneseExplanation: 見張る。注視する。
words.example: I am very satisfied with my new computer monitor.

words.englishDefinition: Win a victory over
words.japaneseExplanation: 勝利を収める。
words.example: I know I can defeat you.

words.japanese: 抗議する、異議を唱える
words.englishDefinition: Utter words of protest
words.japaneseExplanation: 抗議の言葉を吐く。
words.example: We have to protest against it.

words.englishDefinition: Intend (something) to move towards a certain goal
words.japaneseExplanation: （何か）を特定のゴールの方へ進めさせることを狙いとする。
words.example: I thought that I'd get in some target practice.

words.englishDefinition: Keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
words.japaneseExplanation: 不変の状態に保つかまたは維持する。残させる、または持続させる。
words.example: We had to smoke our meat to preserve it.

words.englishDefinition: Act against or in opposition to
words.japaneseExplanation: それに対して、あるいは反対して行う。
words.example: I hope you're not going to oppose me.

words.japanese: 移住する、周期的に移動する
words.englishDefinition: Move from one country or region to another and settle there
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つの国または地域からもう1つへ移って、そこに居住する。
words.example: I wonder why birds migrate.

words.englishDefinition: Consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質的な特徴か意味を発見するために、詳細に検討し分析する。
words.example: I want you to analyze this.

words.englishDefinition: Admonish or counsel in terms of someone's behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かの行動の点から見て忠告または助言する。
words.example: I don't want to discourage you from doing that.

words.englishDefinition: Establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts
words.japaneseExplanation: 新しい証拠または事実などで立証する、または補強する。
words.example: Could you please confirm that for me in writing?

words.englishDefinition: Have in mind as a purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的として考える。
words.example: I want you to know we intend to be back soon.

words.englishDefinition: Make a prediction about; tell in advance
words.japaneseExplanation: 予言をする。前もって予見する。
words.example: I won't try to predict the future.

words.englishDefinition: Extend in scope or range or area
words.japaneseExplanation: 範囲、幅または領域が広がる。
words.example: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

words.englishDefinition: A point where lines intersect
words.japaneseExplanation: 線が交わる点。
words.example: We ran out of gas in the middle of the intersection.

words.englishDefinition: Scrape or rub as if to relieve itching
words.japaneseExplanation: かゆみを軽減するかのように掻くあるいはこする。
words.example: I asked him if he would scratch my back.

words.englishDefinition: Act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief
words.japaneseExplanation: 協力して行うか、共通の目的または信念の下に結束する。
words.example: I would unite with anybody to do right, and with nobody to do wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Hold fast or firmly
words.japaneseExplanation: 速く、または、しっかりと保つ。
words.example: My mind slowly lost its grip on reality.

words.englishDefinition: Give up or agree to forgo to the power or possession of another
words.japaneseExplanation: 権力または他の者の所有物をあきらめまたは手放すことに同意する。
words.example: We should give Tom the chance to surrender.

words.englishDefinition: Twist suddenly so as to sprain
words.japaneseExplanation: 捻挫するように突然ねじる。
words.example: You always twist what I say.

words.englishDefinition: Do over, as of (part of) a house
words.japaneseExplanation: やり直す、家（の部分）のように。
words.example: We want to remodel our house.

words.englishDefinition: Increase threefold
words.japaneseExplanation: 3倍に増える。
words.example: I'd like a large triple-triple.

words.englishDefinition: Die from being submerged in water, getting water into the lungs, and asphyxiating
words.japaneseExplanation: 水中に沈められたことにより、肺の中に水が入り込み、窒息して死ぬ。
words.example: You were about to drown in the river.

words.englishDefinition: Have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをするまたは何かになる傾向のあるまたはその気質のある。何かをしがちな。
words.example: I don't have anyone to lean on.

words.japanese: ずぶ濡れになる、 (液体に)浸す
words.englishDefinition: Submerge in a liquid
words.japaneseExplanation: 液体にしずませる。
words.example: Japanese like to soak in hot water before going to sleep.

words.englishDefinition: to stay in one position in the air
words.japaneseExplanation: 空中のほぼ同じ場所にとどまること。
words.example: The helicopter hovered above the field before landing.

words.englishDefinition: Destroy the peace or tranquility of
words.japaneseExplanation: 平和または静けさを破壊する。
words.example: Please don't interrupt me when I am speaking.

words.englishDefinition: Take part in social activities; interact with others
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会活動に参加する。他人と相互作用する。
words.example: My new job leaves me little time to socialize.

words.englishDefinition: Whitish soft-bodied ant-like social insect that feeds on wood
words.japaneseExplanation: 木を主食にする白色の軟体のアリのような社会性の昆虫。
words.example: We have a termite problem that we need to do something about.

words.englishDefinition: A piece broken off or cut off of something else
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の物を砕いてできる部分。
words.example: There's a tiny fragment that's broken off.

words.englishDefinition: A ceremonial dinner party for many people
words.japaneseExplanation: 大勢の人々のための正式の食事会。
words.example: You are a feast for my eyes.

words.englishDefinition: A nonmetallic univalent element that is normally a colorless and odorless highly flammable diatomic gas; the simplest and lightest and most abundant element in the universe
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、無色の、そして、無臭の非常に可燃性の二原子のガスである非金属の一価要素。最も単純な構造を持ち、最も軽く、また宇宙に最も大量に存在する元素である。
words.example: Hydrogen has no more future than it had past.

words.englishDefinition: Making modern in appearance or behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 外観または行動を現代的にする。
words.example: Its modernization was far beyond my expectations.

words.englishDefinition: The goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
words.japaneseExplanation: （成し遂げられると考えられる）成し遂げるための目標。
words.example: My objective is to speak your language.

words.englishDefinition: An inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people
words.japaneseExplanation: ランダムに選んだ人にインタビューして行う世論の調査。
words.example: I am depressed by the results of the poll.

words.englishDefinition: The food allowance for one day (especially for service personnel)
words.japaneseExplanation: 1日分の食糧割り当て（特に軍人用の）。
words.example: We have used our ration of coal for the week.

words.englishDefinition: The entire amount of income before any deductions are made
words.japaneseExplanation: 何も引かない前の収入総額。
words.example: How much revenue are we talking about?

words.englishDefinition: Financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
words.japaneseExplanation: 学問をしやすいように学生に与えられる経済的援助。
words.example: I was thinking I'd get a scholarship somewhere.

words.englishDefinition: Helping someone grow up to be an accepted member of the community
words.japaneseExplanation: 人を社会に受け入れられる一員として育てること。
words.example: I had a pretty good upbringing.

words.englishDefinition: A remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration
words.japaneseExplanation: 賞賛と感嘆を表現する意見（または行為）。
words.example: I wouldn't mind a compliment from time to time.

words.englishDefinition: A passage selected from a larger work
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きな作品から選択された一節。
words.example: Dan played an excerpt of classical music to the students.

words.englishDefinition: A strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の運命を支配する超自然的な力、または能力への強い確信。
words.example: Our faith is very strong.

words.englishDefinition: One of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体の物を構成するために他と適合するいくつかの断片あるいは部分の1つ。
words.example: I am willing to bet that that particular segment of the population did not vote for him.

words.englishDefinition: A worsening of business or economic activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 商業的・経済的活動の悪化。
words.example: Today, my mood has taken a downturn and I feel worse than I did yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: A characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情の特徴的な状態（常習的または比較的一時的な）。
words.example: I hope you'll try to control your temper better next time.
